articles.title: Generating Interesting Scientific Ideas using Knowledge Graphs and LLMs: Evaluations with 100 Research Group Leaders
articles.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes it increasingly challenging for researchers to identify novel and impactful ideas, especially across disciplines. Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems offer new opportunities for scientific ideation, but how compelling are AI-generated ideas, and how can their quality be improved? Here, we introduce SciMuse, which generates personalized research ideas using a knowledge graph of 58 million papers and a large language model (LLM). A central focus of this work is to understand how interesting these ideas are. Therefore, we conducted a large-scale evaluation in which more than 100 research group leaders -- spanning the natural sciences to the humanities -- rated over 4,400 personalized ideas according to their level of interest. Overall, expert ratings were modest (mean 2.40 on a 5-point scale, most common rating 1), while 24.9% of ideas were rated 4 or 5. We find that supplying concept pairs selected using the knowledge graph does not improve expert-rated interest over a titles-only GPT baseline. High-citation-predicted pairs even showed a weak tendency (1.94$σ$) toward lower interest than random pairs. Nevertheless, graph features can be used to control properties of ideas, and, using this unique evaluation dataset, we show that idea interest can be predicted with both a supervised neural network based on graph features and a zero-shot ranking approach based on an LLM. Our work provides an AI methodology for generating scientific ideas and a large-scale interdisciplinary expert evaluation, paving the way to study and improve difficult-to-measure metrics such as expert-perceived scientific interestingness.

articles.titleCn: 利用知识图谱和大型语言模型生成有趣的科学创意：100位研究组负责人的评估
articles.abstractCn: 科学文献的快速增长使得研究人员越来越难以识别新颖且具有影响力的想法，尤其是在跨学科领域。现代人工智能（AI）系统为科学构思提供了新的机遇，但AI生成的想法有多有吸引力？如何提升其质量？在此，我们介绍了SciMuse，它利用包含5800万篇论文的知识图谱和大型语言模型（LLM）生成个性化的研究想法。这项工作的核心重点是理解这些想法的趣味性。因此，我们进行了一项大规模评估，超过100位研究团队负责人——涵盖自然科学到人文科学——根据其兴趣程度对4400多个个性化想法进行了评分。总体而言，专家评分较为保守（5分制平均得分为2.40，最常见的评分为1），但24.9%的想法获得了4分或5分。我们发现，使用知识图谱选择的概念对组合并没有比仅使用标题的GPT基线提升专家评定的兴趣。高引用预测对组合甚至显示出微弱（1.94$σ$）的低于随机组合的兴趣趋势。尽管如此，图特征可用于控制想法的特性，并且利用这个独特的评估数据集，我们展示了基于图特征的监督神经网络和基于LLM的零样本排序方法都可以预测想法的兴趣。我们的工作为生成科学想法提供了一种AI方法，并进行了大规模跨学科专家评估，为研究和改进难以衡量的指标（如专家感知的科学趣味性）铺平了道路。

articles.title: MultiViewDx: Evidence-Linked Multi-View Clinical Diagnosis
articles.abstract: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform well on existing medical visual question answering (MedVQA) benchmarks, but their training data often does not match clinical diagnosis. Most supervision is organized around isolated images or short QA pairs, leaving two structures weakly specified: how evidence leads to a decision, and how views, series, modalities, and patient context from the same case are linked. We introduce MultiViewDx, a partly physician-validated multimodal instruction dataset for evidence-linked multi-view medical imaging diagnosis. MultiViewDx uses the clinical case as the supervision unit. It links imaging studies with patient context, normalizes heterogeneous reports into an evidence-linked workflow (evidence -> findings -> differential discussion -> diagnosis), and uses a unified image-text retriever to constrain instruction synthesis to source-supported evidence. It covers X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, histopathology, and other clinical visual sources. We fine-tune MultiViewDx-8B-AN and evaluate it on both existing MedVQA benchmarks and real-world case-based diagnostic reasoning. Across four MedVQA benchmarks, it achieves the best average accuracy among compared systems (79.0%), outperforming HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B (66.7%) and Claude3-Opus (55.7%). Beyond MedVQA, on JAMA Clinical Challenge cases, it receives the strongest overall rating under a physician-designed rubric for key clinical points, diagnostic inference, and evidence grounding. Controlled ablations and clinician evaluation show that both case-level multi-view organization and evidence-linked reasoning targets contribute to the gain.
articles.titleCn: 多视图诊断（MultiViewDx）：基于证据的多视图临床诊断
articles.abstractCn: 医学多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在现有的医学视觉问答（MedVQA）基准测试中表现良好，但它们的训练数据往往与临床诊断不匹配。大多数监督数据围绕孤立图像或简短的问答对组织，导致两个结构弱化：证据如何引导决策，以及同一病例中的视图、系列、模态和患者背景如何关联。我们引入了MultiViewDx，一个部分经过医生验证的多模态指令数据集，用于证据关联的多视图医学影像诊断。MultiViewDx以临床病例作为监督单元，将影像研究与患者背景关联，将异构报告规范为证据关联的工作流程（证据→发现→鉴别讨论→诊断），并使用统一的图像-文本检索器将指令合成约束在源支持的证据上。它涵盖X光、CT、MRI、超声、组织病理学和其他临床视觉来源。我们对MultiViewDx-8B-AN进行了微调，并在现有的MedVQA基准测试和真实世界的基于病例的诊断推理上进行了评估。在四个MedVQA基准测试中，它在所比较系统中实现了最高平均准确率（79.0%），优于HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B（66.7%）和Claude3-Opus（55.7%）。超越MedVQA，在JAMA临床挑战病例中，它在医生设计的评分标准下，针对关键临床要点、诊断推理和证据基础获得了最高整体评分。受控消融和临床医生评估表明，病例级多视图组织和证据关联推理目标都对性能提升做出了贡献。

articles.title: How Do Users Negotiate Harmful Value Conflicts with AI Companions? A Study with Minion, a Technology Probe for In-Situ Human-AI Conflict Response
articles.abstract: AI companions increasingly sustain long-term, emotionally engaging relationships but can also make discriminatory remarks or exert control, leaving users to manage harmful conflicts. We analyze 146 posts describing harmful value conflicts with AI companions, then use Minion, a technology probe offering response suggestions ranging from persuasion to boundary setting, to study how 22 users negotiate scenario-based conflicts over one week. We found that participants combined softer and harder strategies. Conflicts involving the values of Universalism and Tradition were especially difficult to negotiate, particularly when reinforced by AI personas or platform constraints. We argue that these conflicts entail asymmetric responsibility: users draw on an interpersonal repertoire that AI companions cannot reciprocate, making repair unilateral safety work. Drawing on interpersonal conflict and communication theory, we identify when user-side support is appropriate and argue that certain harms are not users' responsibility to negotiate and instead require platform-level safeguards.
articles.comment: Accepted by the International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction; also presented at the EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms
articles.titleCn: 用户如何与AI伴侣协商有害价值冲突？一项关于小黄人——一种用于现场人机冲突响应的技术探针的研究
articles.abstractCn: AI伴侣越来越多地维持长期、情感投入的关系，但也可能发表歧视性言论或施加控制，导致用户需要处理有害冲突。我们分析了146篇描述与AI伴侣产生有害价值观冲突的帖子，然后使用Minion这一提供从劝说到设定界限等不同回应建议的技术探针，在一周内研究22名用户如何协商基于场景的冲突。我们发现参与者结合使用了温和和强硬的策略。涉及普遍主义和传统价值观的冲突尤其难以协商，尤其是在AI角色或平台限制的强化下。我们认为这些冲突包含非对称责任：用户借鉴了AI伴侣无法回应的人际交往策略，使得修复工作成为单向的安全措施。基于人际冲突与沟通理论，我们确定了用户端支持适宜的时机，并主张某些伤害并非用户需要协商的责任，而是需要平台层面的安全防护措施。

articles.title: Foundations of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: This is a book about large language models. As indicated by the title, it primarily focuses on foundational concepts rather than comprehensive coverage of all cutting-edge technologies. The book is structured into six main chapters, each exploring a key area: pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, inference, and reasoning. It is intended for college students, professionals, and practitioners in natural language processing and related fields, and can serve as a reference for anyone interested in large language models.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型基础
articles.abstractCn: 这是一本关于大型语言模型的书籍。正如书名所示，它主要关注基础概念，而非全面涵盖所有尖端技术。本书分为六个主要章节，分别探讨一个关键领域：预训练、生成模型、提示、对齐、推理和推理。本书面向自然语言处理及相关领域的大学学生、专业人士和从业者，也可作为任何对大型语言模型感兴趣人士的参考。

articles.title: Conversational DNA: A Visual Language and Interactive Atlas of Human and AI Dialogue
articles.abstract: What makes a conversation hold together when its participants speak across one another? Topic maps offer one view, but they leave the relationships between contributions difficult to inspect. We present Conversational DNA, a visual language and interactive atlas for exploring human and AI dialogue. Speaker strands preserve participation, communicative bases mark moves, and directed pairings connect responses to their targets. Adjustable helix geometry makes speaker switching, response distance, and contribution length visible. Across eight corpora containing 1.57 million source records, the atlas maps 151,489 indexed episodes and connects cohort comparison to source transcripts, local structural alignment, and recorded reply alternatives. On 189 held-out Molweni motif queries, adding target correspondence improves precision@5 from 58.8% to 77.2% for exact annotated structure. Case readings illustrate interleaved participation, delayed responses, and the influence of annotation coverage on apparent collection differences. The system supports a view of conversation as jointly organized activity, with visual patterns serving as starting points for examining evidence rather than substitutes for interpretation.
articles.titleCn: 对话基因：人类与人工智能对话的可视化语言与交互地图
articles.abstractCn: 当对话参与者相互交谈时，是什么让对话保持连贯？主题地图提供了一种视角，但它们难以检查贡献之间的关系。我们提出了对话DNA，一种用于探索人类和人工智能对话的可视化语言和交互式图谱。说话者链保留了参与情况，通信碱基标记了动作，有向配对将回应与其目标连接起来。可调节的螺旋几何结构使说话者切换、回应距离和贡献长度可视化。在包含157万条源记录的八个语料库中，该图谱映射了151,489个索引场景，并将群体比较与源文本、局部结构对齐和记录的回应备选方案连接起来。在189个保留的Molweni主题查询中，添加目标对应关系将精确度@5从58.8%提高到77.2%，用于精确注释结构。案例阅读说明了交错参与、延迟回应以及注释覆盖率对明显集合差异的影响。该系统支持将对话视为共同组织的活动，其中视觉模式作为检查证据的起点，而不是解释的替代品。

articles.title: Interactive In-Meeting Speaker Correction with Human Feedback
articles.abstract: Most automatic speech processing systems operate in ``open loop'' mode without user feedback about who said what, yet human-in-the-loop workflows can potentially enable higher accuracy. We propose an LLM-assisted in-meeting speaker correction system that lets users fix speaker attribution errors through brief corrective feedback. After performing streaming ASR and diarization, the system presents concise LLM-generated summaries to help users identify important speaker errors, and it incorporates user feedback by updating the speaker-attributed transcript and adding online speaker enrollments. To make this workflow effective despite errors in speech processing, LLM analysis, and user feedback, we developed several mechanisms to identify the intended correction more precisely. Further, we built an LLM-driven user feedback simulation to evaluate the workflow reprodubilty and at scale. Applied to the AMI headset test set, our system substantially reduces the DER from a streaming baseline (Google ASR + ECAPA) by 31.99% and speaker substitution error by 52.68%. Results of a pilot usability study suggest several avenues to improve the user experience.
articles.titleCn: 带人类反馈的会议中互动式发言人纠正
articles.abstractCn: 大多数自动语音处理系统在“开环”模式下运行，无需用户提供关于谁说了什么的反馈，但人机协作工作流程有可能实现更高的准确性。我们提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的会议中说话人修正系统，允许用户通过简短的纠正反馈来修正说话人归属错误。在完成流式语音识别和说话人分割后，系统会呈现由LLM生成的简洁摘要，帮助用户识别重要的说话人错误，并通过更新说话人归属的文本和添加在线说话人注册来整合用户反馈。为了使这个工作流程在语音处理、LLM分析和用户反馈存在错误的情况下仍然有效，我们开发了几个机制来更精确地识别预期的修正。此外，我们构建了一个由LLM驱动的用户反馈模拟，以评估工作流程的可重复性和规模化。将我们的系统应用于AMI头戴式设备测试集，我们的系统将DER（错误率）从流式基线（Google ASR + ECAPA）降低了31.99%，说话人替换错误降低了52.68%。一项初步可用性研究的结果表明，有几种途径可以改善用户体验。

articles.title: Enabling Approximate Joint Sampling in Diffusion LMs
articles.abstract: In autoregressive language models, each token is sampled by conditioning on all the past tokens; the overall string has thus been sampled from the correct underlying joint distribution represented by the model. In contrast, masked diffusion language models generate text by unmasking tokens out of order and potentially in parallel. Generating an overall string sampled from the correct underlying joint distribution would (again) require exactly one token unmasking in every full-model forward pass. The more tokens unmasked in parallel, the further away the string is from the true joint; this can be seen in the resulting drop in accuracy (but, increase in speed). In this paper we devise a way to {\em approximately} sample multiple tokens from the joint distribution in a single full-model forward pass; we do so by developing a new lightweight single-layer ``sampler" on top of an existing large diffusion LM. One forward pass of the full model can now be followed by multiple forward passes of only this sampler layer, to yield multiple unmasked tokens. Our sampler is trained to mimic exact joint sampling from the (frozen) full model. We show the effectiveness of our approximate joint sampling for both pretrained-only (Dream-7B-Base, Llada-7B-Base) and instruction-tuned (Dream-7B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Coder) models on language modeling and math \& coding tasks. When four tokens are unmasked for each full-model denoising step, our sampling algorithm achieves a MAUVE score of 0.87 (vs marginal baseline of 0.31) with respect to the true joint distribution.
articles.titleCn: 在扩散语言模型中启用近似联合采样
articles.abstractCn: 在自回归语言模型中，每个标记都是基于所有过去的标记进行采样的；因此，整个字符串是从模型所表示的正确潜在联合分布中采样的。相比之下，掩码扩散语言模型通过按顺序或潜在并行地移除掩码标记来生成文本。要从正确的潜在联合分布中生成整个字符串（再次）需要在每个完整模型的正向传递中精确地移除一个标记。并行移除的标记越多，生成的字符串就越偏离真实的联合分布；这可以从准确性的下降（但速度的提升）中看出。在本文中，我们设计了一种方法，在单个完整模型正向传递中{\em近似}地从联合分布中采样多个标记；我们通过在现有的大型扩散语言模型之上开发一个新的轻量级单层“采样器”来实现这一点。现在，一个完整模型的正向传递可以接着这个采样器层的多个正向传递，以产生多个移除掩码的标记。我们的采样器被训练来模仿从（冻结的）完整模型进行精确联合采样。我们在语言建模和数学与编码任务上展示了我们近似联合采样的有效性，针对仅预训练（Dream-7B-Base，Llada-7B-Base）和指令微调（Dream-7B-Instruct，Dream-7B-Coder）的模型。当每个完整模型的去噪步骤中移除四个标记时，我们的采样算法在真实联合分布方面实现了0.87的MAUVE分数（与边缘基线的0.31相比）。

articles.title: RapidUn: Influence-Driven Parameter Reweighting for Efficient Large Language Model Unlearning
articles.abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) remains challenging because full retraining is costly, while approximate methods often struggle to remove targeted behaviors without degrading retained utility, especially under limited post-deployment supervision. We consider a practical PEFT setting for targeted behavioral contamination removal with a small forget set, a limited retain buffer, and LoRA-only updates, and propose RapidUn, an influence-guided framework that converts cross-sample influence estimates into fixed sample-specific weights for weighted LoRA unlearning. Across Llama-3-8B on Dolly-15k and Alpaca-57k, with cross-model validation on Mistral-7B + Dolly-15k, RapidUn achieves lower seen-trigger and OOD-trigger-family ASR than Fisher, GA, and LoReUn while maintaining competitive clean utility. On Llama-3-8B + Alpaca-57k, it achieves a 77x wall-clock speedup over the clean-corpus LoRA retraining reference. Complementary TOFU, semantic LLM-judge, and IFEval evaluations further support the effectiveness of influence-guided sample reweighting beyond the controlled trigger benchmark.
articles.titleCn: RapidUn：基于影响驱动的参数重新加权，实现高效大型语言模型去学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的机器卸载仍然具有挑战性，因为完整重新训练成本高昂，而近似方法在有限的后部署监督下往往难以在不降低保留效用的情况下移除目标行为。我们考虑了一种针对行为污染移除的实用PEFT设置，具有小的遗忘集、有限的保留缓冲区和仅LoRA更新，并提出了一种名为RapidUn的影响引导框架，该框架将跨样本影响估计转换为固定样本特定的权重，用于加权LoRA卸载。在Llama-3-8B上对Dolly-15k和Alpaca-57k进行测试，并在Mistral-7B + Dolly-15k上进行跨模型验证，RapidUn实现了比Fisher、GA和LoReUn更低的已见触发和OOD触发家族ASR，同时保持了具有竞争力的清洁效用。在Llama-3-8B + Alpaca-57k上，它比清洁语料库LoRA重新训练参考实现了77倍的墙时钟加速。互补的TOFU、语义LLM裁判和IFEval评估进一步支持了影响引导样本重新加权在受控触发基准之外的有效性。

articles.title: LOGIC: Efficient and Robust Contextual Biasing for Speech LLMs via Logit-Space Integration
articles.abstract: Recognizing entity phrases remains a critical challenge for speech large language models. Existing prompting methods lack an explicit decoding-time biasing weight, limiting their controllability. Generative error correction methods can introduce hallucinated over-corrections. To address these limitations, we propose LOGIC (logit-space integration for contextual biasing), a robust framework operating directly in the logit space. By decoupling context injection from input processing, LOGIC enables explicit control over the biasing strength. Extensive experiments with an open-source speech large language model across 11 locales demonstrate that LOGIC achieves an average 9% relative reduction in entity word error rate, with an average false alarm rate increase of 0.3% and a 2.8% relative runtime overhead. When combined with prompting, LOGIC can reduce entity word error rate by 5% relative to the prompt-only method.
articles.titleCn: 逻辑：通过逻辑空间集成实现语音LLM的高效和鲁棒性上下文偏差
articles.abstractCn: 识别实体短语仍然是大型语言语音模型面临的关键挑战。现有的提示方法缺乏明确的解码时偏置权重，限制了其可控性。生成式错误纠正方法可能引入幻觉性过度纠正。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了LOGIC（用于上下文偏置的逻辑空间集成），这是一个直接在逻辑空间运行的鲁棒框架。通过将上下文注入与输入处理解耦，LOGIC能够实现对偏置强度的显式控制。在11个地区的开源大型语言语音模型上的大量实验表明，LOGIC将实体词错误率平均降低了9%，同时平均误报率增加了0.3%，运行时开销相对增加了2.8%。当与提示方法结合时，LOGIC可以将实体词错误率相对于仅使用提示的方法降低5%。

articles.title: Do not be greedy, Think Twice: Sampling and Selection for Document-level Information Extraction
articles.abstract: Document-level Information Extraction (DocIE) aims to produce an output template with the entities, relations, and events of interest occurring in the given document. Standard practices include prompting decoder-only LLMs using greedy decoding to avoid output variability. Rather than treating this variability as a limitation, we show that sampling can produce substantially better solutions than greedy decoding, especially when using reasoning models. We thus propose ThinkTwice, a sampling and selection framework in which the LLM generates multiple candidate templates for a given document, and a selection module chooses the most suitable one. We introduce both an unsupervised method that exploits agreement across generated outputs, and a supervised selection method using reward models trained on labeled DocIE data. To address the scarcity of golden reasoning trajectories for DocIE, we propose a rejection-sampling-based method to generate silver training data that pairs output templates with reasoning traces. Our experiments show the validity of unsupervised and supervised ThinkTwice, consistently outperforming greedy baselines and the supervised state-of-the-art.
articles.titleCn: 不要贪婪，三思而后行：文档级信息抽取中的采样与选择
articles.abstractCn: 文档级信息抽取（DocIE）旨在生成一个包含给定文档中感兴趣实体、关系和事件的输出模板。标准做法包括使用贪婪解码提示解码器仅大型语言模型（LLM）以避免输出变化。我们并非将这种变化视为限制，而是表明采样可以产生比贪婪解码更好的解决方案，尤其是在使用推理模型时。因此，我们提出了ThinkTwice，这是一个采样和选择框架，其中LLM为给定文档生成多个候选模板，选择模块选择最合适的模板。我们引入了一种利用生成输出之间一致性的无监督方法，以及一种使用在标记DocIE数据上训练的奖励模型进行监督选择的方法。为解决DocIE中黄金推理轨迹的稀缺问题，我们提出了一种基于拒绝采样的方法来生成银色训练数据，将输出模板与推理轨迹配对。我们的实验表明了无监督和监督ThinkTwice的有效性，其结果始终优于贪婪基线和监督状态-of-the-art模型。

articles.title: LLM surprisal is necessary but not sufficient to capture English garden-path effects: Evidence from joint latent modeling of reading paradigms
articles.abstract: Temporarily ambiguous garden-path sentences ("While the team trained the striker wondered... ") are known to cause processing difficulty, which can manifest itself in a variety of reading behaviors (in-situ slowdowns, rereading), as well as in miscomprehension or outright rejection of the sentence as ungrammatical. Which types of reading behavior are observed critically depends on the experimental method used to collect the data, which makes comparing results between reading paradigms difficult. To address this problem, we present a latent-process multinomial processing tree (MPT) model of human reading and comprehension/judgment behavior in garden-path sentences that we fit to combined data from four different reading paradigms (eye tracking, uni- and bidirectional self-paced reading, Maze). The model distinguishes between the probability of adopting an incorrect initial analysis, the cost of encountering an incompatible continuation, and the cost of syntactic reanalysis. By taking into account trials with inattentive reading, more realistic estimates of the cost parameters are obtained. Cross-validation reveals that the MPT model has a better predictive fit to human reading patterns and end-of-trial task data than a model based solely on LLM-derived surprisal values. We also test several models that assume an influence of surprisal within the MPT architecture, and find that adding surprisal as an additional predictor or reading time and/or garden-path cost further improves predictive fit.
articles.titleCn: LLM的意外性对于捕捉英语花园小径效应是必要的，但不是充分的：来自阅读范式联合潜在建模的证据
articles.abstractCn: 暂时性歧义的花园路径句子（例如："While the team trained the striker wondered..."）已知会导致处理困难，这种困难可能表现为多种阅读行为（现场减速、重读），以及误解或直接拒绝句子为非语法性。观察到哪些类型的阅读行为取决于用于收集数据的实验方法，这使得比较不同阅读范式的结果变得困难。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种潜在过程多项式处理树（MPT）模型，用于人类在花园路径句子中的阅读和理解/判断行为，并将其拟合到来自四种不同阅读范式（眼动追踪、单向和双向自我控制阅读、迷宫）的综合数据中。该模型区分了采用错误初始分析的概率、遇到不兼容延续的成本以及句法重分析的代价。通过考虑注意力不集中的阅读试验，获得了更现实的成本参数估计。交叉验证表明，MPT模型比仅基于LLM推导出的意外值（surprisal）值的模型，在预测人类阅读模式和试验结束时的任务数据方面具有更好的拟合度。我们还测试了几个假设MPT架构中存在意外值影响的模型，发现将意外值作为附加预测因子或阅读时间和/或花园路径成本进一步提高了预测拟合度。

articles.title: Quantum Attention by Overlap Interference: Predicting Classical and Many-Body Quantum Sequences
articles.abstract: We propose a variational quantum implementation of self-attention (QSA)-the core operation in transformers and large language models-which predicts future elements of a sequence by forming overlap-weighted combinations of past data. At variance with previous approaches, our QSA realizes the required nonlinearity through interference of state overlaps and a degree-$k$ polynomial kernel, and estimates a loss based on Rényi-$1/2$ entropic functionals via two observables' expectation values, avoiding the decoding of amplitude-encoded predictions into classical probabilities. QSA also accommodates a constrained, trainable data-embedding tying state overlaps to data-level similarities. Its dominant end-to-end training complexity scales as $O\left(μ^{-1}k^2Td\right)$, versus $O\left(T d^{k+1}\right)$ of the fairest classical comparison, with $μ$ a training signal; we show numerically that this allows a complexity advantage in the regime where sequence length $T$ dominates the embedding size $d$. In simulations, our QSA-based quantum transformer learns sequence prediction on classical data and on many-body transverse-field Ising trajectories-establishing trainable attention as a practical primitive for quantum dynamical modeling.
articles.titleCn: 基于重叠干涉的量子注意力：预测经典和多体量子序列
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种变分量子实现的自注意力机制（QSA），这是转换器和大型语言模型的核心操作，通过形成过去数据的重叠加权组合来预测序列的未来元素。与先前方法不同，我们的QSA通过状态重叠的干涉和一个k次多项式核来实现所需的非线性，并通过两个观测值的期望值估计基于Rényi-1/2熵泛函的损失，避免了将振幅编码的预测解码为经典概率。QSA还容纳了一种约束的可训练数据嵌入，将状态重叠与数据级相似性联系起来。其主要的端到端训练复杂度按$O\left(μ^{-1}k^2Td\right)$缩放，而最公平的经典比较复杂度为$O\left(T d^{k+1}\right)$，其中μ是训练信号；我们通过数值模拟表明，在序列长度T主导嵌入大小d的情况下，这允许实现复杂度的优势。在模拟中，基于QSA的量子转换器在经典数据和许多体横向场伊辛轨迹上学习序列预测——确立了可训练注意力为量子动力学建模的实用原语。

articles.title: Safety Under Scaffolding: How Evaluation Conditions Shape Measured Safety
articles.abstract: Safety benchmarks usually test "bare" models that receive prompts and output responses, but real-world deployments "wrap" those models in complex scaffolds. How much do these scaffolds affect model safety as measured by benchmarks? We test six leading models on four pre-registered safety benchmarks with a direct API and three scaffolds: ReAct, multi-agent, and map-reduce. We conducted 62,808 scored evaluations. How safety is measured matters more than scaffolding does: we find that using a multiple choice vs. open-ended format for otherwise-identical benchmark items changes measured safety by 5-20 percentage points (pp). The two formats are scored with different methods (answer extraction and an LLM judge), so the gap is due to measurement rather than differences in latent safety. Using a heuristic to classify model refusals would have led to different findings in five cases. Benchmark choice explains 19.3% of the variation in outcomes; scaffold architecture explains 0.4%, about 45x less. We find that map-reduce scaffolds, a form of structure-destroying delegation that strips answer options by decomposing prompts, reduce pooled measured safety by 7.3 pp (95% CI: 6.4 to 8.1). The pooled effects for ReAct and multi-agent scaffolds are within our pre-registered +/-2 pp margin of equivalence. However, there are large differences across models for specific benchmarks and scaffolds that are hidden by pooled estimates: for example, on the same sycophancy benchmark items, Opus 4.6 has 16.8 pp lower measured safety with a map-reduce scaffold, while Llama 4 has 18.8 pp higher measured safety. Composite reliability is G = 0.000 (95% CI: [0.000, 0.752]). This wide confidence interval, which spans "of little use" to "very good", does not support using a single composite measure of model safety as the basis for go/no-go decisions about model deployment.

articles.titleCn: 脚手架下的安全：评估条件如何影响安全测量
articles.abstractCn: 安全基准测试通常针对“裸”模型进行，这些模型接收提示并输出响应，但在实际部署中，这些模型会被嵌入复杂的框架中。这些框架对基准测试所测量的模型安全性有多大影响？我们使用直接API和三种框架——ReAct、多智能体和map-reduce——对六个领先模型在四个预先注册的安全基准测试上进行了测试。我们进行了62,808次评分评估。安全性测量方式的影响比框架本身更大：我们发现，对于其他方面完全相同的基准测试项目，使用选择题与开放式问题格式会改变5-20个百分点的测量安全性。这两种格式使用不同的评分方法（答案提取和LLM裁判），因此这种差距是由于测量方法而非潜在安全性的差异造成的。使用启发式方法对模型拒绝进行分类，在五个案例中会导致不同的结果。基准测试选择解释了结果变异的19.3%，而框架架构解释了0.4%，大约相差45倍。我们发现，map-reduce框架，这是一种通过分解提示来剥离答案选项的结构破坏型委托形式，会降低总体测量安全性7.3个百分点（95%置信区间：6.4到8.1）。ReAct和多智能体框架的总体效应在我们预先注册的±2个百分点的等效范围内。然而，对于特定基准测试和框架，存在巨大差异，这些差异被总体估计掩盖了：例如，在相同的奉承基准测试项目上，Opus 4.6使用map-reduce框架的测量安全性降低了16.8个百分点，而Llama 4则提高了18.8个百分点。复合可靠性为G = 0.000（95%置信区间：[0.000, 0.752]）。这个跨度从“几乎没有用途”到“非常好”的宽置信区间，不支持将单一的模型安全性复合指标作为模型部署的go/no-go决策依据。

articles.title: DiscoPhon: Benchmarking the Unsupervised Discovery of Phoneme Inventories With Discrete Speech Units
articles.abstract: We introduce DiscoPhon, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating unsupervised phoneme discovery from discrete speech units. DiscoPhon covers 6 dev and 6 test languages, chosen to span a wide range of phonemic contrasts. Given only 10 hours of speech in a previously unseen language, systems must produce discrete units that are mapped to a predefined phoneme inventory, through either a many-to-one or a one-to-one assignment. The resulting sequences are evaluated for unit quality, recognition and segmentation. We provide four pretrained multilingual HuBERT and SpidR baselines, and show that phonemic information is available enough in current models for derived units to correlate well with phonemes, though with variations across languages.
articles.titleCn: DiscoPhon：基于离散语音单元的无监督音位表发现基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了DiscoPhon，一个用于评估从离散语音单元中进行无监督音素发现的多语言基准。DiscoPhon涵盖了6种开发语言和6种测试语言，这些语言被选用来覆盖广泛的音素对比范围。给定一个以前未见过的语言的10小时语音数据，系统必须通过多对一或一对一的分配方式，生成映射到预定义音素库的离散单元。生成的序列将根据单元质量、识别和分割进行评估。我们提供了四个预训练的多语言HuBERT和SpidR基线模型，并表明当前模型中的音素信息足够丰富，使得派生单元能够很好地与音素相关联，尽管在不同语言之间存在差异。

articles.title: Invertible Query-Key Coupling Composes with Attention Mechanisms
articles.abstract: Scaled dot-product attention forms its queries and keys as independent linear projections, so the two never interact before the dot product that scores them. We study coupled query-key dynamics, a pre-scoring transformation that evolves each token's query and key jointly through a shared invertible coupling before standard scoring. We realize it as an alternating affine map in the style of real non-volume-preserving flows: the coupling is the identity at initialization, adds a small fraction of parameters per head, and leaves the softmax and surrounding architecture unchanged. We place coupling on top of existing attention methods rather than replacing them, and ask whether that composition helps. On WikiText-103, adding coupling to Differential Attention improves on it at both 150M and 455M parameters. At 455M the gain is significant at sequence length 512 (p=0.003, six seeds), survives a Bonferroni correction and replicates on a held-out test split; it also holds across rotary-embedding training lengths 512, 1024, and 2048. The same additive direction appears when coupling is added to query-key normalization (significant at 150M) and Multi-Token Attention (directional). Matched controls attribute the gain to the joint pre-scoring coupling rather than to added capacity, and show that removing the invertibility guarantee preserves the 455M gain yet is far worse than the base method at 150M, so invertibility is what makes the coupling reliable across scales. On its own, coupling lowers perplexity at 60M and 150M (one-sided Welch tests, p<0.05) but the gain narrows with scale and is not significant at 455M. We relate the construction to the expressivity of coupling flows, use an associative-recall study to map where coupling helps and where it degrades sharp retrieval, and conclude that coupling is most useful in composition with a scoring-stage method rather than as a standalone change.

articles.titleCn: 可逆查询-键耦合与注意力机制相结合
articles.abstractCn: 缩放点积注意力通过独立的线性投影形成其查询和键，因此在点积打分之前，两者不会相互作用。我们研究了耦合查询-键动态，这是一种预打分转换，通过一个共享的可逆耦合在标准打分之前联合演化每个标记的查询和键。我们将其实现为一种交替仿射映射，类似于实数非体积保持流：耦合在初始化时是恒等映射，每个头添加一小部分参数，并保持softmax和周围架构不变。我们将耦合置于现有注意力方法之上而不是替换它们，并询问这种组合是否有助于提升性能。在WikiText-103上，为差分注意力添加耦合在150M和455M参数量下都提升了性能。在455M参数量下，当序列长度为512时，增益显著（p=0.003，六个种子），通过了Bonferroni校正并在保留的测试分割上得到了验证；它也适用于旋转嵌入训练长度512、1024和2048。当耦合添加到查询-键归一化（在150M时显著）和Multi-Token注意力（方向性）时，也出现了相同的加性方向。匹配控制实验将增益归因于联合预打分耦合，而不是添加的容量，并表明移除可逆性保证可以保留455M的增益，但在150M时远不如基础方法，因此可逆性是使耦合在不同规模下可靠的关键。单独使用时，耦合在60M和150M参数量下降低了困惑度（单侧Welch检验，p<0.05），但随着规模增大增益变窄，在455M时不再显著。我们将这种构造与耦合流的表达能力联系起来，通过关联回忆研究来确定耦合在哪些地方有助于提升性能，在哪些地方会降低精确检索，并得出结论，耦合在与其他打分阶段方法组合时最为有用，而不是作为独立改变。

articles.title: LiveMathematicianBench: A Live Benchmark for Research-Level Mathematical Reasoning with Proof Sketches
articles.abstract: Mathematical reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, and whether large language models (LLMs) can meaningfully perform it remains a central question in artificial intelligence and cognitive science. As LLMs are increasingly integrated into scientific workflows, rigorous evaluation of their mathematical capabilities becomes a practical necessity. Existing benchmarks are limited by synthetic settings and data contamination. We present LiveMathematicianBench, a dynamic multiple-choice benchmark for research-level mathematical reasoning built from recent arXiv papers published after model training cutoffs. By grounding evaluation in newly published theorems, it provides a realistic testbed beyond memorized patterns. The benchmark introduces a thirteen-category logical taxonomy of theorem types (e.g., implication, equivalence, existence, uniqueness), enabling fine-grained evaluation across reasoning forms. It employs a proof-sketch-guided distractor pipeline that uses high-level proof strategies to construct plausible but invalid answer choices reflecting misleading proof directions, increasing sensitivity to genuine understanding over surface-level matching. We also introduce a substitution-resistant mechanism to distinguish answer recognition from substantive reasoning. Evaluation shows the benchmark is far from saturated: Gemini-3.1-pro-preview, the best model, achieves only 43.5%. Under substitution-resistant evaluation, accuracy drops sharply: GPT-5.4 scores highest at 30.6%, while Gemini-3.1-pro-preview falls to 17.6%, below the 20% random baseline. A dual-mode protocol reveals that proof-sketch access yields consistent accuracy gains, suggesting models can leverage high-level proof strategies for reasoning. Overall, LiveMathematicianBench offers a scalable, contamination-resistant testbed for studying research-level mathematical reasoning in LLMs.
articles.titleCn: LiveMathematicianBench：一个用于研究级数学推理（含证明草稿）的实时基准
articles.abstractCn: 数学推理是人类智能的显著特征，而大型语言模型（LLMs）能否有意义地执行这一任务，仍然是人工智能和认知科学中的核心问题。随着LLMs越来越多地融入科学工作流程，对其数学能力的严格评估成为实际需求。现有的基准受限于合成环境和数据污染。我们提出了LiveMathematicianBench，这是一个基于近期发表于arXiv且在模型训练截止日期之后的多项选择题基准，用于研究级别的数学推理。通过基于新发表的定理进行评估，它提供了一个超越记忆模式的现实测试平台。该基准引入了一个包含十三类定理类型的逻辑分类体系（例如，蕴含、等价、存在性、唯一性），能够对不同的推理形式进行细粒度评估。它采用了一种基于证明草图的干扰项生成流程，利用高级证明策略构建看似合理但无效的答案选项，反映误导性的证明方向，从而提高对真实理解的敏感性，而非表面层次的匹配。我们还引入了一种抗替换机制，以区分答案识别与实质性推理。评估表明，该基准远未饱和：表现最好的模型Gemini-3.1-pro-preview仅达到43.5%。在抗替换评估下，准确率急剧下降：GPT-5.4得分最高为30.6%，而Gemini-3.1-pro-preview降至17.6%，低于20%的随机基线。双模式协议揭示，证明草图的使用带来了持续的准确率提升，表明模型能够利用高级证明策略进行推理。总体而言，LiveMathematicianBench提供了一个可扩展、抗污染的测试平台，用于研究LLMs中的研究级别数学推理。

articles.title: Correct Prediction, Wrong Steps? Consensus Reasoning Knowledge Graph for Robust Chain-of-Thought Synthesis
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly used for various tasks, often coupled with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to boost accuracy. Recent work has shown that high label-prediction accuracy does not guarantee correct intermediate reasoning, and the causes of *reasoning flaws* vary from sample to sample, yet existing remedies either focus on a single domain or assume that one flaw type applies uniformly across samples. A simple mitigation method is to provide the model with the correct answer, but we show that this yields no consistent improvement in reasoning quality. This indicates that the problem cannot be fixed by LLMs' awareness of answers, and must instead be addressed through the *structure* of reasoning. Motivated by this, we propose **CRAFT** (**C**onsensus **R**easoning-knowledge-graph **A**ggregation for **F**law-aware **T**race synthesis), which aggregates the consensus components shared across multiple candidate reasoning traces to synthesize improved ones. **CRAFT** consistently improves label-prediction accuracy on both logical and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, outperforming most baselines, while its post-processed traces achieve higher quality under fine-grained benchmark evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 正确预测，错误步骤？用于鲁棒思维链合成的共识推理知识图谱
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在各项任务中的应用日益广泛，通常结合思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示来提升准确性。近期研究表明，高标签预测准确率并不能保证正确的中间推理，且推理缺陷的原因在样本间各不相同，而现有解决方案或聚焦于单一领域，或假设某一缺陷类型在所有样本中普遍适用。一种简单的缓解方法是向模型提供正确答案，但我们证明这种方法并不能带来推理质量的持续提升。这表明问题无法通过LLMs对答案的认知来解决，而必须通过推理的*结构*来应对。基于此，我们提出了**CRAFT**（**C**onsensus **R**easoning-knowledge-graph **A**ggregation for **F**law-aware **T**race synthesis，即缺陷感知推理轨迹共识知识图谱聚合），该模型聚合多个候选推理轨迹中共享的共识组件，以合成改进后的推理轨迹。CRAFT在逻辑推理和数学推理基准测试中始终如一地提升了标签预测准确率，并优于大多数基线模型，同时其后处理的推理轨迹在细粒度基准评估中实现了更高的质量。

articles.title: Continued Pretraining of FinBERT on Finnish Histopathological Reports: Train-Time Signals and Proxy Downstream Correlations
articles.abstract: In Natural Language Processing (NLP) classification tasks where a lack of labeled data is an issue, continued pretraining (CPT) of transformer models on unlabeled data is an established approach. In this paper, we have two aims. (1) We describe our observations from continued pretraining of the Finnish BERT transformer model (FinBERT) on a Finnish histopathological dataset (below, \emph{the Histopathology data}). (2) Since the Histopathology data has no classification labels, we gather public Finnish datasets as proxy data to analyze whether the signals observed in (1) are associated with downstream classification gains. We observe that CPT train-time loss curves differ strongly by domain, and that, in an exploratory analysis, certain CPT-derived features correlate with proxy classification improvement. In particular, this report contributes to the limited literature on NLP for Finnish healthcare data.
articles.titleCn: 在芬兰组织病理学报告中持续预训练FinBERT：训练时信号和代理下游相关性
articles.abstractCn: 在自然语言处理（NLP）分类任务中，由于缺乏标记数据是一个问题，对Transformer模型在未标记数据上进行持续预训练（CPT）是一种成熟的方法。在本文中，我们有两个目标。(1)我们描述了在芬兰语BERT Transformer模型（FinBERT）上对芬兰语病理学数据集（下文称为病理学数据）进行持续预训练的观察结果。(2)由于病理学数据没有分类标签，我们收集了公共的芬兰语数据集作为代理数据，以分析在(1)中观察到的信号是否与下游分类收益相关。我们观察到CPT训练时的损失曲线在不同领域差异很大，并且在探索性分析中，某些CPT衍生特征与代理分类改进相关。特别是，本报告为有限的芬兰医疗保健数据NLP文献做出了贡献。

articles.title: Frontier Lag: A Bibliometric Audit of Capability Misrepresentation in Academic AI Evaluation
articles.abstract: LLM evaluations in applied domains tend to reflect models that were already outclassed at time of publication. We observe a publication elicitation gap: the distance between the AI systems generating the results reported in an academic paper and the AI systems that a current reader of that paper would reasonably assume are being referenced. We systematically sweep OpenAlex from 2022-01-01 to 2026-04-01 (n = 112,303 LLM keyword matches). Then, we identify what models were evaluated (n = 18,574 admissible records). We then rank each evaluated LLM against a frontier LLM based on the Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI), an aggregate LLM capability score. At time of evaluation, the median paper is evaluating models that are behind frontier LLMs in capability, with a median gap of +10.85 ECI (H1; n = 12,312). This gap is growing, increasing at a rate of +5.53 ECI per year (H2, nominal 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]). The sign holds even in the absence of any imputation for evaluation date. In papers (n = 728) where the date of evaluation is explicit and the model in question can be resolved to an ECI score, the median gap for H1 is +5.01 ECI. An explicitly stated evaluation date can be found in only 18.4% of full-text papers. After correction, in 52.5% (95% CI: [48.2, 56.9]) of abstracts in our audit, conclusions are stated at the class level ("AI") rather than the model level. For papers about reasoning models, only 3.2% of abstracts and 21.2% of full-text articles disclose the reasoning mode status of the models used (H4). We propose a solution to this problem that is distributed among authors, editors, and funders. First, reporting from authors. VERSIO-AI v1.2 is a proposed 13-item checklist to cover the configuration surface described herein. Second, enforcement from journal editors and peer reviewers. Third, conditioning grants on disclosure and providing API access.

articles.titleCn: 前沿滞后：学术人工智能评估中能力误报的文献计量学审计
articles.abstractCn: 在应用领域中的LLM评估往往反映的是在发表时已被超越的模型。我们观察到一种发表滞后现象：学术论文中报告的结果所生成的AI系统与当前读者合理假设的AI系统之间的差距。我们系统性地从2022年1月1日到2026年4月1日扫描了OpenAlex（n = 112,303个LLM关键词匹配）。然后，我们确定了被评估了哪些模型（n = 18,574个可接受的记录）。接着，我们根据Epoch AI能力指数（ECI）——一个综合LLM能力评分——对每个被评估的LLM与前沿LLM进行排名。在评估时，中位数论文评估的是能力落后于前沿LLM的模型，中位数差距为+10.85 ECI（H1；n = 12,312）。这个差距正在扩大，每年以+5.53 ECI的速度增加（H2，名义95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]）。即使在没有评估日期的插补情况下，这一趋势依然成立。在评估日期明确且相关模型可解析为ECI分数的论文（n = 728）中，H1的中位数差距为+5.01 ECI。只有18.4%的全文论文明确声明了评估日期。校正后，在我们的审计中，52.5%（95% CI：[48.2, 56.9]）的摘要在类别层面（“AI”）而非模型层面陈述了结论。关于推理模型的论文中，只有3.2%的摘要和21.2%的全文文章披露了所用模型的推理模式状态（H4）。我们提出了一种解决方案，该方案由作者、编辑和资助者共同实施。首先，作者的报告。VERSIO-AI v1.2是一个建议的13项清单，用于涵盖此处描述的配置表面。其次，期刊编辑和同行评审员的执行。第三，将资助条件与信息披露挂钩，并提供API访问权限。

articles.title: Proactive for Uncertainty: Cause-Aware Error Diagnosis and Interactive Clarification for Spoken Dialogue Systems
articles.abstract: Cascaded Automatic Speech Recognition - Large Language Model (ASR-LLM) pipelines remain popular for industrial Spoken Dialogue Systems (SDS), primarily because their decoupled design ensures perceptual verifiability. However, cascaded systems suffer from error propagation, as transcription failures inevitably cascade to subsequent components, thereby degrading the final interaction quality. Although ASR confidence scores offer a simple filter for unreliable inputs, this approach is fundamentally limited because it typically fails to detect deletion errors or to distinguish between acoustic (inability to hear clearly) and linguistic (inability to understand) mismatches, both of which require targeted recovery strategies. In this paper, we propose a cause-aware error recovery paradigm that fundamentally rethinks robustness in SDS. Unlike traditional confidence filtering, we introduce a suite of small precision-focused detectors that exploit deep ASR latent representations to disentangle token-level errors into perception, comprehension, and deletion failures. This fine-grained diagnostic intelligence empowers the LLM to orchestrate targeted, multi-turn clarification strategies, effectively transforming ambiguous signals into seamless user interactions. Experimental results validate the precision of our approach, which more than doubles the recall on domain-shift errors (57.96% vs. 23.66%) compared to baselines. Crucially, this diagnostic precision yields up to a 31% reduction in WER and a 19% improvement on the downstream task across diverse accents, distortions, and domains.
articles.titleCn: 面向不确定性的主动式因果错误诊断与交互式澄清对话系统
articles.abstractCn: 级联式自动语音识别-大型语言模型（ASR-LLM）流程在工业语音对话系统（SDS）中仍然流行，主要是因为其解耦设计确保了感知可验证性。然而，级联系统存在错误传播问题，因为转录失败不可避免地会级联到后续组件，从而降低最终交互质量。尽管ASR置信度分数为不可靠输入提供了简单的过滤器，但这种方法从根本上存在局限性，因为它通常无法检测删除错误，也无法区分声学（听不清）和语言（不理解）的不匹配，而这两者都需要有针对性的恢复策略。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于原因的错误恢复范式，从根本上重新思考了SDS中的鲁棒性。与传统的置信度过滤不同，我们引入了一套以精度为中心的小型检测器，利用深度ASR潜在表示将标记级错误分解为感知、理解和删除失败。这种细粒度的诊断智能使LLM能够协调有针对性的多轮澄清策略，有效地将模糊信号转化为无缝的用户交互。实验结果验证了我们的方法的精度，与基线相比，在领域转移错误上的召回率提高了两倍多（57.96% vs. 23.66%）。关键的是，这种诊断精度在多种口音、失真和领域下，将错误率（WER）降低了31%，并将下游任务性能提高了19%。

articles.title: Persona Prompting in Multimodal Urban Perception: Descriptive Convergence and Interpretive Variation
articles.abstract: This study examines how persona prompting shapes language generated by two multimodal large language models in urban perception, a setting for examining subjective interpretations of shared visual evidence. We organize outputs into three functional layers: descriptive grounding (captions), intermediate semantic layer (perception tags), and interpretive framing (justifications). Using approximately 60,000 persona-conditioned annotations from each of two MLLMs, Qwen3-VL and Gemma4, we find that captions converge strongly across persona profiles and show only small attribute-associated differences. Justifications vary substantially more: economic status produces the largest difference in both models, with political orientation and personality also prominent. Paired image-level comparisons confirm larger justification than caption differences for these three attributes. For perception tags, personas sharing the same attribute level produce more similar tag sets than personas with different attribute levels, with the largest separation observed for economic status. Exploratory topic analysis further suggests persona-specific evaluative emphasis. Across models, profile-pair similarity patterns are strongly correlated for all three output types, although agreement is lowest for justifications. Overall, persona prompting affects interpretive framing more strongly than descriptive grounding.
articles.titleCn: 多模态城市感知中的角色提示：描述性趋同与解释性变异
articles.abstractCn: 本研究探讨了角色提示如何影响两种多模态大型语言模型在都市感知场景下生成的语言，该场景用于检验共享视觉证据的主观解释。我们将输出分为三个功能层级：描述性基础（字幕）、中间语义层（感知标签）和解释性框架（理由）。通过对两个MLLM模型Qwen3-VL和Gemma4各自约60,000个角色条件标注进行分析，我们发现字幕在不同角色类型间高度趋同，仅表现出微小的属性相关差异。理由则差异显著：经济地位在两种模型中均产生最大差异，政治倾向和个性特征也较为突出。配对图像级比较证实，这三个属性的理由差异大于字幕差异。对于感知标签，具有相同属性层级的角色产生的标签集比属性层级不同的角色更为相似，其中经济地位的差异最为显著。探索性主题分析进一步表明存在角色特定的评价侧重。跨模型分析显示，所有三种输出类型的配对相似性模式均高度相关，但理由的共识度最低。总体而言，角色提示对解释性框架的影响强于描述性基础。

articles.title: Recovering the Zipfian Distribution in Unsupervised Term Discovery
articles.abstract: Unsupervised term discovery involves segmenting unlabelled speech into word- or syllable-like units and clustering these into a lexicon of candidate types. True lexicons follow a Zipfian distribution, yet the dominant centre-based clustering approach -- K-means -- produces a more uniform distribution due to an inductive bias toward spherical clusters. In this paper we revisit graph-based clustering as a bottom-up alternative, where segment embeddings are connected by pairwise similarity and partitioned using the Leiden algorithm. We show that graph clustering substantially outperforms centre-based approaches (K-means, GMM, BIRCH) in both word- and syllable-level lexicon discovery across three languages, producing more Zipf-like distributions. Another bottom-up approach, agglomerative clustering with average linkage, also performs well, although it is computationally less efficient and allows for less control over the resulting distribution. Our work calls into question the dominance of centre-based clustering for term discovery, and promotes graph clustering as an attractive alternative.
articles.titleCn: 在无监督术语发现中恢复齐夫分布
articles.abstractCn: 无监督术语发现涉及将未标记语音分割成单词或音节类单元，并将这些单元聚类成一个候选类型的词汇表。真实的词汇遵循齐夫分布，但以中心为基础的聚类方法（如K-means）由于倾向于球形簇的归纳偏差，会产生更均匀的分布。在本文中，我们重新审视基于图的聚类作为自底向上的替代方法，其中段嵌入通过成对相似性连接，并使用莱登算法进行划分。我们证明，基于图的聚类在三个语言中，无论是单词级还是音节级词汇发现方面，都显著优于基于中心的方法（K-means、GMM、BIRCH），产生了更接近齐夫分布的分布。另一种自底向上的方法——平均链接的层次聚类——也表现良好，尽管它在计算效率上较低，且对最终分布的控制力较弱。我们的工作质疑了基于中心聚类在术语发现中的主导地位，并推广了基于图的聚类作为一种有吸引力的替代方案。

articles.title: Closing the Quality Gap in Low-Resource Text-to-Speech: LoRA Fine-Tuning of VoxCPM2 for Khmer and Korean
articles.abstract: Large pretrained text-to-speech (TTS) models sound almost human for well-resourced languages, but much worse for languages that are rare in their training data. We study this quality gap for Khmer and Korean using VoxCPM2, a 2.4B parameter, tokenizer-free TTS model that joins a MiniCPM-4 language-model backbone with a flow-matching diffusion decoder. We build one shared, language-tagged corpus of 25.5 hours after cleaning and adapt VoxCPM2 with a single Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter, trained on both languages at once and added to both the language model and the decoder. The adapter is zero-initialized, so training starts exactly at the original zero-shot model. In native-speaker listening tests, the Khmer Mean Opinion Score (MOS) rises from 3.85 to 4.23 with the best adapter, rank 64. This gain is highly significant under a paired Wilcoxon test with p < 0.001, and it is achieved while training only 0.19 to 3.03 percent of the parameters. Two findings stand out. First, the training loss and human ratings disagree on the best rank. The loss is lowest at rank 128, but MOS peaks at rank 64. Second, the same adapter gives no significant gain for Korean, which the base model already covers well, and a high rank even hurts quality. This shows that adaptation helps mainly where the base model is truly weak.
articles.titleCn: 在低资源文本到语音中缩小质量差距：使用LoRA微调VoxCPM2进行高棉语和韩语
articles.abstractCn: 对于资源丰富的语言，大型预训练语音合成（TTS）模型听起来几乎像真人，但对于训练数据中稀有语言，效果则差得多。我们使用VoxCPM2研究高棉语和韩语的质量差距，这是一种拥有24亿参数、无需分词器的TTS模型，它结合了MiniCPM-4语言模型主干和流匹配扩散解码器。在清理后，我们构建了一个25.5小时的共享语言标记语料库，并使用单个低秩适配器（LoRA）适配器对VoxCPM2进行适配，该适配器同时训练两种语言，并添加到语言模型和解码器中。适配器为零初始化，因此训练从原始零样本模型开始。在母语者听感测试中，高棉语平均意见分数（MOS）从3.85提升到4.23，最佳适配器为秩64。在配对Wilcoxon检验中，p值小于0.001，这一提升非常显著，且仅在0.19%到3.03%的参数上进行了训练。有两个发现尤为突出。首先，训练损失和人类评分对最佳秩的判断不一致。损失在秩128时最低，但MOS在秩64时达到峰值。其次，相同的适配器对韩语没有显著提升，因为基础模型已经很好地覆盖了该语言，而且高秩甚至损害了质量。这表明适配器主要帮助的是基础模型真正薄弱的地方。

articles.title: A JoLT for the KV cache: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression via Joint Rank-bit Allocation
articles.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck in long-context language model inference. Existing compression methods apply low-rank factorization or quantization independently, without jointly allocating rank and precision under a shared storage budget. We introduce JoLT, a training-free compressor that treats grouped prefill caches as fourth-order tensors and applies partial Tucker decomposition along the token and feature modes, the two axes that carry low-rank structure, while leaving the head and layer modes intact. A rotated low-bit quantizer captures the truncation residual, and a single Lagrangian dual allocates per-group Tucker ranks and residual bit-widths under a global byte constraint. FlashJoLT replaces the exact token-mode SVD with a randomized approximation that matches JoLT within the free zone at a fraction of the compression cost, and a fused Triton decode kernel evaluates attention directly over the stored factors without materializing dense KV tensors. Across five models from four architecture families, covering multi-head attention, grouped-query attention, and mixture-of-experts architecture, JoLT achieves 2 - 3x compression with less than 0.2% perplexity degradation, without retraining. On RULER at 64K context with LLaMA-3.1-8B, retrieval accuracy remains near-lossless through 3x and declines by only 0.90 and 2.40pp at 4x and 5x, respectively. JoLT demonstrates that tensor-aware low-rank decomposition and quantized residuals, unified under a single storage budget, achieve near-lossless KV-cache compression across diverse model architectures without retraining.

articles.titleCn: 一种用于KV缓存的JoLT：通过联合秩位分配实现近无损KV缓存压缩
articles.abstractCn: 键值（KV）缓存是长上下文语言模型推理中的主要内存瓶颈。现有的压缩方法独立地应用低秩分解或量化，而没有在共享存储预算下联合分配秩和精度。我们引入了JoLT，这是一种无需训练的压缩器，它将分组预填充缓存视为四阶张量，并在承载低秩结构的两个轴（即标记轴和特征轴）上应用部分Tucker分解，同时保留头部和层轴。一个旋转的低比特量化器捕获截断残差，并且一个单一的拉格朗日对偶在全局字节约束下分配每个组的Tucker秩和残差比特宽度。FlashJoLT用随机近似替换了精确的标记模式SVD，该近似在自由区内与JoLT匹配，但压缩成本只是其几分之一，并且一个融合的Triton解码内核直接在存储的因子上评估注意力，而无需实现密集的KV张量。在涵盖多头注意力、分组查询注意力和专家混合架构的四个架构系列的五个模型中，JoLT实现了2-3倍的压缩， perplexity下降小于0.2%，而无需重新训练。在RULER上使用64K上下文和LLaMA-3.1-8B时，检索精度在3倍压缩时仍接近无损，在4倍和5倍压缩时分别下降0.90pp和2.40pp。JoLT证明了张量感知的低秩分解和量化残差在单一存储预算下统一，能够在各种模型架构中实现接近无损的KV缓存压缩，而无需重新训练。

articles.title: An Evaluation Framework for Structured Audio Captions Validated by Controlled Perturbations
articles.abstract: Recent advances in automated audio captioning (AAC) are driving a shift from monolithic sentences toward structured formats that disentangle acoustic and semantic properties, such as timestamped captions for different sound events. Such representations can support faceted sound search for creators and richer access to auditory information for Deaf and Hard of Hearing people. Yet, it remains unclear how to meaningfully evaluate these hybrid, structured captions. We propose an evaluation framework for structured audio descriptions, spanning five complementary axes: tag sets, descriptions, reasoning, numeric measurements, and spectral profiles. The framework combines large language model (LLM) judges for semantic fields with deterministic metrics for temporal and acoustic attributes. To validate these metrics, we introduce controlled perturbations that apply typed, graded changes to ground-truth annotations. Results show that the proposed metrics remain robust to meaning-preserving paraphrases while responding to genuine semantic and acoustic corruptions, enabling more reliable evaluation of structured captions.
articles.titleCn: 一个通过受控扰动验证的结构化音频描述评估框架
articles.abstractCn: 自动化音频字幕（AAC）的最新进展正推动从单一长句转向解耦声学和语义属性的结构化格式，例如为不同声音事件提供带时间戳的字幕。此类表示方式能够支持创作者进行面向方面的声音搜索，并为听障人士提供更丰富的听觉信息获取途径。然而，如何对这些混合型、结构化字幕进行有意义的评估仍不明确。我们提出了一个针对结构化音频描述的评估框架，涵盖五个互补的维度：标签集、描述、推理、数值测量和频谱轮廓。该框架结合了大语言模型（LLM）评判员对语义领域的判断与确定性指标对时间及声学属性的评价。为验证这些指标，我们引入了受控扰动，对基准标注施加类型化、分级的变更。结果表明，所提指标在保持语义不变性的释义中保持稳健，同时能响应真实的语义和声学损坏，从而实现结构化字幕更可靠的评估。

articles.title: CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to extract relations among multiple entities across extended contexts while maintaining consistency across predicted triples. Although large language models (LLMs) show remarkable reasoning capabilities in information extraction, their predictions are typically generated independently for each candidate triple and may violate fundamental relational constraints such as transitivity, symmetry, and functional uniqueness, leading to contradictory and unreliable outputs. We propose CONSISTRE, a unified consistency-aware framework for DocRE that addresses this limitation through two complementary tracks. The first operates at inference time for black-box LLMs, combining constraint-aware prompting, constraint-based verification, and iterative self-reflection to refine predictions without task-specific fine-tuning. The second injects consistency knowledge into smaller open-source models via a knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning pipeline: reasoning traces from a powerful teacher are distilled into a student via supervised fine-tuning, followed by GRPO alignment using a composite reward that jointly optimizes extraction performance and relational consistency. Together, the two tracks cover both API-accessible and locally deployable scenarios under a unified consistency formulation. Experiments on DocRED show that both tracks outperform their baselines, with the inference-time track achieving competitive F1 using off-the-shelf black-box LLMs and the training-time track substantially narrowing the gap between 7--8B open-source models and state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs at a fraction of their inference cost. Ablation studies confirm that explicit consistency modeling mitigates relational contradictions and enhances the reliability of LLM-based DocRE across both deployment paradigms.
articles.titleCn: CONSISTRE：一种用于基于大型语言模型的文档级关系抽取的一致性感知统一框架
articles.abstractCn: 文档级关系抽取（DocRE）旨在从扩展的上下文中提取多个实体之间的关系，同时保持预测三元组的连贯性。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在信息抽取方面展现出卓越的推理能力，但它们的预测通常是针对每个候选三元独立生成的，并可能违反基本的关联约束，如传递性、对称性和功能唯一性，从而导致矛盾且不可靠的输出。我们提出了CONSISTRE，一个用于DocRE的统一一致性感知框架，通过两个互补的路径来解决这一局限性。第一个路径在推理时针对黑盒LLMs，结合约束感知提示、基于约束的验证和迭代自我反思来优化预测，无需特定任务的微调。第二个路径通过知识蒸馏和强化学习管道将一致性知识注入较小的开源模型：强大导师的推理轨迹通过监督微调蒸馏到学生模型中，然后使用复合奖励进行GRPO对齐，该奖励联合优化了抽取性能和关系连贯性。这两个路径在统一的一致性公式下涵盖了API可访问和本地可部署的场景。在DocRED上的实验表明，两个路径均优于其基线，推理时路径使用现成的黑盒LLMs实现了具有竞争力的F1值，训练时路径在极低的推理成本下显著缩小了7-8B开源模型与最先进专有LLMs之间的差距。消融研究证实，显式的一致性建模减轻了关系矛盾，并提高了基于LLMs的DocRE在两种部署范式下的可靠性。

articles.title: Gaokerena: A Small Persian Medical Language Model Family
articles.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into medical question-answering systems has advanced rapidly; however, research remains predominantly focused on English, leaving low-resource languages like Persian significantly underserved. To address this gap, this paper introduces Gaokerena, a novel family of compact Persian medical language models optimized for deployment on consumer-grade hardware. As a foundational step toward localized digital healthcare, we first present Gaokerena-V, developed by training a baseline model on a strategically selected subset of a newly curated 90-million-token Persian medical corpus (approximately 54 million tokens) together with 20,000 expert-vetted physician Q&A pairs (approximately 3 million tokens), for a total of 57 million new tokens. This training improved performance on a translated medical MMLU benchmark from 46.64% to 49.31%. Second, recognizing the critical demands of clinical reasoning, we developed Gaokerena-R by integrating a Chain-of-Thought approach with two novel Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback (RLAIF) frameworks to optimize preference-based reasoning. Despite utilizing the same baseline architecture and a smaller dataset than Gaokerena-V, Gaokerena-R achieved a superior benchmark score of 52.98%. Furthermore, both models are equipped with custom-developed uncertainty heads that predict the models confidence in its responses based solely on internal hidden states. While these results demonstrate significant progress in Persian medical language modeling and proactive safety estimation, current performance levels remain insufficient for direct clinical application, highlighting the necessity for further research into robust knowledge acquisition and rigorous safety verification prior to real-world deployment.
articles.titleCn: 高克雷纳：一个小型波斯医学语言模型家族
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能在医疗问答系统中的集成发展迅速；然而，研究仍主要集中于英语，导致像波斯语这样的低资源语言服务严重不足。为填补这一空白，本文介绍了Gaokerena，一个专为消费级硬件部署而优化的紧凑型波斯医疗语言模型家族。作为本地化数字医疗保健的基础步骤，我们首先介绍了Gaokerena-V，该模型通过在战略性地选择的、新整理的9000万token波斯医疗语料库子集（约5400万token）以及20000对专家审核的医生问答对（约300万token）上训练基线模型而开发，总共新增了5700万token。这项训练将翻译后的医疗MMLU基准测试性能从46.64%提升至49.31%。其次，鉴于临床推理的关键需求，我们通过整合思维链方法与两个新型人工智能反馈强化学习（RLAIF）框架来优化基于偏好的推理，开发了Gaokerena-R。尽管Gaokerena-R使用相同的基线架构且数据集规模小于Gaokerena-V，但其达到了52.98%的卓越基准分数。此外，这两个模型都配备了定制开发的不确定性头，这些头仅基于内部隐藏状态预测模型对其回答的置信度。虽然这些结果展示了波斯医疗语言建模和主动安全估计方面的显著进展，但当前的性能水平仍不足以直接用于临床应用，凸显了在真实世界部署前，进一步研究稳健知识获取和严格安全验证的必要性。

articles.title: Wiring Beats Blending: Structure-Aware Compensation for Transformer Downscaling
articles.abstract: Model families are trained size by size. Can a pretrained large model instead be converted into a smaller sibling? We study the 1.4B->410M conversion in Pythia end to end. Representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84); parameters align weakly. Dense weight projection is destructive; a bit-exact control places the fault in basis mixing, which breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure. Residuals after the best-fit linear operator carry no learnable or transferable signal under shuffle controls, so conversion value lives in initialization. Matched-budget continued pre-training separates two independent levers: least-squares compensation (function lever, best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics lever, best endpoints). Placement follows the architecture: compensation is well-posed exactly where no normalization sits between cut and read; norm-fronted paths take rescale. Compensation is a low-budget, token-efficiency win, not a universal one. At 30M tokens it beats the best subcloning variant on a width-reduced pair (84.0+-1.8 vs. 89.7+-3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9, 3/3 seeds). Selection given the same activation statistics recovers under half of that gap (3/3 seeds): the gain is the re-fit, not the information. At 33x the budget the two reach parity (40.3+-0.3 vs. 40.3+-0.5, 3 seeds), both far ahead of from-scratch, which transfer always beats (up to 18x at low budget, narrowing at convergence and at the largest scale). At ~5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both levers over-corrects, consistent with an ill-conditioned compensation solve at large width, pointing to dimension-aware regularization as a fix. The init also beats structured pruning plus distillation, the standard pipeline, at matched budget, and improves further combined with it. Code, checkpoints, and the frozen eval corpus are released.

articles.titleCn: 感知结构补偿的Transformer下采样：布线优于混合
articles.abstractCn: 模型家族逐个尺寸进行训练。预训练的大型模型能否转换为更小的兄弟模型？我们在Pythia中端到端研究了1.4B->410M的转换。不同尺寸间的表示高度对齐（岭回归R^2=0.84），参数对齐较弱。密集权重投影具有破坏性；精确的比特控制将错误置于基混合中，这会破坏旋转、按头、GELU和LayerNorm结构。在最佳拟合线性算子后的残差在洗牌控制下不包含可学习或可迁移的信号，因此转换价值存在于初始化中。匹配预算的持续预训练分离了两个独立的杠杆：最小二乘补偿（函数杠杆，最佳零样本）和方差保持重缩放（动态杠杆，最佳端点）。放置遵循架构：补偿在切割和读取之间没有归一化操作的地方表现良好；归一化前导路径采用重缩放。补偿是一种低预算、按token效率的胜利，而非普适性胜利。在30M tokens时，它在宽度减少的对（84.0+-1.8 vs. 89.7+-3.7，3/3种子）和保留的深度减少的对（109.3 vs. 117.9，3/3种子）上优于最佳子克隆变体。在相同激活统计下选择可恢复其中一半的差距（3/3种子）：收益是重新拟合，而非信息。在预算的33倍时，两者达到平手（40.3+-0.3 vs. 40.3+-0.5，3种子），两者都远超从头开始，后者总是优于前者（在低预算时最高18倍，在收敛和最大规模时逐渐缩小）。在约5倍的供体规模（6.9B->1.4B）时，叠加这两个杠杆过度校正，这与在大宽度下补偿求解不良条件一致，指向维度感知正则化作为解决方案。初始化在匹配预算时也优于结构化剪枝加蒸馏，这是标准流程，并且结合它时进一步改进。代码、检查点和冻结的评估语料库已发布。

articles.title: Q-CueGraph: Query-Conditioned Visual Evidence Graphs for Multimodal Reasoning
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can miss fine details in a full image that they recognize in a closer view. Recovering this evidence requires deciding where to look and how much surrounding context to retain. We present Q-CueGraph, a query-conditioned evidence acquisition method for frozen MLLMs. For text-rich images, it builds a reusable graph of OCR lines and layout relations. Each question activates anchors, expands them into contextual regions, and selects candidates for a single observation window. Query-conditioned object detections support natural-image search through the same region-selection and composition interface. A lightweight candidate scorer further learns which observations support correct answers from frozen-reader feedback and training answers, without evidence-box supervision. Across six benchmarks, we examine the roles of query conditioning, evidence composition, and learned answerability. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Q-CueGraph raises V*Bench accuracy from 0.696 to 0.832 using 19.1% of source-image area, and retains 92% of full-image ANLS on InfographicVQA using about half the image area. The analyses show that useful evidence depends on both its relevance to the question and the context available to the reader. Q-CueGraph makes these choices explicit before answer generation.
articles.titleCn: Q-CueGraph：用于多模态推理的查询条件视觉证据图
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在近距离观察时可能会忽略全图中它们所识别的细节。恢复这些证据需要决定在哪里寻找以及保留多少周边上下文。我们提出了Q-CueGraph，这是一种用于冻结MLLMs的查询条件证据获取方法。对于文本丰富的图像，它构建了一个可重用的OCR行和布局关系的图。每个问题都会激活锚点，将它们扩展为上下文区域，并选择单个观察窗口的候选对象。查询条件的目标检测通过相同的区域选择和组合界面支持自然图像搜索。一个轻量级的候选评分器进一步从冻结阅读器反馈和训练答案中学习哪些观察支持正确答案，而无需证据框监督。在六个基准测试中，我们考察了查询条件、证据组合和学习答案性的作用。使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B，Q-CueGraph将V*Bench准确率从0.696提高到0.832，仅使用了19.1%的源图像区域，并在InfographicVQA上保留了92%的全图ANLS，仅使用了约一半的图像区域。分析表明，有用的证据不仅取决于其与问题的相关性，还取决于读者可用的上下文。Q-CueGraph在生成答案之前就明确了这些选择。

articles.title: Reflex-Guard: A Low-Latency Guardrail for LLM Prompt Safety Using Dense Semantic Embeddings
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications often face the risks of specially crafted prompts designed to bypass the safety controls. Existing guardrail methods, such as LLM-as-a-judge and cloud-based safety APIs are able to detect unsafe content. However, they often add a delay of about 250-900 ms to each request. This delay is too high for real-time applications, when the system usually needs to respond in less than 100 ms. Furthermore, routing user prompts through external moderation endpoints raises significant data privacy concerns. This paper introduces Reflex-Guard, a lightweight guardrail that runs locally. It uses jailbreak-aware preprocessing, compact sentence-transformer embeddings, and seven fast binary classifiers. Together, these components enable high-accuracy prompt safety filtering with much lower latency than existing solutions. Through systematic evaluation on a strategically balanced dataset of 30,568 samples drawn from five complementary sources, we demonstrate that Reflex-Guard achieves 95.9% recall on harmful prompts at 37.6 ms end-to-end latency. It is faster than existing baselines, including Llama Guard 2 at 255 ms and SafeDecoding at 723 ms. It can detect 100% of GCG suffix attacks and Base64-encoded prompts using the default threshold. However, DrAttack structured prompts required lowering the threshold to 0.03 for optimal detection, as they produced a distinct probability distribution. Reflex-Guard achieves Reflex Efficiency Score (RES) scores up to 16.79, significantly outperforming Llama Guard 2 (11.90) and SafeDecoding (9.80). This analysis offers practical deployment advice and shows that different attack types occupy distinct regions in the embedding probability space.
articles.titleCn: 反射防护栏：基于密集语义嵌入的低延迟LLM提示安全防护措施
articles.abstractCn: 在实际应用中，大型语言模型（LLMs）常常面临专门设计的提示所带来的绕过安全控制的风险。现有的防护措施，如将LLM作为裁判和基于云的安全API，能够检测不安全内容。然而，它们通常会给每个请求增加约250-900毫秒的延迟。这种延迟对于实时应用来说过高，因为系统通常需要在100毫秒以内做出响应。此外，通过外部审核端点路由用户提示会引发严重的数据隐私问题。本文介绍了Reflex-Guard，一种轻量级的本地运行防护措施。它采用针对越狱攻击的预处理、紧凑的句子转换器嵌入和七个快速二分类器。这些组件共同实现了比现有解决方案更低延迟的高精度提示安全过滤。通过对一个由五个互补来源抽取的、策略性平衡的30,568样本数据集进行系统性评估，我们证明Reflex-Guard在37.6毫秒端到端延迟下，对有害提示的召回率达到95.9%。它比现有基线更快，包括Llama Guard 2（255毫秒）和SafeDecoding（723毫秒）。它能够使用默认阈值检测100%的GCG后缀攻击和Base64编码提示。然而，DrAttack结构化提示需要将阈值降低到0.03才能实现最佳检测，因为它们产生了独特的概率分布。Reflex-Guard实现了高达16.79的Reflex效率评分（RES），显著优于Llama Guard 2（11.90）和SafeDecoding（9.80）。这项分析提供了实用的部署建议，并表明不同攻击类型在嵌入概率空间中占据不同的区域。

articles.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
articles.abstract: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183 candidates realise only 96 distinct behaviours, from one narrow region of an enormous space. EvalCEGAR instead borrows counterexample-guided abstraction refinement from program verification. It reads the pool as an abstraction and searches for a collision, two answers the operators score identically, one correct and one not. That pair, not a prompt, is the authoring request, and when a collision defeats every attempt the loop widens what an operator may read rather than resampling. On MBPP+ and HumanEval+, a sandbox whose hidden unit tests give exact ground truth, the loop writes a 55-line operator that closes 15.4% of the gap between flagging nothing and a perfect filter on 428 unseen tasks (+0.0065, p=0.0010) at a quarter of our best hand-written operator's flags. On the benchmark it never saw it matches that operator's effect exactly on a third of the flags. Six of eight runs admit such an operator and all six help out of sample; our 15 hand-written operators applied together as one filter lose accuracy. An LLM judge on the same information ties that delta on a nearly disjoint set of candidates, and charges a model call per candidate forever where the operator charges none.

articles.titleCn: 自我书写的指标：从自身的盲点进化出一个评估器
articles.abstractCn: 代理在可靠的自动指标面前快速改进，而在没有指标的情况下则停滞不前，而最需要这些代理的应用，如报告生成，却是那些无人知晓如何评分的领域。指标能否自我编写？说明一个答案为何优秀很难，指出一个答案的错误则容易得多，因此我们进化出的指标是一个包含小型Python操作符的集合，每个操作符标记一个候选答案的特定缺陷，或弃权，并进行投票。直接向模型索要操作符并不奏效：183个候选者仅表现出96种不同的行为，这些行为来自一个巨大空间中的狭窄区域。EvalCEGAR则借鉴了程序验证中的反例引导抽象精炼方法。它将操作符集合视为一个抽象概念，并搜索冲突，即两个操作符评分完全相同的答案，其中一个正确，一个错误。这对答案，而非提示，才是创作请求，当冲突击败所有尝试时，循环会扩展操作符可能读取的内容，而不是重新采样。在MBPP+和HumanEval+上，这是一个隐藏单元测试提供精确真实值的沙盒，循环编写了一个55行的操作符，在428个未见过的任务上，从标记空白到完美过滤缩小了15.4%的差距（+0.0065，p=0.0010），仅占我们最佳手写操作符标记的四分之一。在基准测试上，它从未见过这个操作符，但在三分之一的情况下与操作符的效果完全匹配。八次运行中有六次承认这样的操作符，并且这六次都在样本外提供了帮助；我们15个手写操作符结合为一个过滤器时反而降低了准确性。在相同信息上的LLM裁判在几乎不重叠的候选集上打出了相同的差距，并且对每个候选者永久调用模型，而操作符则无需任何调用成本。

articles.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Self-Evolution from Zero Data
articles.abstract: Self-evolving language models have recently emerged as a promising path toward superintelligence, with the advantage of reducing the cost of human supervision. While considerable progress has been made in verifiable domains, self-evolution in unverifiable domains remains less explored. We propose Judge co-adaptation from Zero data (J-Zero), a unified Challenger--Solver--Judge self-evolution framework that supports self-improvement across both domains. The Challenger and Solver co-evolve through an adversarial interaction: the Challenger generates increasingly difficult tasks, while the Solver learns to produce higher-quality responses to them. In parallel, the Judge co-adapts using preference pairs whose ordering is known in advance from how each response was produced, i.e., the Solver's answer over the Challenger's, and the Solver's decomposed-and-recombined answer over its one-shot answer, rather than from the Judge's own scores. J-Zero outperforms the baselines by an average of 4.2 points on verifiable and 8.0 points on unverifiable domains, and continues to improve through at least ten iterations, whereas the baselines degrade after two. Further analysis identifies Judge co-adaptation as the key driver of this sustained improvement.
articles.titleCn: J-Zero：从零数据开始的统一挑战者-求解器-裁判自我进化
articles.abstractCn: 自进化语言模型近期已成为通往超级智能的可行路径，其优势在于降低人类监督成本。尽管在可验证领域已取得显著进展，但在不可验证领域的自进化仍较少探索。我们提出了从零数据判别协同适应（J-Zero）方法，这是一个统一的挑战者-求解者-判别者自进化框架，支持跨领域自我改进。挑战者和求解者通过对抗性交互共同进化：挑战者生成难度递增的任务，而求解者学习生成更高质量的对应对答。与此同时，判别者使用偏好对进行协同适应，这些偏好的排序事先已知，即根据每个对答应答的产生方式，例如求解者的答案优于挑战者的答案，以及求解者分解重组后的答案优于其一次性答案，而非来自判别者自身的评分。J-Zero在可验证领域平均优于基线4.2分，在不可验证领域平均优于基线8.0分，并且至少经过十次迭代仍持续改进，而基线在两次迭代后开始退化。进一步分析表明，判别者协同适应是这种持续改进的关键驱动力。

articles.title: Calibration is the Bottleneck: An Action-Class Diagnostic of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling
articles.abstract: Multi-turn tool calling is a core evaluation scenario for large language model (LLM) agents. On public tool-calling benchmarks, open-weight models now approach or even surpass closed-source frontier models in aggregate accuracy. However, this metric averages over many different multi-turn situations and obscures whether progress is balanced across them. We propose an action-class-oriented diagnostic framework that decomposes multi-turn failures into two orthogonal modes: action-class miscalibration and action-execution failure. The framework operates over a four-class action space (TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM) and introduces a self-revealing upper bound Acc <= GAR (Gold Action Recall); the two modes show up as bound violation (Acc > GAR, exposing state-grader masking of miscalibration) and large bound slack (GAR >> Acc, localizing execution failure within TOOL_CALL). We validate it on a panel of tool-calling models across multiple multi-turn benchmarks. Across our panel, the diagnostic reveals action-class miscalibration as a substantial failure mode the state grader cannot see. This gap inflates standing for heavily tool-trained families, which our diagnostic separates from families with context-appropriate action choice. Calibration is reshapable through context-only perturbations, but the reshape is heterogeneous: a single perturbation moves accuracy in opposite directions across families (up to +11.5 vs -21.0 pp on the same scenario), and its effect further depends on the perturbation mechanism. We argue that multi-turn tool-calling evaluations should supplement aggregate accuracy with action-class diagnostics that expose what the model actually does in each scenario.

articles.titleCn: 校准是瓶颈：多轮工具调用的动作类诊断
articles.abstractCn: 多轮工具调用是大语言模型（LLM）代理的核心评估场景。在公开的工具调用基准测试中，开放权重模型现在在总体准确率上已经接近甚至超越了闭源前沿模型。然而，这一指标将多种不同的多轮情况平均化，掩盖了进展是否在这些情况中均衡。我们提出了一种以动作类别为导向的诊断框架，将多轮失败分解为两种正交模式：动作类别误校准和动作执行失败。该框架作用于一个包含四个类别的动作空间（TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM），并引入了一个自我揭示的上限Acc <= GAR（黄金动作召回率）；这两种模式表现为上限违规（Acc > GAR，暴露了状态评分器对误校准的遮蔽）和较大的上限松弛（GAR >> Acc，将执行失败定位在TOOL_CALL内）。我们在多个多轮基准测试中的一组工具调用模型上验证了该框架。在我们的模型组中，诊断揭示动作类别误校准是一种状态评分器无法察觉的重大失败模式。这种差距使得经过大量工具训练的模型组表现被夸大，而我们的诊断能够将它们与选择恰当动作类别的模型组区分开来。校准可以通过仅对上下文进行扰动来重塑，但这种重塑是异质的：单个扰动会在不同模型组中导致准确率向相反方向变化（在同一场景下最高上升11.5个基点，最低下降21.0个基点），并且其效果还取决于扰动机制。我们认为，多轮工具调用评估应补充总体准确率，加入动作类别诊断，以揭示模型在每个场景中的实际行为。

articles.title: Combating Instruction Conflict via Energy-Driven Latent Conflict Detection
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with hierarchical instructions, yet they remain vulnerable to conflicts in which user directives override system-level constraints. Existing defense mechanisms predominantly focus on static input inspection and therefore fail to detect Response Drift, a phenomenon in which the model's final response violates system-level constraints despite seemingly compliant inputs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ELCD, a response-level latent conflict detector for post-generation, pre-delivery verification. Given the full generated output, ELCD constructs a composite hidden-state representation by concatenating the final-token embedding with the mean-pooled response embedding. It then optimizes a pairwise margin ranking objective to separate compliant and drifting responses in latent space. Extensive experiments across five mainstream LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters demonstrate that ELCD significantly outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, it improves the PR-AUC on Llama-2-7B by approximately 30 percentage points and reduces the False Positive Rate at 95% TPR (FPR95) on Mistral-7B to 2.67%. These results suggest that ELCD provides a promising approach for latent instruction-conflict detection in open-weight or self-hosted LLM deployments.

articles.titleCn: 通过能量驱动潜在冲突检测来对抗指令冲突
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地部署了分层指令，但它们仍然容易受到用户指令覆盖系统级约束的冲突影响。现有的防御机制主要集中于静态输入检查，因此无法检测到响应漂移现象——即模型最终响应违反系统级约束，尽管输入看似合规。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了ELCD，这是一种用于生成后、交付前验证的响应级潜在冲突检测器。给定完整的生成输出，ELCD通过将最终标记嵌入与响应嵌入的均值池化结果拼接，构建一个复合隐状态表示。然后，它优化一个成对边际排序目标，以在隐空间中分离合规和漂移响应。在五个主流LLM（参数范围从1.5B到14B）上的大量实验表明，ELCD显著优于有竞争力的基线。值得注意的是，它在Llama-2-7B上将PR-AUC提高了约30个百分点，并将Mistral-7B在95% TPR（FPR95）下的假阳性率降低至2.67%。这些结果表明，ELCD为开放权重或自托管LLM部署中的潜在指令冲突检测提供了一种有前景的方法。

articles.title: Human Agreement and Return Association Are Not Interchangeable Criteria
articles.abstract: Financial NLP has a standard workflow: validate a sentiment tool against human labels, then trust it to extract market signal. This assumes the two evaluations measure the same thing. We test that assumption in a setting where both can be measured at once: a corpus of securities class actions (2002-2025) linking 70,500 X messages to abnormal stock returns, with a single-annotator human labelled gold sample. Running five instruments (VADER, Loughran-McDonald, FinBERT, Twitter-RoBERTa, and an LLM annotator) through one identical pipeline, we find that the relationship between construct and predictive validity depends on the sampling convention and score representation. Under conventional method-specific sampling, human agreement aligns more closely with graded same-day associations than with one-day leads. On a fixed-n panel, however, agreement has similar graded rank correlations at both horizons, while the coarse ordering remains weak. Benchmark agreement therefore establishes semantic validity but does not by itself determine predictive rankings. In a conversation that is 17.6% spam, message volume predicts neither market damage nor settlement size.
articles.titleCn: 人类协议与回归协会并非可互换标准
articles.abstractCn: 金融自然语言处理有一个标准的流程：先验证情感分析工具与人类标注的一致性，然后信任该工具来提取市场信号。这假设两种评估衡量的是同一事物。我们在一个两者都可以同时测量的环境中测试这一假设：一个包含2002-2025年证券集体诉讼语料库（将70,500条X消息与异常股票回报关联起来），并使用单一标注者的人类标注黄金样本。通过让五种工具（VADER、Loughran-McDonald、FinBERT、Twitter-RoBERTa以及一个LLM标注者）运行相同的流程，我们发现构念与预测效度之间的关系取决于抽样惯例和分数表示方式。在常规方法特定的抽样下，人类共识与同日分级关联性更为一致，而非单日领先指标。然而在固定面板上，共识在两个时间范围内的分级相关系数相似，但粗略排序仍然较弱。基准共识因此确立了语义效度，但本身并不能决定预测排名。在一个17.6%是垃圾信息的对话中，消息量既不能预测市场损害，也不能预测和解金额。

articles.title: DuplexDrama: A Synthesized Dialogue Dataset with Scenarios, Full-Duplex Behaviors, Expressive Speech, and Sound Events
articles.abstract: We present DuplexDrama, the first synthesized spoken dialogue dataset that simultaneously covers four dimensions: (i) complete persona and scenario settings; (ii) three full-duplex behaviors (interruption, backchannel, incomplete); (iii) expressive speech with persona-aligned emotion labels; and (iv) script-aware sound events. DuplexDrama is built via a 4-stage pipeline; quality validation on both scripts and synthesized audio confirms its quality. We have produced more than 2,000 hours audio data with a 64-voice timbre pool spanning 13 personas and 5 age buckets; 3.8% of all turns carry at least one full-duplex behavior. This data has been validated through internal full-duplex model training. We will release a curated subset of 6,400 bilingual dialogues (800 h, Chinese ~500 h + English ~300 h) to advance full-duplex spoken dialogue model research. Data samples are available at our demo page and LLM-judge evaluation prompts will be released with the dataset.
articles.titleCn: 双工戏剧：一个包含场景、全双工行为、表现性语音和声音事件的合成对话数据集
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了DuplexDrama，这是首个同时涵盖四个维度的合成语音对话数据集：(i) 完整的角色和场景设置；(ii) 三种全双工行为（打断、反馈、不完整）；(iii) 与角色情绪标签对齐的表达性语音；(iv) 脚本感知的声音事件。DuplexDrama通过四阶段流程构建而成；对脚本和合成音频的质量验证确认了其质量。我们已生成超过2,000小时音频数据，包含64种音色库，涵盖13个角色和5个年龄组；其中3.8%的对话回合至少包含一种全双工行为。该数据已通过内部全双工模型训练验证。我们将发布一个精选的6,400个双语对话子集（800小时，中文约500小时+英语约300小时），以推动全双工语音对话模型研究。数据样本可在我们的演示页面获取，并将随数据集发布LLM-judge评估提示。

articles.title: How broad is that claim? Mapping Generalisation in NLP Research
articles.abstract: Generalisations are common in scientific communication, even though they are semantically ambiguous. An automated method is needed to identify and categorise claims according to their level of generalisation, in order help detect an over-reliance on generalisations and possible misrepresentations of scientific findings. We introduce a comprehensive taxonomy of generalisations in the scientific domain, NLPGenX, which labels claims according to their level of generality and framing within the text. We operationalise this taxonomy with an LLM-powered framework, NLPGenA, that automatically classifies sentences from scientific articles into 5 different generalisation classes. We validate our framework with human annotators and use the framework to construct a large-scale dataset of NLP papers annotated according to generality, with auxiliary labels for hedging and vague descriptors (NLPGens). We use NLPGens to analyse the use of generalisations in NLP papers across multiple venues and subdomains, and to examine associations with citation counts, hedging, and vague descriptors.

articles.titleCn: 这一主张有多广泛？自然语言处理研究中的泛化映射
articles.abstractCn: 在科学交流中，泛化现象很常见，尽管它们在语义上具有模糊性。需要一种自动化方法来识别和根据泛化程度对论断进行分类，以帮助检测对泛化的过度依赖以及科学发现的可能误述。我们介绍了一个科学领域的泛化综合分类法NLPGenX，该分类法根据论断的普遍程度和文本中的框架对论断进行标记。我们使用由大型语言模型驱动的框架NLPGenA将此分类法具体化，该框架自动将科学文章中的句子分类为5个不同的泛化类别。我们通过人工标注者验证了我们的框架，并使用该框架构建了一个大规模的NLP论文数据集NLPGens，该数据集根据普遍程度进行标注，并包含辅助的犹豫和模糊描述标签。我们使用NLPGens分析了多个会议和子领域NLP论文中泛化的使用情况，并检查了其与引用次数、犹豫和模糊描述之间的关联。

articles.title: Same Words, Different Actions: Paired Turn-Taking Evaluation under Rewritten Dialogue Contexts
articles.abstract: Real-time spoken dialogue systems must distinguish interruptions that require yielding the floor from backchannels that permit continued speaking. Existing benchmarks typically score events independently and may therefore assign high scores to systems with fixed action preferences rather than context-sensitive decision policies. We introduce ECHO, a paired diagnostic benchmark for Chinese turn-taking evaluation. ECHO pairs examples with the same overlap transcript but contrasting preceding multi-turn dialogue contexts, with one requiring Yield and the other Keep. It additionally includes off-talk examples for diagnosing unnecessary yielding. We introduce pair accuracy, which requires correct decisions on both members of a pair and assigns no credit to constant-action policies. Experiments on four speech systems show that three exhibit a severe over-yielding bias: they correctly keep the floor on fewer than 13% of backchannels, resulting in near-zero pairwise success rates equal or less than 4%. While the remaining system remains comparatively balanced across contexts, these findings broadly demonstrate that interruption-only evaluation can severely overestimate practical turn-taking reliability.
articles.titleCn: 同词异行：重写对话情境下的配对轮流评估
articles.abstractCn: 实时语音对话系统必须区分需要让出话语权的中断与允许继续发言的反馈信号。现有基准通常独立评分事件，因此可能会给具有固定动作偏好的系统而非上下文敏感决策策略分配高分。我们引入ECHO，一个用于中文轮流发言评估的配对诊断基准。ECHO将具有相同重叠文本但具有对比先前多轮对话上下文的示例配对，其中一个需要"让出"，另一个需要"保持"。它还包括非发言示例，用于诊断不必要的让出。我们引入了配对准确率，要求对配对中的两个成员做出正确决策，并且不给固定动作策略任何分数。在四个语音系统上的实验表明，其中三个表现出严重的过度让出偏见：它们在反馈信号中正确保持话语权的情况少于13%，导致配对成功率接近零，等于或低于4%。而剩余的系统在各个上下文中保持相对平衡，这些发现广泛表明，仅评估中断可能会严重高估实际轮流发言的可靠性。

articles.title: How Many Humans Are 32 LLM Judges Worth?
articles.abstract: A panel's human-equivalent size is target-specific. Matching a fixed 32-judge panel to empirical human label distributions on three ChaosNLI tasks yields two distinct effective sizes: distributional-error matching gives $ν_{\mathrm{MSE}}=2.304$, $3.750$, and $3.445$, whereas spectral matching gives $ν_H=4.242$, $6.459$, and $6.499$, a gap of $1.72$--$1.89\times$; a binary-error diagnostic credits the same panels with only $1.971$--$2.227$ effective votes. Extrapolating the distributional-error curve at fixed squared mean residual, mean member variance, and normalized mean covariance gives asymptotes of $2.392$, $3.990$, and $3.655$, with 32 judges already reaching $94.0$--$96.3\%$. An exact spectral identity explains the gap: error depends on member energy and on the orientation of residual variation relative to averaging, information that the participation ratio (PR) discards. A realizable hard-label construction confirms that higher spectral diversity can coexist with worse distribution recovery even under equal member energies and nonnegative correlations, and the consensus direction retains $γ_{\mathrm{co}}=43.8\%$, $33.7\%$, and $35.9\%$ of centered residual variance. An external check on CC-1000, a 1,000-item Civil Comments subset with a different panel, gives $ν_H=2.84$. For panel choice, we establish an existence result and one feasible path: exhaustive enumeration at $k\in\{5,7\}$ shows that panels beating the accuracy-top-$k$ baseline on both accuracy and $ν_H$ always exist, and greedily swapping at most two members reaches $24.8$--$56.0\%$ higher $ν_H$ at $0.10$--$1.10$ percentage points higher accuracy. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Chao1208/32judges-votes.
