articles.titleCn: 32个LLM裁判值多少人类？
articles.abstractCn: 一个小组的人类等效规模是目标特定的。将一个固定的32人裁判小组与三个ChaosNLI任务中的经验人类标签分布进行匹配，会产生两种不同的有效规模：分布误差匹配给出$ν_{\mathrm{MSE}}=2.304$、$3.750$和$3.445$，而频谱匹配给出$ν_H=4.242$、$6.459$和$6.499$，差距为$1.72$--$1.89$倍；二元误差诊断则将这些小组的有效投票数归为$1.971$--$2.227$。在固定的均方残差、成员均值方差和归一化均值协方差下，外推分布误差曲线的渐近线为$2.392$、$3.990$和$3.655$，而32位裁判已经达到了$94.0$--$96.3\%$。一个精确的频谱一致性解释了这一差距：误差取决于成员能量，以及残差变化方向相对于平均的方向，而参与率（PR）会忽略这些信息。一个可实现的硬标签构造证实，即使在成员能量相等和非负相关的情况下，更高的频谱多样性也可能伴随着更差的分布恢复，共识方向保留了$γ_{\mathrm{co}}=43.8\%$、$33.7\%$和$35.9\%$的居中残差方差。对CC-1000（一个包含1000项Civil Comments子集，且具有不同裁判小组）的外部检查给出$ν_H=2.84$。对于小组选择，我们建立了一个存在性结果和一个可行路径：在$k\in\{5,7\}$中的穷举枚举表明，在准确性和$ν_H$上均优于准确率前$k$的基线的裁判小组总是存在的，而贪婪地最多交换两个成员可以在准确率提高$0.10$--$1.10$个百分点的同时，使$ν_H$提高$24.8$--$56.0\%$。我们的数据集和代码可在https://github.com/Chao1208/32judges-votes获取。

articles.title: LLMs Anchor on Chief Complaint and Fail to Integrate Evidence in Sequential Clinical Triage
articles.abstract: Triage in the emergency department (ED) is a sequential decision process that unfolds turn by turn. Existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for triage use completed retrospective records and report performance close to that of physicians. We implement a methodology for evaluating LLMs on sequential triage, the task of predicting a triage acuity label from a growing prefix of a nurse-patient conversation. We evaluate six LLMs at five sequential checkpoints on two corpora: 425 LLM-generated (SIMULATED) and 50 physician-authored (CLINICIAN) conversations, both labelled under the Emergency Severity Index (ESI). Every model, measured by quadratic weighted kappa (QWK), degrades from moderate-to-substantial agreement on completed records to fair-to-moderate agreement at every sequential checkpoint. Controlled perturbations show that the label at every checkpoint is anchored on the chief complaint exchanges, and prompting interventions fail to lift this plateau. Models extract clinically relevant content from later turns, yet the surprisal of the true label rises across the checkpoints. So the model fails to integrate the evidence. Three expert clinicians on the same conversations reach a QWK of 0.887-0.929, while the best model reaches 0.295. Predictions concentrate at ESI-2 and ESI-3, and models agree with each other more than with the ground truth, so ensembling worsens the failure. Deploying LLMs for ED triage based on offline benchmarks alone misses this sequential failure.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型主要基于主诉进行锚定，并在顺序临床分诊中未能整合证据
articles.abstractCn: 急诊科的分诊是一个逐步展开的决策过程。现有的对大型语言模型（LLM）在分诊中的评估使用回顾性记录完成，并报告其性能接近医生。我们实现了一种评估LLM在顺序分诊中的方法，即从护士与患者对话不断增长的prefix中预测分诊严重程度标签的任务。我们在两个语料库上评估了六个LLM在五个顺序检查点上的表现：425个LLM生成的（模拟）和50个医生撰写的（临床）对话，均根据急诊严重指数（ESI）进行标注。每个模型通过二次加权kappa（QWK）衡量，从完成记录的中等到重大程度的一致性下降到每个顺序检查点上的尚可到中等程度的一致性。受控扰动表明，每个检查点的标签都基于主要症状交流，而提示干预未能提升这一平台。模型从后继回合中提取了临床相关内容，但真实标签的意外性在检查点间上升。因此，模型未能整合证据。三位专家临床医生在相同的对话上达到了0.887-0.929的QWK，而最佳模型的QWK仅为0.295。预测集中在ESI-2和ESI-3，模型之间比与真实情况更一致，因此集成反而加剧了这一失败。仅基于离线基准在急诊科分诊中部署LLM会忽略这一顺序失败。

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime: Towards Reliable Agentic Voice Interaction
articles.abstract: Real-time voice assistants must reason over evolving requests, execute actions, and follow conversational rules. Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime brings these requirements together through Think, Act, and Speak and Coordinate. Think combines Core-Cocktail supervised fine-tuning with Multimodality and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (M$^{2}$-OPD) to transfer language capabilities and develop native audio skills. Act uses self-evolving executable environments and multi-granularity rollouts for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), teaching the model to use tools, interpret feedback, and complete tasks. Speak and Coordinate aligns whether, when, and how the assistant speaks or acts. We evaluate audio reasoning, multilingual understanding, tool use, conversational behavior, full-duplex interaction, and safety. Compared with Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime, 3.1 raises overall task success from 78.4% to 82.0% on our half-duplex speech-to-text adaptation of $τ$-Voice. On speech-to-speech Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5, the response rate to background speech falls from 73.0% to 13.0%. We also present a separate Voice Harness prototype, using Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime as its foreground, that extends spoken interaction to persistent tasks through foreground--background coordination and memory.
articles.titleCn: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime：迈向可靠的智能语音交互
articles.abstractCn: 实时语音助手必须对不断变化的请求进行推理、执行操作并遵循对话规则。Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime通过“思考、行动、说话和协调”将这些要求结合起来。思考结合了核心鸡尾酒监督微调、多模态和多导师在线策略蒸馏（M$^{2}$-OPD），以迁移语言能力并发展原生音频技能。行动使用自进化可执行环境和多粒度滚动更新，用于群体相对策略优化（GRPO），教会模型使用工具、解释反馈并完成任务。说话和协调则对助手何时、以何种方式说话或行动进行对齐。我们评估了音频推理、多语言理解、工具使用、对话行为、全双工交互和安全性。与Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime相比，3.1将τ-Voice半双工语音转文本适应的整体任务成功率从78.4%提高到82.0%。在语音转语音全双工基准v1.5上，对背景语音的响应率从73.0%降至13.0%。我们还展示了一个独立的语音驱动原型，以Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime作为其前台，通过前台-后台协调和记忆将语音交互扩展到持久任务。

articles.title: Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map: Real-Time Edge Triage Across Heterogeneous Domains
articles.abstract: Deploying Large Language Models for runtime operational triage incurs prohibitive latency (>100-500 ms), high VRAM requirements (>4-8 GB), and excessive energy dissipation. Extending Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis (Dagli et al., 2026), this paper presents the Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map, realized via the werr machine-native edge reflex runtime and the production answerr platform (https://answerr.me). Operating entirely without stored weight tensors (0 Bytes VRAM), the engine synthesizes deterministic decisions---noul (Boolean), choice (categorical), and score (ordinal)---by dynamically modulating 24-byte coordinate seeds along the chaotic boundary of the Mandelbrot set and evaluating multi-scale escape dynamics. Drawing inspiration from biological System-One reflex arcs, the engine introduces: (i) an Auto-Seed Router with domain projector Phi_D yielding a +28.8% accuracy gain over linear baselines; (ii) an Information-Theoretic Semantic Token Damping Filter (T_desc = 0.045) insulating against prompt injections (0.0% empirical bypass; 95% Wilson CI: [0.0%, 27.8%]) while pruning iterations by 45.8% (accelerating throughput 2.5x to 3.31 ms latency); (iii) a Multi-Scale Harmonic Tripod Fusion; (iv) a Coupled Margin Expansion Operator (Pitchfork Bifurcation Offset); and (v) a Cyclic Z/9Z Modular Resonant Grid Discretization based on the closed sub-ideal {0,3,6} (Lean 4 Mathlib ZMod 9), reducing FLOPs by 68.4%. Evaluated on JevBench (N=231), werr achieves 100.00% TypeSafe compliance and 81.65% calibrated accuracy with 7.08 ms median latency. We provide an OpenAI-compatible API and demonstrate deployment on 32-byte EVM smart contracts via the open-source werracle on-chain oracle (21,438 gas).
articles.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Version 2.0 with expanded EVM on-chain oracle benchmarks (werracle), formal multi-scale tripod dynamics, semantic token damping filter, and Zenodo v2 dataset
articles.titleCn: 通用分形自然语言决策图谱：跨异构域实时边缘分诊
articles.abstractCn: 部署大型语言模型用于实时操作级故障排除会导致过高的延迟（>100-500毫秒）、高VRAM需求（>4-8GB）以及过度的能耗。本文基于Mandelbrot分形神经合成（Dagli等，2026年），提出了通用分形自然语言决策图，通过werr机器原生边缘反射运行时和answerr生产平台（https://answerr.me）实现。该引擎完全无需存储权重张量（0字节VRAM），通过动态调制Mandelbrot集合混沌边界上的24字节坐标种子，并评估多尺度逃逸动力学，合成确定性决策——布尔值（noul）、分类值（choice）和序数值（score）。受生物系统一反射弧的启发，引擎引入：(i) 域投影器Phi_D的自种子路由器，相比线性基线提升准确率28.8%；(ii) 信息论语义标记阻尼过滤器（T_desc = 0.045），抵御提示注入攻击（实证绕过率0.0%；95%威尔逊置信区间：[0.0%，27.8%]），同时迭代次数减少45.8%（吞吐量加速2.5倍至3.31毫秒延迟）；(iii) 多尺度谐波三足架融合；(iv) 耦合边缘扩展算子（分叉分支偏移）；(v) 基于闭子理想{0,3,6}的循环Z/9Z模态谐振网格离散化（Lean 4数学库ZMod 9），将FLOPs降低68.4%。在JevBench（N=231）测试中，werr实现100.00%类型安全合规和81.65%校准准确率，中位延迟7.08毫秒。我们提供兼容OpenAI的API，并通过开源werracle链上预言机（21,438 gas）演示了在32字节EVM智能合约上的部署。

articles.title: LOCKR: A Hidden-State Trajectory-Guided Planner for Detecting and Repairing Stable-but-Wrong Lock-In in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative denoising, exposing intermediate trajectories before final answers are produced. We identify a recurring reasoning failure, stable-but-wrong lock-in, where an answer stabilizes early around an incorrect value while substantial denoising remains. Surface-level decoding signals such as confidence, entropy, margin, and answer stability are insufficient to reliably distinguish correct from erroneous lock-in. We formulate selective reasoning repair as a lightweight test-time planning problem and propose LOCKR, a hidden-state trajectory-guided planner that decides when to allocate additional computation, expands a structured set of targeted repair branches, and selects the most promising continuation using trajectory-aware verification. Across two diffusion language models and three mathematical reasoning benchmarks, hidden-state trajectories consistently outperform surface signals and single hidden snapshots for both wrong-lock-in detection and repair selection. On natural evaluation distributions, LOCKR yields absolute accuracy gains of 2.21--5.37 percentage points across all five evaluated settings, with repair rates ranging from 22% to 41%. These results establish hidden diffusion trajectories as actionable signals for selective test-time reasoning repair.
articles.titleCn: LOCKR：一种用于检测和修复扩散语言模型中稳定但错误的锁定状态的隐藏状态轨迹引导规划器
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型通过迭代去噪生成文本，在最终答案生成前会暴露中间轨迹。我们识别出一种反复出现的推理失败模式——稳定但错误的锁定，即答案在错误值附近过早稳定，而此时仍有大量去噪过程未完成。诸如置信度、熵、边缘和答案稳定性等表面解码信号不足以可靠地区分正确锁定与错误锁定。我们将选择性推理修复问题形式化为轻量级的测试时规划问题，并提出LOCKR，这是一种基于隐藏状态轨迹引导的规划器，它决定何时分配额外计算、扩展一组结构化的目标修复分支，并使用轨迹感知验证选择最有希望的延续。在两个扩散语言模型和三个数学推理基准测试中，隐藏状态轨迹在错误锁定检测和修复选择方面始终优于表面信号和单一隐藏状态快照。在自然评估分布上，LOCKR在所有五个评估设置中均实现了2.21--5.37个百分点的绝对精度提升，修复率在22%到41%之间。这些结果证实了隐藏扩散轨迹作为选择性测试时推理修复的可操作信号。

articles.title: ProCredit: From Outcome Rewards to Progress Credit in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require an agent to modify an environment through a sequence of tool calls, with success determined by the final state. The standard recipe assigns a single outcome reward at the end and compares trajectories sampled for the same task. As a result, a group with no successful trajectory yields no training signal, failed attempts cannot be told apart by how close they came to completion, and turns that advance the task receive the same credit as turns that only query the environment. Prior work refines the unit of comparison from the trajectory to the step, or trains a reward model to supply intermediate signal: the former still derives its signal from final success alone, and the latter estimates it with a model. We observe that the acceptance checks that decide success can also be run on intermediate states, so progress is as verifiable as the outcome. We propose ProCredit, which turns this verified progress into credit: it reruns the acceptance checks after each turn, rewards the turn by its change in progress, and uses these rewards to assign credit both across attempts at the same task and across the turns within a trajectory. Starting from Qwen3.5 base models at three scales on AppWorld, ProCredit outperforms outcome-reward baselines and progress-based baselines in task completion rate at every scale on both test sets, exceeding the strongest outcome-reward baseline by 4.1 percentage points at 4B, and results in a second environment show the same direction of improvement. Ablations show that adding the final progress to the trajectory score alone does not improve performance: the gain comes from crediting progress to the turn where it occurs.
articles.titleCn: ProCredit：从结果奖励到进度信贷的代理强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 长时程代理任务需要代理通过一系列工具调用修改环境，其成功由最终状态决定。标准方法在任务结束时分配单一结果奖励，并比较针对同一任务采样的轨迹。因此，没有成功轨迹的组别不会产生训练信号，失败尝试无法根据其接近完成的程度区分，而推进任务的步骤与仅查询环境的步骤获得相同的信用。先前工作将比较单位从轨迹细化为步骤，或训练奖励模型提供中间信号：前者仍仅从最终成功中获取信号，后者则通过模型估计。我们观察到，决定成功的接受检查也可以在中间状态上运行，因此进展与结果一样可验证。我们提出了ProCredit，将这种验证过的进展转化为信用：它在每一步之后重新运行接受检查，根据步骤进展的变化奖励该步骤，并使用这些奖励在相同任务的多次尝试之间以及轨迹内的步骤之间分配信用。从AppWorld上的三个规模Qwen3.5基础模型开始，ProCredit在两个测试集上每个规模的任务完成率均优于结果奖励基线和基于进展的基线，在4B规模上超过最强的结果奖励基线4.1个百分点，并在第二个环境中的结果也显示出相同方向的改进。消融实验表明，仅将最终进展添加到轨迹得分中并不能提高性能：收益来自将进展归功于发生进展的步骤。

articles.title: Brain-to-Language Decoding: Tasks, Signals, Methods, Evaluation, Practical Use and Beyond
articles.abstract: Brain-to-language decoding translates neural activity associated with language production, internal speech and perception into linguistic or expressive outputs. It offers a route to restoring communication after speech loss and a means of studying how the brain represents language. Advances in neural recording and representation learning have expanded the field from constrained recognition and acoustic reconstruction to text generation, streaming personalised speech and facial animation. This survey synthesises these developments across invasive and non-invasive measurements, drawing on a search without a lower year limit and source-led updates through September 2026. We connect Articulated, Inner and Perceived tasks to the neural populations they engage, the representations available to decoders and the outputs those representations can support. We examine model development, public resources and the evolution of evaluation, and compare published performance and communication costs within their reported protocols. The synthesis identifies complementary routes to progress: phonetic, acoustic and semantic targets preserve different aspects of a message; shared representations support reuse across recording conditions and tasks; and online communication increasingly depends on calibration, feedback and user control alongside decoding accuracy. Shared benchmarks enable algorithmic comparisons, while longitudinal studies reveal the demands of sustained use. We discuss these developments and their remaining limitations, then outline a prospective five-level trajectory from commands and language to meaning, scenarios and bidirectional cognitive exchange
articles.titleCn: 脑机语言解码：任务、信号、方法、评估、实际应用及未来展望
articles.abstractCn: 脑-语言解码将语言产生、内部言语和感知相关的神经活动转化为语言或表达输出。它为在失语症后恢复沟通提供途径，也为研究大脑如何表征语言提供方法。神经记录和表征学习的进步已将研究领域从受限的识别和声学重建扩展到文本生成、个性化语音流和面部动画。本综述综合了侵入性和非侵入性测量中的这些发展，基于无下限年份的搜索和截至2026年9月的来源更新。我们将表达、内部和感知任务与它们所涉及的神经群体、解码器可用的表征以及这些表征所能支持的输出联系起来。我们考察了模型开发、公共资源和评估的演变，并在其报告的协议内比较了已发表的性能和沟通成本。综合分析确定了进步的互补途径：语音、声学和语义目标保留了消息的不同方面；共享表征支持跨记录条件和任务的复用；在线沟通越来越多地依赖于校准、反馈和用户控制，而不仅仅是解码准确性。共享基准促进了算法比较，而纵向研究揭示了持续使用的需求。我们讨论了这些发展和它们剩余的局限性，然后概述了从指令和语言到意义、场景和双向认知交流的前景五级轨迹。

articles.title: Consequential Behaviour and Representational Fairness in the Validation of Synthetic Research
articles.abstract: Researchers in industry and academia use synthetic survey respondents powered by large language models as substitutes for human samples. These synthetic populations require validation against real-world data, so researchers often address them using ad hoc comparisons with human surveys. Inspired by the intention-behaviour gap in behavioural science, we argue that these validations test the wrong thing for most applied cases where decision makers commission synthetic research to anticipate consequential behaviour. To address this problem, we propose a validation framework with two requirements. First, every validity claim must state its level of correspondence with human data: does the sample predict what the represented people do, which of four diagnostics (location, dispersion, response process and structure) does the validation address, and does the validation compare against experimental effects? Second, researchers must report validity claims for subgroups, since these groups are often the most affected by consequential decisions and aggregate accuracy hides their misrepresentation. Our validation framework operationalises three justice dimensions (distributional, procedural, and recognition) as measurable quantities and defines within-persona counterfactual experiments as a validation requirement. We then apply the framework to electric vehicle charging tariffs, before closing with a reporting checklist that researchers can use to make convincing validity claims.
articles.titleCn: 合成研究的验证中的结果行为与表征公平
articles.abstractCn: 工业界和学术界的研究人员使用由大型语言模型驱动的合成调查受访者作为人类样本的替代品。这些合成人群需要与真实世界数据进行验证，因此研究人员通常通过与人调查的临时性比较来处理它们。受行为科学中意图-行为差距的启发，我们认为在这些验证中，大多数实际应用案例（决策者委托合成研究以预测具有重大影响的行为）测试了错误的东西。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个具有两个要求的验证框架。首先，每个有效性声明都必须说明其与人类数据的对应程度：样本是否预测了所代表人群的行为，验证涉及四个诊断中的哪一个（位置、分散度、响应过程和结构），以及验证是否与实验效应进行比较？其次，研究人员必须报告子群体的有效性声明，因为这些群体通常是受重大决策影响最大的群体，而汇总准确性会掩盖它们的错误表征。我们的验证框架将三个正义维度（分配性、程序性和认可性）操作化为可测量的量，并将人格内反事实实验定义为验证要求。然后我们将该框架应用于电动汽车充电费率，最后提供一个研究人员可以使用以做出令人信服的有效性声明的报告清单。

articles.title: SkillGym: Internalizing Human Skills into LLMs for Real-World Problem Solving
articles.abstract: Human-written agent skills encode rich workflows for real-world problem solving, but are typically used as external inference-time instructions rather than internalized as reusable model capabilities. We introduce \texttt{SkillGym}, a framework that transforms these skills into executable, verifiable training environments for large language model agents. Its skill-to-task pipeline instantiates concrete tasks, verifies outcomes with code-based checkers, and assesses empirical skill dependence through contrastive executions. We construct and release 2,756 environments across 12 categories and collect 8,364 successful trajectories from multiple models and harnesses, averaging 49 tool calls and over 60k logged text tokens. These resources support supervised fine-tuning on verified workflows and reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards. Under Claude Code, supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 199 Elo on GDPval-AA v2, 19.10 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and 28.13 and 12.38 points on SkillsBench v1.1 with and without skills, respectively. Our 35B \texttt{SkillGym-Agent} reaches 51.47\% on skill-assisted SkillsBench, exceeding reported scores for Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4 Mini, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Without skills, it also surpasses skill-assisted bases under Codex and Claude Code, suggesting reusable procedural competence.
articles.titleCn: SkillGym：将人类技能内化于大型语言模型以解决现实世界问题
articles.abstractCn: 人类编写的代理技能编码了丰富的流程，用于解决现实世界问题，但通常仅作为推理时的外部指令使用，而非内化为可复用的模型能力。我们引入了SkillGym框架，将此类技能转化为大型语言模型代理的可执行、可验证训练环境。其技能到任务的流程能够实例化具体任务，通过代码检查器验证结果，并通过对比执行评估经验技能依赖性。我们构建并发布了涵盖12个类别的2,756个环境，并从多个模型和引擎中收集了8,364条成功轨迹，平均包含49次工具调用和超过60k条记录的文本标记。这些资源支持在验证工作流上进行监督微调和基于结果的奖励强化学习。在Claude Code下，监督微调使Qwen3.5-35B-A3B在GDPval-AA v2上的Elo评分提升了199分，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上的得分提高了19.10个百分点，在有技能和无技能的情况下，在SkillsBench v1.1上的得分分别提升了28.13分和12.38分。我们的35B SkillGym-Agent在技能辅助的SkillsBench上达到了51.47%的成绩，超过了Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4 Mini和DeepSeek V4 Pro的公开报道分数。在没有技能的情况下，它也超越了Codex和Claude Code下的技能辅助基准，表明了可复用的程序性能力。

articles.title: Learning New Words from Unlabeled Test Data in Automatic Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: New words are invented every day. A human listener can learn a new word by hearing it clearly once and inferring its usage from sentence context. This paper proposes granting ASR a similar ability to learn the contextual representations and spellings of new words from unlabeled test data at test time. A frozen CTC acoustic model provides spellings, a frozen language model provides contextual evidence for out-of-vocabulary (OOV) word detection, and an adaptation module expands the vocabulary by learning the lexical token representations with distributions over CTC-generated candidates. The spelling model of each token is optimized by minimizing a Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD) objective. We demonstrate that the CTC-weighted language model log likelihood ratio can be interpreted as the KLD between the unknown correct ASR and the unsupervised learned ASR, and that, using a Pinsker bound, the square root of KLD can be interpreted as an upper bound on the total variation distance between the true and estimated spelling of the unknown word. Experiments show relative OOV character-error-rate reductions of up to 14.97% on LibriSpeech and 6.67% on dysarthric Speech Accessibility Project data for recurring OOV words, relative to the corresponding rescoring system.
articles.titleCn: 从无标签测试数据中学习新词在自动语音识别中
articles.abstractCn: 每天都有新词被创造。人类听众可以通过清晰地听到一次新词，并从句子语境中推断其用法来学习新词。本文提出赋予语音识别系统类似的能力，使其在测试时能够从无标签测试数据中学习新词的语境表示和拼写。一个冻结的CTC声学模型提供拼写，一个冻结的语言模型为词汇外（OOV）词检测提供语境证据，而一个自适应模块通过学习CTC生成的候选词的分布来扩展词汇。每个词的拼写模型通过最小化Kullback-Leibler散度（KLD）目标进行优化。我们证明了CTC加权语言模型对数似然比可以解释为未知正确语音识别和未监督学习语音识别之间的KLD，并且使用Pinsker界，KLD的平方根可以解释为未知词真实拼写和估计拼写之间总变差距离的上界。实验表明，对于反复出现的OOV词，在LibriSpeech数据上相对OOV字符错误率降低了14.97%，在失语症语音可访问性项目数据上降低了6.67%，相对于相应的重评分系统。

articles.title: Personalized Korean Lipreading as Visual Speech Recognition: Transfer, Census and Adaptation on OLKAVS
articles.abstract: We present a personalized Korean visual speech recognition (VSR) system and quantify, on the nine-camera OLKAVS corpus, the gap between the population-level benchmark score and an individual user's error. A video-only Conformer initialized from English-trained weights attains 9.95 - 12.19% character error rate (CER) under the corpus protocol against the published 26.64, and 19.00 - 21.52 on unseen wording. Per speaker, CER spans 1.0 to 52.2%, with seen wording lowering CER by 7.0 - 9.0 points and professional delivery and spontaneous speech raising it by 8.5 - 10.5 and 12.7 points. A low-rank adapter with 4.6% of the parameters, trained on 4 to 29 minutes of the user's frontal video, lowers the CER of twelve high-error speakers by 2.13 to 3.58 points, transfers to every camera without loss, and keeps 85% of the full fine-tuning gain at 12% of its cost to other speakers. Cameras above the mouth plane add about six CER points as a constant offset that training on all views keeps small.
articles.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. 4 pages plus references
articles.titleCn: 基于视觉语音识别的个性化韩语唇语识别：OLKAVS上的迁移、普查和适应
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种个性化的韩语视觉语音识别（VSR）系统，并在九摄像头OLKAVS语料库上量化了群体水平基准分数与个人用户错误之间的差距。仅使用视频的Conformer模型，在英语训练权重初始化下，在语料库协议下达到9.95%至12.19%的字符错误率（CER），优于已发表的26.64%，在未见过的词语上达到19.00%至21.52%。每个说话人的CER范围在1.0%至52.2%，已见词语使CER降低7.0至9.0个百分点，专业发音和自发性语音分别使CER提高8.5至10.5个百分点和12.7个百分点。一个低秩适配器，仅占参数的4.6%，通过训练用户正面视频4至29分钟，使十二个高错误率说话人的CER降低2.13至3.58个百分点，无损迁移到每个摄像头，并保持85%的完整微调收益，只需其他说话人12%的成本。口部平面以上的摄像头作为常数偏移量增加了约6个CER点，而训练所有视角能保持这一偏移量较小。

articles.title: Polite but Misaligned: Evaluating LLM Politeness Judgments Against Human Pragmatic Norms
articles.abstract: Despite strong performance on standard benchmarks, it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) evaluate social pragmatics in ways that align with human judgments. We evaluate LLM politeness judgments using two English-language datasets with complementary annotation formats: continuous human ratings and three-way categorical labels. Across the seven evaluated models, we find that inter-model agreement is stronger than model--human agreement. Strategy-level analyses suggest that model--human alignment is associated with explicit linguistic cues, while some rapport-building strategies occur more frequently in misaligned cases. In the categorical task, model predictions exhibit systematic neutral compression, characterized by the overproduction of Neutral labels and the underprediction of Impolite labels. This pattern persists when expert consensus is used as the reference on a diagnostic subset. Our findings highlight the need for pragmatic evaluations that go beyond aggregate agreement metrics by examining directional patterns of model--human disagreement across different human references.
articles.titleCn: 礼貌但错位：评估大型语言模型礼貌判断与人类语用规范的一致性
articles.abstractCn: 尽管在标准基准测试中表现出色，但大型语言模型（LLM）在评估社交语用学方面是否与人类判断相符仍不明确。我们使用两种具有互补标注格式的英语数据集评估LLM的礼貌判断：连续的人类评分和三项分类标签。在评估的七种模型中，我们发现模型间的协议强于模型与人类的协议。策略层面的分析表明，模型与人类的对齐与显式语言线索相关，而某些建立融洽关系的策略在未对齐的情况下更频繁出现。在分类任务中，模型预测表现出系统性的中性压缩，其特征为过度产生中性标签和低估粗鲁标签。当在诊断子集上使用专家共识作为参考时，这种模式仍然存在。我们的研究结果表明，需要超越总体协议指标，通过检查模型与人类在不同人类参考中的不一致方向模式来进行语用评估。

articles.title: MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks
articles.abstract: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate through local interactions, but an agent can remain responsive while its task-solving quality persistently degrades. Such gray failures require protecting current tasks before sufficient evidence exists to alter future routing, while still allowing recovered agents to rejoin. We introduce MeshHeal, a fully decentralized self-healing framework that couples ability-matched peer review across two timescales. At the fast timescale, an adaptive hierarchy escalates uncertain or low-scoring outputs from repeated single-reviewer evaluation to committee deliberation and, when needed, correction before use. At the slow timescale, a task- and ability-conditioned peer-relative detector aggregates scores to distinguish persistent degradation from ordinary output variation, trigger mandatory committee review, and eventually exclude degraded agents from ordinary routing; recovery probes provide fresh evidence for reintegration. To faithfully evaluate routing, we introduce Model-Backed MAS Evaluation, which ties ability assignments to execution models, since prompt-based ability assignments alone can leave routing errors hidden. Across BBH, MATH, and MMLU-Pro, MeshHeal achieves 0.839 degraded-phase accuracy using 51k total model tokens per task, versus the strongest baseline Symphony's 0.807 accuracy using 115k per task. Under staggered degradation and recovery, MeshHeal isolates degraded agents, keeps them excluded from ordinary task execution until recovery, and returns them to normal routing.
articles.titleCn: MeshHeal：针对去中心化LLM代理网络中的灰度故障的双时标自愈技术
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的去中心化多智能体系统通过局部交互进行协调，但当一个智能体的任务解决质量持续下降时，它仍能保持响应。这种灰色故障需要在存在足够证据改变未来路由之前保护当前任务，同时仍允许恢复的智能体重新加入。我们引入了MeshHeal，一个完全去中心化的自愈框架，它结合了跨两个时间尺度的能力匹配同行评审。在快速时间尺度上，自适应层级将重复单一评审员评估的不确定或低评分输出升级为委员会审议，并在需要时在使用前进行纠正。在慢速时间尺度上，一个基于任务和能力条件的相对同行检测器聚合评分，以区分持续退化与普通输出变异，触发强制委员会审议，并最终将退化智能体从普通路由中排除；恢复探测提供重新整合的新证据。为了真实评估路由，我们引入了基于模型的MAS评估，将能力分配与执行模型挂钩，因为仅基于提示的能力分配可能会隐藏路由错误。在BBH、MATH和MMLU-Pro上，MeshHeal使用每个任务51k个总模型令牌实现了0.839的退化阶段准确率，而最强的基线Symphony使用每个任务115k个令牌实现了0.807的准确率。在交错退化和恢复的情况下，MeshHeal隔离了退化的智能体，将它们排除在普通任务执行之外直到恢复，然后将其返回到正常路由。

articles.title: Design and Evaluation of LLM Chaining-Based Task Planning for General Purpose Service Robots
articles.abstract: General Purpose Service Robot (GPSR) tasks, as defined in the RoboCup@Home benchmark, require robots to interpret diverse natural language commands and generate multi-step action sequences in real home environments. Conventional Single Prompt (SP) approaches suffer from context bloat and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, leading to unreliable task planning. We propose an LLM chaining architecture that separates instruction classification and action generation into two specialized stages, reducing per-inference prompt length by approximately 45% while improving planning consistency. We evaluate our method using 100 randomly generated GPSR commands across three language models spanning local open-source and frontier cloud deployment contexts. Results show consistent planning improvements over SP across all models, with gains of up to +37 percentage points on local models. Further, real-robot execution experiments on the Toyota Human Support Robot (HSR) reveal that planning success alone does not guarantee task completion, with 6 of 10 tasks completing successfully and execution-layer failures identified as the primary remaining bottleneck.
articles.comment: Accepted to IEEE GCCE 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
articles.titleCn: 通用服务机器人基于LLM链式任务规划的设计与评估
articles.abstractCn: 根据RoboCup@Home基准定义的通用服务机器人（GPSR）任务，要求机器人在真实家庭环境中解释多样化的自然语言指令，并生成多步骤行动序列。传统的单提示（SP）方法存在上下文冗余和“迷失于中间”现象，导致任务规划不可靠。我们提出了一种LLM串联架构，将指令分类和行动生成分为两个专门阶段，通过将每次推理的提示长度减少约45%来提高规划一致性。我们使用三个跨越本地开源和前沿云部署环境的三种语言模型，对100个随机生成的GPSR指令评估了我们的方法。结果表明，在所有模型中，与SP相比，规划一致性均有提升，本地模型提升了高达+37个百分点。此外，在丰田人形支持机器人（HSR）上的真实机器人执行实验表明，仅规划成功并不能保证任务完成，10个任务中有6个成功完成，而执行层失败被识别为主要的剩余瓶颈。

articles.title: Empath: Tracing Multi-Level Emotion Dynamics in Crisis Counseling Dialogues
articles.abstract: Emotion dynamics are critical for understanding crisis-support conversations, yet most computational work treats emotion as static utterance-level labels. We introduce EMPATH, a framework for understanding affective dynamics in mental health dialogues across three granularities: turn-level labels, transition probabilities, and global conversation archetypes. Applying EMPATH to text-based crisis conversations with self-identified Black texters discussing grief, we find persistent negative affect, gradual hope-ward transitions, distinct texter-volunteer emotional roles, and heterogeneous recovery trajectories. These results highlight the informative patterns that emerge from computationally understanding crisis support and expressions of grief as dynamic processes within conversations, as well as the overall value of emotion-dynamic analysis for analyzing and comparing affect in dialogues.
articles.titleCn: 共情：危机咨询对话中多级情绪动态追踪
articles.abstractCn: 情绪动态对于理解危机支持对话至关重要，然而大多数计算工作将情绪视为静态的语句级标签。我们引入了EMPATH框架，该框架从三个粒度来理解心理健康对话中的情感动态：语句级标签、转换概率和全局对话原型。将EMPATH应用于自我认定的黑人文本者讨论悲伤的基于文本的危机对话，我们发现持续性的负面情绪、逐渐向希望转变的过程、文本者与志愿者之间不同的情感角色，以及异质性的恢复轨迹。这些结果突出了在对话中，通过计算理解危机支持和悲伤表达作为动态过程所出现的具有信息性的模式，同时也强调了情绪动态分析在分析和比较对话中情感的整体价值。

articles.title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
articles.abstract: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.59 across easy/medium/hard tiers versus 0.29/0.26/0.29 for non-RAG. RAG models also achieved higher semantic-similarity scores overall. Proprietary RAG models performed strongest on easy and medium questions, while local RAG models ranked highest on hard questions and proprietary models were generally more cautious. Domain-specific RAG improved evidence grounding and response quality for cancer registry questions while enabling citation-supported assistance across complexity levels. CRISS demonstrates the potential of human-centered, citation-grounded AI to support cancer registrars while preserving human oversight for final coding decisions.
articles.comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 7 tables. Keywords: cancer registry, retrieval-augmented generation, large language models, conversational AI, clinical informatics, oncology data specialists, medical question answering, AI safety, clinical decision support
articles.titleCn: CRISS：一个用于辅助癌症登记员的检索增强型AI聊天机器人
articles.abstractCn: 癌症登记员，包括肿瘤学数据专家（ODS），必须解读复杂且频繁更新的编码和分期标准。我们开发了CRISS（癌症登记智能支持系统），这是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的对话助手，能够提供快速、有引用支持的登记指南访问。本研究评估了CRISS是否能够（1）支持准确且有引用支持的回复，（2）提高对相关指南的访问和解读，（3）在保留最终抽象决策的人为监督的同时支持培训和帮助台使用。我们从国家癌症登记标准中构建了一个特定领域的知识库，将其分割为元数据标记的段落，并作为密集嵌入进行索引。检索到的段落通过大型语言模型（LLM）生成有引用支持的回复。在Gemini和GPT系列中，对开放权重、专有和非RAG基线模型进行了评估，使用LLM作为裁判协议对简单、中等和困难的登记问题进行评估。RAG配置始终优于非RAG方法，尤其是在问题难度增加时。RAG的平均接地分数在简单/中等/困难级别分别为0.62/0.56/0.59，而非RAG则为0.29/0.26/0.29。RAG模型在整体上也实现了更高的语义相似度分数。专有RAG模型在简单和中等问题上表现最强，而本地RAG模型在困难问题上排名最高，专有模型通常更为谨慎。特定领域的RAG提高了癌症登记问题的证据接地和回复质量，同时实现了跨复杂程度的引用支持协助。CRISS展示了以人为中心、有引用支持的AI在支持癌症登记员的同时，保留最终编码决策的人为监督的潜力。

articles.title: Can Classical Semantic-Extractive Summarization Be Evaluated in Hindi? A Replication Study
articles.abstract: We replicate the distributional-semantics extractive summarisation method of Mohd, Jan and Shah (2020) and adapt it to Hindi, substituting a Devanagari-appropriate component at every language-specific step. The system is evaluated on two independent corpora --- the Hindi portion of XL-Sum and FIRE ILSUM 2.0 Hindi --- under a Devanagari-aware ROUGE implementation validated against the XL-Sum authors' own multilingual scorer, with all comparisons drawn as 1000-resample paired bootstraps. In its published equal-weight configuration the replicated system is significantly worse than a three-sentence lead baseline on both corpora, trailing Lead-3 by 0.042 ROUGE-1 Fon XL-Sum and by 0.265 on ILSUM. A feature ablation shows that sentenceposition is the only feature that contributes: position alone reproduces the lead baseline exactly, removing position gives the weakest configuration,and a validation-tuned weighting can at best equal Lead-3 and never exceed it. TextRank fails identically, making this a class-level rather than an implementation-level result. A selection analysis shows the remaining features steer extraction towards long, entity-dense body sentences while the references reuse the article lead.Current Hindi benchmarks therefore cannot reward non-lead content selection, motivating purpose-built evaluation resources.
articles.titleCn: 古典语义提取式摘要能否用印地语进行评估？一项复制研究
articles.abstractCn: 我们复制了Mohd、Jan和Shah（2020）提出的基于分布语义的抽取式摘要方法，并将其适配于印地语，在每种语言特定的步骤中替换了适合天城文书的组件。该系统在两个独立语料库上进行了评估——XL-Sum的印地语部分和FIRE ILSUM 2.0的印地语部分，评估采用了一种对天城文书敏感的ROUGE实现，该实现经过XL-Sum作者自己的多语言评分器验证，所有比较均通过1000重采样配对自举法进行。在其发布的等权重配置下，复制的系统在两个语料库上均显著劣于三句导语基线，在XL-Sum上落后于Lead-3 0.042 ROUGE-1分数，在ILSUM上落后0.265。特征消融实验表明，句子位置是唯一贡献特征：仅位置特征就能精确复现导语基线，移除位置特征得到最弱配置，而经过验证调优的权重最多只能与Lead-3持平且永不超越。TextRank表现相同，因此这是一个类别级别而非实现级别的结果。选择分析显示，剩余特征使抽取倾向于长实体密集的正文句子，而参考则重复使用文章导语。因此，当前的印地语基准无法奖励非导语内容选择，这促使我们构建专门的评价资源。

articles.title: ELF-REG: Scaling Continuous Diffusion Language Models to Reasoning Tasks
articles.abstract: Fully continuous diffusion language models (dLMs) denoise continuous representations without intermediate discretization, then decode all response tokens in parallel at the final step. Their performance on challenging reasoning tasks remains less established than that of autoregressive (AR) LLMs and masked dLMs. We scale Embedded Language Flows (ELF) to mathematical reasoning and code generation on GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP. We introduce ELF-REG, which improves learning with representation alignment and entanglement (REPA+REG), where a frozen AR teacher supervises intermediate denoiser features and supplies a global representation that is jointly denoised with the response. ELF-REG-L achieves 55.96% pass@1 on GSM8K at 64 network function evaluations (NFE), and 13.39% on MATH-500 and 22.56% on HumanEval at 128 NFE. It outperforms the evaluated comparable-scale dLMs in pass@1 on GSM8K and code, and improves MATH-500 pass@1 from 10.55% for the ELF-L baseline to 13.39% with ELF-REG-L. Without few-step training, the same task-specific checkpoints support strong low-NFE performance through early-stop, which decodes an intermediate clean prediction without completing the denoising trajectory. At 16 NFE, ELF-REG-L reaches 41.21% HumanEval pass@10, outperforming recent continuous dLMs of comparable scale.
articles.titleCn: ELF-REG：将连续扩散语言模型扩展到推理任务
articles.abstractCn: 全连续扩散语言模型（dLMs）无需中间离散化即可对连续表示进行去噪，并在最终步骤并行解码所有响应标记。它们在具有挑战性的推理任务上的表现仍不如自回归（AR）LLMs和掩码dLMs。我们将嵌入式语言流（ELF）扩展到GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval和MBPP上的数学推理和代码生成。我们引入了ELF-REG，它通过表示对齐和纠缠（REPA+REG）改进学习，其中冻结的AR教师监督中间去噪器特征，并提供一个全局表示，该表示与响应共同去噪。ELF-REG-L在64次网络函数评估（NFE）时在GSM8K上达到55.96%的pass@1，在128 NFE时在MATH-500和HumanEval上分别达到13.39%和22.56%。它在GSM8K和代码的pass@1上优于评估的可比规模dLMs，并将MATH-500的pass@1从ELF-L基线的10.55%提高到ELF-REG-L的13.39%。在没有少量步长训练的情况下，相同的任务特定检查点通过提前停止支持强大的低NFE性能，这在不完成去噪轨迹的情况下解码中间的清洁预测。在16 NFE时，ELF-REG-L达到41.21%的HumanEval pass@10，优于近期可比规模的连续dLMs。

articles.title: Accent Analogy Guidance: More Speaker Similarity at Equal Accent in Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
articles.abstract: In cross-lingual zero-shot text-to-speech, the accent of the reference leaks into the target speech. We propose accent analogy guidance (AAG), a training-free sampler term that subtracts an accent direction estimated from the model's own predictions for one synthetic voice rendered in both languages, so the voice cancels and only the accent remains. By a blind LLM accent judge on real dubbing data, reweighting classifier-free guidance between reference and text, and its variants, stay near one identity-accent trade-off curve; we score a method by its speaker similarity above that curve at equal accent ($Δ$SIM). Across four open TTS models AAG lies above the curve: on OmniVoice $Δ$SIM is +0.11 to +0.27 on three test sets (accent 3.51 to 4.28 on a 1-5 scale at speaker similarity 0.29, where reweighting keeps 0.02); MaskGCT and CosyVoice 2 also lie above their curves, and on F5-TTS it is more native than any reweighting setting. An LLM-free language-ID measure and a twelve-listener panel agree. A premise test and the reach of a model's own curve indicate in advance whether and roughly how much AAG can gain, predicting the one model where it gains nothing (X-Voice).
articles.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Listening samples: https://yoomee-cho.github.io/accent-analogy-guidance/
articles.titleCn: 重音类比指导：同等重音下跨语言语音克隆中的更多说话人相似性
articles.abstractCn: 在跨语言零样本语音合成中，参考语音的口音会泄露到目标语音中。我们提出了口音类比引导（AAG），这是一种无需训练的采样项，它从模型对两种语言合成的语音的预测中估计口音方向，并将其相减，使语音抵消，仅保留口音。通过在真实配音数据上进行的盲法LLM口音评判，重新加权参考语音和文本之间的无分类器引导及其变体，它们都保持在接近身份-口音权衡曲线附近；我们通过衡量在相同口音水平下（$Δ$SIM）高于该曲线的说话人相似度来评分该方法。在四个公开的TTS模型中，AAG都高于该曲线：在OmniVoice上，$Δ$SIM在三个测试集上为+0.11至+0.27（在说话人相似度为0.29时，口音评分为1-5级的3.51至4.28，其中重新加权保持为0.02）；MaskGCT和CosyVoice 2也高于它们的曲线，在F5-TTS上，其效果比任何重新加权设置都更自然。无LLM的语言ID测量和十二位听众小组的评判结果一致。前提测试和模型自身曲线的范围可以提前预测AAG能否以及大致能获得多少收益，并预测了唯一一个AAG无收益的模型（X-Voice）。

articles.title: Tag-Aware Structured Text Translation: Towards a Systematic Understanding
articles.abstract: Internet texts are replete with format tags that carry structural, semantic, and functional meaning. Current large language model (LLM)-based translation systems struggle to balance translation fluency with tag fidelity when processing tagged text. We argue that resolving this tension requires a systematic approach at three interconnected levels: data synthesis, capability building, and multi-objective alignment. At the data level, we identify and formalize a fundamental trade-off between structural tag diversity and translation naturalness in synthetic data generation; existing methods optimize for one at the expense of the other. We propose a hybrid synthesis strategy (Hy-LST) combining LLM-based synthesis tag method and Two-Stage LLM-based synthesis tag method to produce both diverse and natural tagged data. At the capability level, we decompose tag-aware translation into four sub-tasks of increasing difficulty in a multi-task supervised fine-tuning framework, enabling targeted capability acquisition and knowledge transfer. At the alignment level, we design three complementary reward functions under a group relative policy optimization framework, each targeting a distinct objective (fluency, tag fidelity, and tag-scoped translation quality), and show that joint optimization consistently outperforms single-reward alternatives. Experiments on six language directions (en2zh, en2ja, en2de, en2fr, en2ru, de2fr) demonstrate that each level contributes measurable improvements, and the complete system significantly outperforms existing methods. Qualitative analysis reveals specific error patterns and their mitigation after training with our method.
articles.titleCn: 标签感知结构化文本翻译：迈向系统化理解
articles.abstractCn: 互联网文本中充斥着携带结构、语义和功能含义的格式标签。当前的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的翻译系统在处理带标签文本时，难以在翻译流畅度和标签保真度之间取得平衡。我们认为，解决这一矛盾需要在一个相互关联的三个层面采取系统方法：数据合成、能力构建和多目标对齐。在数据层面，我们识别并形式化了一个在合成数据生成过程中结构标签多样性与翻译自然性之间的基本权衡；现有方法在优化一个方面时牺牲了另一方面。我们提出了一种混合合成策略（Hy-LST），结合基于LLM的合成标签方法和基于LLM的两阶段合成标签方法，以生成多样且自然的带标签数据。在能力层面，我们在多任务监督微调框架中将带标签感知翻译分解为四个难度递增的子任务，实现有针对性的能力获取和知识迁移。在对齐层面，我们在群体相对策略优化框架下设计了三个互补的奖励函数，每个函数针对一个不同目标（流畅度、标签保真度和标签范围翻译质量），并证明联合优化始终优于单一奖励替代方案。在六个语言方向（en2zh、en2ja、en2de、en2fr、en2ru、de2fr）上的实验表明，每个层面都带来了可衡量的改进，完整系统显著优于现有方法。定性分析揭示了使用我们的方法进行训练后出现的特定错误模式及其缓解措施。

articles.title: BanglaKontho: Closing the Long-Form Gap in Bangla Text-to-Speech
articles.abstract: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, remains under-resourced for neural text-to-speech. Public Bangla speech corpora are dominated by short read-prompt utterances collected for speech recognition, leaving long-form prosody and consistent single-speaker narration uncovered. We present BanglaKontho, a single-speaker Bangla TTS corpus of 20 hours derived from professional audiobook recordings: 7,050 segmented utterances with verified transcripts at 24 kHz. We also release a reusable Bangla text normalizer covering Bangladeshi-style digit grouping, currency and date expressions, Danda punctuation and Unicode normalization, together with the full preprocessing pipeline. An MB-iSTFT-VITS baseline trained from scratch reaches 9.5% WER and 4.46 naturalness MOS, against 16.0% and 3.16 for the same architecture retrained on the 12-hour IndicTTS-Bn corpus. The corpus is released openly under CC BY-NC 4.0.
articles.titleCn: BanglaKontho：解决孟加拉语文本到语音的长文本差距问题
articles.abstractCn: 孟加拉语是世界上使用人数第七的语言，但在神经语音合成方面资源仍然匮乏。公共孟加拉语语音语料库主要由为语音识别收集的短读提示语音构成，导致长文本韵律和一致的单人叙述未被覆盖。我们提出了孟加拉语Kontho，这是一个由专业有声读物录音衍生而来的20小时单人孟加拉语TTS语料库：包含7,050个分段语音，频率为24 kHz，并附有经过验证的文本。我们还发布了一个可重复使用的孟加拉语文本规范化工具，涵盖孟加拉风格数字分组、货币和日期表达、Danda标点符号和Unicode规范化，以及完整的前处理流程。从头开始训练的MB-iSTFT-VITS基线达到了9.5%的WER和4.46的自然度MOS，而使用相同架构在12小时的IndicTTS-Bn语料库上重新训练时，WER为16.0%，MOS为3.16。该语料库在CC BY-NC 4.0许可下公开发布。

articles.title: Predicting Emerging Topics from Outliers: A Prospective Study of Weak Signals in Embedding Space
articles.abstract: Some documents that embedding-based topic models initially classify as noise later become founding members of emerging topics. At publication time, however, they appear as scattered points in embedding space and are difficult to distinguish from ordinary noise without the benefit of hindsight. We study whether such anticipatory outliers can be predicted prospectively, using only information available when a document first appears. We derive labels from the subsequent trajectories of outlier documents, distinguishing those that anticipate new topics from those that reinforce existing topics or remain isolated, and estimate label confidence through agreement across multiple embedding models. On two French news corpora, anticipatory outliers prove predictable at publication time. Under cross-validation, $F_1$ rises from about 0.77 over the full eligible population to above 0.90 on high-consensus subsets, and remains at 0.76-0.80 under a strictly chronological evaluation. Predictive performance is driven mainly by geometric features capturing each outlier's position in embedding space.
articles.titleCn: 从异常值中预测新兴主题：嵌入空间中弱信号的预测性研究
articles.abstractCn: 基于嵌入的主题模型最初将某些文档分类为噪声，但后来这些文档成为新兴主题的创始成员。然而，在发布时，它们在嵌入空间中表现为分散的点，如果没有后见之明，很难将它们与普通噪声区分开来。我们研究了仅使用文档首次出现时可用信息，是否可以预测此类预期异常值。我们从异常值文档的后续轨迹中推导出标签，区分那些预示新主题的文档与那些强化现有主题或保持孤立的文档，并通过多个嵌入模型的一致性来估计标签置信度。在两个法语新闻语料库上，预期异常值在发布时被证明是可预测的。在交叉验证中，$F_1$ 值从全合格人群中的约 0.77 提高到高共识子集中的 0.90 以上，并在严格的时间顺序评估下保持在 0.76-0.80。预测性能主要由几何特征驱动，这些特征捕捉了每个异常值在嵌入空间中的位置。

articles.title: EAGER: Enhancing Generative Event Extraction via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
articles.abstract: End-to-end event extraction remains challenging for large language models as it requires simultaneous identification of event triggers, classification of event types, and extraction of schema-grounded argument spans. We present EAGER, a reinforcement learning framework for generative event extraction that combines fine-grained verifiable rewards with Schema-Contrastive Advantage Estimation to alleviate advantage collapse under sparse binary rewards. Our reward design explicitly targets structural validity, extraction accuracy, groundedness, coverage, over-generation, and span precision. Experiments across seven benchmark datasets show that EAGER consistently outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and prior reinforcement learning baselines, achieving a substantial improvement over the strongest prior method. Results demonstrate that task-aligned verifiable rewards and contrastive advantage estimation substantially improve structured extraction.
articles.titleCn: EAGER：通过具有可验证奖励的强化学习增强生成式事件抽取
articles.abstractCn: 端到端事件抽取对于大型语言模型来说仍然是一项挑战，因为它需要同时识别事件触发词、分类事件类型以及提取基于模式的论元跨度。我们提出了EAGER，一个用于生成式事件抽取的强化学习框架，该框架结合了细粒度可验证奖励与模式对比优势估计，以缓解稀疏二元奖励下的优势崩溃问题。我们的奖励设计明确针对结构有效性、抽取准确性、基础性、覆盖率、过度生成和跨度精确度。在七个基准数据集上的实验表明，EAGER始终优于提示、监督微调和先前的强化学习基线，相较于最强先验方法实现了显著提升。结果证明，任务对齐的可验证奖励和对比优势估计显著提高了结构化抽取效果。

articles.title: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
articles.abstract: We find that language models can transfer capabilities through task-unrelated text. Post-training typically improves language models using task-specific data. Prior work on subliminal learning shows that information about these updates can pass through unrelated generations, but has largely focused on traits or preferences using extensive teacher outputs. We introduce Active Taskless Distillation (ATD), which achieves capability transfer using only a single word from the teacher per prompt. ATD probes the behavioral shadow of post-training by selecting prompts where the teacher and student's shared public ancestor is nearly indifferent between two ordinary words. A student initialized from this ancestor learns solely from the resulting prompt-word pairs, without target-task examples, teacher logits, or teacher parameters. In the primary coding experiment with Qwen2.5-1.5B, 5,664nses yield a 5.34 pp gain on HumanEval+ over an exact nuisance-matched control thadisrupts prompt-resperiments showtransfer in scientific knowledge, commonsense reasoning, and reading comprehensins across additional model generations, sizes, and families. Functional analyses show that the learned sid composable, andthat its strength tracks the teacher's update strength.
articles.titleCn: 训练后行为会在无关决策上留下痕迹
articles.abstractCn: 我们发现语言模型可以通过与任务无关的文本进行能力迁移。通常，在训练后使用特定任务的数据来改进语言模型。先前关于潜意识学习的研究表明，关于这些更新的信息可以通过无关的生成过程传递，但主要集中于使用大量教师输出的特征或偏好。我们引入了主动无任务蒸馏（ATD），它通过每个提示仅使用教师的一个单词来实现能力迁移。ATD通过选择教师和学生共享的公共祖先几乎对两个普通单词无差异的提示来探测训练后的行为阴影。从这一祖先初始化的学生仅从生成的提示-单词对中学习，无需目标任务示例、教师logits或教师参数。在Qwen2.5-1.5B的主要编码实验中，5,664个nse产生了在HumanEval+上比精确的干扰匹配对照高出5.34个百分点的增益。干扰实验表明迁移发生在科学知识、常识推理和阅读理解等多个模型生成、大小和家庭中。功能分析表明，学习到的侧边是可组合的，并且其强度与教师的更新强度相匹配。

articles.title: No More Free Lunch: Corpus Task Complexity Matters as Corpora Grow
articles.abstract: Given a large corpus, the questions one might ask can vary -- from "When was the first human heart transplant?" to "What are all the contradictory claims in this literature?" -- but what makes some questions more challenging than others? In this work, we define a notion of Corpus Task Complexity (CTC) that characterizes tasks by how their difficulty grows with corpus size; for instance, a retrieval query only requires a single linear pass over a corpus, while finding contradictions requires checking a quadratically growing set of claim pairs. Observing that prior work has largely only studied tasks whose difficulty grows linearly with corpus size, which we call low CTC tasks, we introduce 10 new tasks belonging to a class of high CTC whose difficulty grows quadratically or more in corpus size. We find that high-CTC tasks not only grow much more challenging on average at longer contexts for LCLMs, they reverse many modeling conclusions drawn solely from low-CTC evaluations. For instance, efficient block-sparse and hybrid attention approaches consistently match full attention performance on low-CTC tasks, but degrade much more on high-CTC tasks. Large-corpus high-CTC reasoning thus remains an open challenge as full attention is too costly to scale, motivating future research on these tasks. We release our code, data, and 22-task suite (CTC-Bench), to facilitate future research in this area.
articles.titleCn: 没有免费的午餐：语料库任务复杂度随语料库规模增长而变得重要
articles.abstractCn: 给定一个大型语料库，人们可能提出的问题可以多种多样——从“人类首次心脏移植是什么时候？”到“这篇文献中所有矛盾的主张是什么？”——但为什么有些问题比其他问题更具挑战性？在这项工作中，我们定义了一种语料库任务复杂度（CTC）的概念，该概念通过任务难度随语料库规模增长的方式来表征任务；例如，检索查询只需要对语料库进行一次线性遍历，而查找矛盾主张则需要检查一个随语料库规模呈二次方增长的声明对集合。观察到先前的研究主要只研究了那些难度随语料库规模线性增长的任务，我们称之为低CTC任务，我们引入了10个新的任务，这些任务属于高CTC类别，其难度在语料库规模上呈二次方或更高增长。我们发现，高CTC任务不仅在更长上下文中对LCLM的平均难度增长更大，而且它们还颠覆了许多仅基于低CTC评估得出的建模结论。例如，高效的块稀疏和混合注意力方法在低CTC任务上始终与全注意力性能相匹配，但在高CTC任务上的性能下降更为显著。因此，大型语料库高CTC推理仍然是一个开放性挑战，因为全注意力方法的成本过高难以扩展，这促使未来对这些任务的研究。我们发布了我们的代码、数据和22任务套件（CTC-Bench），以促进该领域未来的研究。

articles.title: Policy as Code: A Coroutine-Bridge Harness for Fast-Reasoning Reliability on CAR-bench
articles.abstract: CAR-bench evaluates whether tool-using agents stay reliable under real-world uncertainty, executing every tool inside the evaluator so that each tool-result exchange is a separate agent round-trip. A conventional next-action agent can batch parallel tool calls, but a chain of dependent calls costs it one model call per round of results. We present a coroutine-bridge harness in which the model's only action is to emit a Python program that blocks and resumes in place across evaluator tool exchanges. This decouples model invocation from tool round-trips: on the public test split the agent uses a median of two model calls against seven agent turns per task, resolving a full multi-turn task in a median of 1.8 s of model latency on Cerebras gpt-oss-120b. Because the action surface is executable code, deterministic CAR-bench policies are encoded directly as logic in the tool layer rather than as prompt rules, enforcing compliance at zero reasoning cost. On the official hidden evaluation the harness won Track 2 with 60.0% Pass^3, 4.5x the organizer baseline, at the lowest estimated cost and the fastest median task latency (3.14 s) of any entry scoring above that baseline; the same unchanged harness reproduced an identical 60.0% Pass^3 on GPT-5.5 in the Open track, matching frontier-model agents. A single static prompt, appended with per-task state at the tail, stays byte-identical across calls and across tasks: the frozen submission prompt served 78% of input tokens from cache (86.6% across its warm tail), against 73% over a three-week development corpus in which prompt edits repeatedly reset the cache. This compounds the few-call design into a small fraction of nominal input compute.
articles.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Technical report for the winning entry in Track 2 (Cerebras Fast-Reasoning) of the CAR-bench Challenge at IJCAI-ECAI 2026
articles.titleCn: 政策即代码：一种用于在CAR-bench上实现快速推理可靠性的协程桥接工具
articles.abstractCn: CAR-bench评估工具使用代理在现实世界不确定性下是否保持可靠性，执行评估器内的每个工具，使得每个工具结果交换成为独立的代理往返。传统的下一步行动代理可以批量并行调用工具，但依赖调用的链路会使其每轮结果消耗一个模型调用。我们提出一个协程桥接套件，其中模型的唯一动作是发出一个Python程序，该程序在评估器工具交换中阻塞和原地恢复。这使模型调用与工具往返解耦：在公共测试分割中，代理每项任务使用两次模型调用的中位数对抗七个代理回合，在Cerebras gpt-oss-120b上以1.8秒模型延迟的中位数解决完整多回合任务。由于动作表面是可执行代码，确定性CAR-bench策略直接编码为工具层的逻辑，而不是提示规则，以零推理成本强制合规。在官方隐藏评估中，该套件在Track 2中以60.0% Pass^3通过率夺冠，是组织者基线的4.5倍，具有最低估计成本和最快的任务中位数延迟（3.14秒），是所有得分高于该基线的参赛作品中表现最佳；相同的未更改套件在Open track中复现了GPT-5.5的相同60.0% Pass^3成绩，与前沿模型代理持平。单个静态提示，在尾部附加每项任务状态，跨调用和跨任务保持字节完全一致：冻结的提交提示从缓存中服务了78%的输入令牌（其预热尾部为86.6%），而在为期三周的开发语料库中，提示编辑反复重置缓存，提示覆盖率仅为73%。这种设计将少数调用整合为名义输入计算的一小部分。

articles.title: pylazaro: a Python package for anglicism extraction in Spanish
articles.abstract: Lexical borrowings are words from one language that are introduced into another language. Identifying lexical borrowings in text is a relevant task for data-centric fields in Linguistics such as lexicography or corpus linguistics, but none of the standard libraries for text processing offers such a functionality. In this paper we present pylazaro, an open-source Python package for the automatic extraction of unassimilated lexical borrowings (mostly anglicisms) from Spanish text. pylazaro offers a single interface to five sequence labeling models that were trained using different libraries, so that users can run and switch between them without having to deal with the idiosyncrasies of each library. We describe the design and usage of the package, contrast the performance of its models with that of general-purpose LLMs (which perform poorly at this task: F1 below 0.40, compared to 0.86 for the best model in pylazaro) and report on its adoption: pylazaro has been downloaded more than 58,000 times and is the library behind Observatorio Lazaro, a resource that monitors anglicism usage in the Spanish press. pylazaro can be installed via PyPI, is documented in readthedocs and can be tried through a live demo hosted on HuggingFace Spaces.
articles.titleCn: pylazaro：一个用于西班牙语英语借词提取的Python包
articles.abstractCn: 词汇借用是指从一种语言引入到另一种语言中的词语。在文本中识别词汇借用是语言学数据驱动领域（如词典编纂或语料库语言学）的相关任务，但没有任何标准文本处理库提供此类功能。在本文中，我们介绍了 pylazaro，一个用于自动从西班牙语文本中提取未同化的词汇借用（主要是英语借用词）的开源 Python 包。pylazaro 提供了一个单一接口，用于访问五个使用不同库训练的序列标注模型，以便用户可以在它们之间运行和切换，而无需处理每个库的特殊性。我们描述了该包的设计和使用方法，对比了其模型与通用大型语言模型（在该任务上表现不佳：F1 值低于 0.40，而 pylazaro 中最佳模型的 F1 值为 0.86）的性能，并报告了其应用情况：pylazaro 已被下载超过 58,000 次，并且是 Observatorio Lazaro 的底层库，后者是一个监测西班牙语媒体英语借用词使用的资源。pylazaro 可通过 PyPI 安装，文档在 readthedocs 上提供，并且可以通过 HuggingFace Spaces 上的实时演示进行试用。

articles.title: Reasoning Instructions Can Break Answer Decoding in Vision--Language Models
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) instructions can distort multiple-choice VLM evaluation when a scorer appends a reasoning cue but reads answer-label logits before the model generates any rationale. We call this CoT-prefix scoring. On ScienceQA, Qwen2.5-VL-7B drops from 80.76% to 45.48%, and across five option-content permutations 93.54% of CoT-prefix predictions select the first slot. Condition-matched linear probes recover 78.94% from the same hidden states, while free generation restores 75.24%, showing that the answer often survives the prefix and the immediate readout fails. Vocabulary and layer diagnostics explain the mismatch: probability mass moves toward continuation tokens, while answer information remains linearly accessible in late layers. The effect recurs with varying severity across datasets and models, though not universally. These results show that CoT-prefix scoring can confound model knowledge with an evaluation-interface mismatch and should be avoided unless the requested and scored output events are aligned.
articles.titleCn: 推理指令可能破坏视觉-语言模型的答案解码
articles.abstractCn: 思维链（CoT）指令会在评分者附加推理提示但读取答案标签logits之前读取模型生成的任何推理时，扭曲多选题VLM评估。我们称这种现象为CoT前缀评分。在ScienceQA上，Qwen2.5-VL-7B从80.76%下降到45.48%，在五个选项内容排列中，93.54%的CoT前缀预测选择了第一个槽位。条件匹配的线性探针从相同的隐藏状态中恢复78.94%，而自由生成恢复75.24%，表明答案通常能经受前缀的干扰，而即时读取失败。词汇和层诊断解释了这种不匹配：概率质量向延续标记移动，而答案信息在深层中仍然线性可访问。这种现象在不同数据集和模型中以不同严重程度重复出现，尽管并非普遍存在。这些结果表明，CoT前缀评分会将模型知识与评估接口不匹配混淆，除非请求的输出事件与评分事件对齐，否则应避免使用。

articles.title: Grammatical "grandmother neurons" are rare in LLMs
articles.abstract: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) encode linguistic structures remains a fundamental challenge in interpretability research. While diagnostic classifiers (or "probes") are widely used for this task, they face significant methodological criticism: training auxiliary classifiers introduces capacity confounds and calibration issues, often making it difficult to distinguish the model's intrinsic representations from the probe's ability to learn the task. To address these limitations, we introduce a probe-free framework for localizing linguistic selectivity at the individual neuron level. Leveraging the controlled contrasts of linguistic minimal pairs, we propose a Neuron Separability Index (NSI), a metric that directly quantifies how reliably single neurons differentiate grammatical from ungrammatical constructions without parameter updates. Applying NSI across 68 linguistic paradigms and seven checkpoints reveals three main patterns: 1) raw separability reaches near-peak levels earlier for morphological and syntactic distinctions than for syntax-semantics interface and conceptual distinctions. 2) after permutation normalization, single-unit selectivity is sparse, weak, and narrowly tuned: only a small fraction of units are sensitive to an average paradigm, and strongly selective "grandmother neurons" are rare. 3) whole-vector linear separability, single-neuron selectivity, and behavioral competence are largely dissociated, and targeted ablations further separate activation selectivity from causal reliance.
articles.titleCn: 在LLMs中，语法“祖母神经元”很罕见
articles.abstractCn: 理解大型语言模型（LLMs）如何编码语言结构仍然是可解释性研究中的一个基本挑战。虽然诊断分类器（或“探针”）被广泛用于这项任务，但它们面临着显著的方法论批评：训练辅助分类器会引入能力混淆和校准问题，通常使得难以区分模型的内在表征与探针学习任务的能力。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了一种无探针框架，用于在单个神经元级别定位语言选择性。利用语言最小对的控制对比，我们提出了神经元可分离性指数（NSI），这是一个直接量化单个神经元在不更新参数的情况下可靠地区分语法结构与非语法结构的指标。应用NSI跨越68种语言范式和七个检查点揭示了三种主要模式：1）原始可分离性在形态学和句法区分上比句法-语义界面和概念区分更早达到接近峰值水平。2）经过置换归一化后，单单元选择性是稀疏的、微弱的、且调谐范围狭窄：只有一小部分单元对平均范式敏感，而高度选择性的“祖母神经元”很少见。3）整体向量线性可分离性、单神经元选择性和行为能力在很大程度上是分离的，而靶向消融进一步将激活选择性与因果依赖性分离开。

articles.title: Where LLM Graders Succeed and Break: Evidence from Two Computer-Science Exams
articles.abstract: One long-form exam in a large course costs hundreds of grader-hours, and qualified graders are scarce; LLM graders are a tempting alternative. To show its pitfalls we grade a practical Computer Vision exam ($570$ dual-graded students) under $171$ configurations spanning closed and open-weights models; the best reaches mean absolute error $1.64/35$, below the $2.61/35$ two human graders achieve against each other. The catch is the prompt: a short ''strict grader'' preamble drives $14$ of $17$ open-weights models out of the graded band ($\text{MAE} \ge 8$), three stopping grading altogether. The damage traces to the preamble's two credit-withholding sentences, not to tone or model scale; one of them, ''never give partial credit'', alone makes two of three probed models stop grading. The closed flagships of three vendors shift calibration under it but stay in the band. In $162$ further configurations on a second, independent Machine Learning exam from another course ($1{,}038$ dual-graded students), the preamble worsens ten models, moving three out of the band into collapse and one into refusal, yet improves seven whose neutral prompts over-mark: the vulnerability replicates, but its direction is exam-specific. Light LoRA fine-tuning repairs it: one adapter on the two exams' pooled $\sim 3{,}900$ graded examples brings five small open models to parity or better with a human grader in agreement with the grader pair, and sensitivity to the three harsh personas nearly vanishes ($\le 0.32$ MAE). We release the anonymised dataset, full ablation grid, and grading, fine-tuning and analysis pipelines.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型评分器成功与失败之处：来自两次计算机科学考试的证据
articles.abstractCn: 一门大型课程中的一场长式考试需要耗费数百个评分小时，而合格的评分员却稀缺；大型语言模型评分器成为一种诱人的替代方案。为了展示其弊端，我们在涵盖封闭式和开放式权重模型的171种配置下，对一场实际计算机视觉考试（570名双评分学生）进行了评分；最佳模型的平均绝对误差达到1.64/35，低于两名人类评分员相互评分的2.61/35。问题在于提示语：一个简短的“严格评分员”开场白导致17个开放式权重模型中的14个被排除在评分范围之外（MAE ≥ 8），其中三个完全停止评分。损害源于开场白中的两句扣分句，而非语气或模型规模；其中一句“从不给部分分数”，单独就使三分之二被测试的模型停止评分。三家供应商的封闭式旗舰模型在开场白下调整了校准，但仍然保持在评分范围内。在另一门课程中进行的第二场独立机器学习考试上的162种进一步配置（1038名双评分学生）中，开场白使十个模型恶化，将三个模型从评分范围拖入崩溃，一个进入拒绝，但同时也使七个因中性提示过度评分而受益的模型得到改善：这种脆弱性被复制，但其方向具有考试特定性。轻量级LoRA微调可以修复这一问题：在两场考试合并的约3,900个评分示例上使用一个适配器，使五个小型开放式模型在评分员对评分结果达成一致的情况下达到或优于人类评分员的水平，并且对三种严厉人格的敏感性几乎消失（≤ 0.32 MAE）。我们发布了匿名数据集、完整的消融网格、评分、微调和分析流程。

articles.title: ArGuard Shared Task: Harmful Content Detection in Arabic Memes and LLM Prompts
articles.abstract: ArGuard is a shared task on harmful content detection in Arabic memes and LLM prompts. It includes two tracks: Track A focuses on multimodal hate detection in Arabic memes, while Track B addresses harmful prompt detection for Arabic LLM safety evaluation. In total, 58 teams registered, 35 participated in the final evaluation, and 27 submitted system-description papers. Participating teams explored models such as AraBERT, Jais, and Qwen3-VL. The best systems achieved macro-F1 scores of 0.823 on A1, 0.419 on A2, 0.984 on B1, and 0.790 on B2. Fine-grained meme classification in A2 was the most challenging setting, partly due to sparse labels and train-test distribution shifts.
articles.titleCn: ArGuard共享任务：阿拉伯表情包和LLM提示中的有害内容检测
articles.abstractCn: ArGuard是一项关于阿拉伯表情包和LLM提示中危害内容检测的共享任务，包含两个赛道：赛道A专注于阿拉伯表情包中的多模态仇恨检测，而赛道B则针对阿拉伯LLM安全评估中的有害提示检测。共有58支队伍注册，35支队伍参与了最终评估，27支队伍提交了系统描述论文。参赛队伍探索了AraBERT、Jais和Qwen3-VL等模型。最佳系统在A1上达到了0.823的宏观F1分数，在A2上达到了0.419，在B1上达到了0.984，在B2上达到了0.790。A2中的细粒度表情包分类是最具挑战性的场景，部分原因是标签稀疏和训练-测试分布偏移。

articles.title: Parts-of-Speech as Emergent Categories in SAE Latent Space
articles.abstract: Sparse AutoEncoders (SAEs) offer a promising way to inspect language model representations, but it is still unclear what kind of linguistic structure their latents expose. We use part-of-speech (PoS) categories as a controlled test case to study whether morpho-syntactic information is encoded by individual latents or by structured groups of features. We find that PoS distinctions are highly recoverable from SAE activations, but do not align with one-to-one latent / category mappings. This recoverability is not reducible to lexical memorisation, and Open and Closed PoS classes differ substantially. Categories are supported by compact groups of sparse latents, with substantial variation across tags. These groups remain stable on held-out data, while also showing overlap between related categories. Our results show that SAEs localise morpho-syntactic information in a distributed and category-dependent form rather than through atomic grammatical features.
articles.titleCn: 词性在SAE潜在空间中的涌现类别
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）为检查语言模型表示提供了一种有前景的方法，但它们所暴露的潜在结构中的语言结构类型仍不明确。我们使用词性（PoS）类别作为受控测试案例，研究形态句法信息是否由单个潜在或结构化的特征组编码。我们发现，词性区别可以从SAE激活中高度恢复，但并不与潜在/类别的一对一映射一致。这种可恢复性不能简化为词汇记忆，开放类和封闭类存在显著差异。类别由紧凑的稀疏潜在组支持，不同词性之间存在大量变化。这些组在保留数据上保持稳定，同时在相关类别之间也显示出重叠。我们的结果表明，SAEs以分布式和类别依赖的形式定位形态句法信息，而不是通过原子语法特征。

articles.title: From Policy Documents to Structured Survey Responses: Evaluating Large Language Models for Policy Monitoring
articles.abstract: Science, technology, and innovation policies are crucial for competitiveness, yet their diversity and scale make them difficult to map and monitor consistently. Existing approaches rely heavily on manual survey efforts, which are costly and challenging to scale across countries. Large language models (LLMs) enable new possibilities for extracting and structuring information from long and unstructured policy documents. This paper presents an application of LLMs as "AI respondents" for generating structured survey responses from policy texts. We develop a data extraction pipeline based on long-context in-context learning to map information from public web sources into predefined survey categories, including policy instruments, target groups, and thematic areas. The pipeline integrates a validation step using a secondary LLM to assess relevance and evidence, alongside comparisons with human-provided responses. Using a multi-country dataset, we evaluate the alignment between LLM-generated and human-generated outputs through overlap measures and cross-validation. Results show that LLMs achieve high agreement for structured indicators (84-95%), while differences remain in free-text fields, where models tend to provide more detailed procedural descriptions. These findings highlight the potential of hybrid human-AI workflows for policy monitoring, improving both efficiency and scalability while maintaining the need for human validation and contextual interpretation.
