articles.titleCn: 从政策文件到结构化调查问卷：评估大型语言模型在政策监测中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 科技创新政策对于提升竞争力至关重要，但其多样性和规模使得对其进行系统性的映射和监控成为难题。现有方法高度依赖人工调研，这不仅成本高昂，而且难以跨国家推广。大型语言模型（LLMs）为从冗长且非结构化的政策文件中提取和结构化信息提供了新的可能性。本文提出将LLMs应用于生成结构化调研响应，充当“AI调研员”从政策文本中生成结构化调研结果。我们基于长上下文情境学习开发了一个数据提取流程，将公开网络资源中的信息映射到预定义的调研类别中，包括政策工具、目标群体和主题领域。该流程集成了使用第二个LLM进行验证的步骤，以评估相关性和证据，并与人类提供的调研结果进行比较。通过一个多国数据集，我们通过重叠指标和交叉验证评估了LLM生成结果与人类生成结果的一致性。结果显示，LLMs在结构化指标上达到了高度一致性（84-95%），但在自由文本字段中仍存在差异，模型倾向于提供更详细的程序性描述。这些发现突出了混合人机工作流程在政策监控中的潜力，既提高了效率与可扩展性，同时也强调了人类验证和情境解释的必要性。

articles.title: BanglaTurn: A Benchmark and Whisper-Based Model for End-of-Turn Detection in Bangla Speech
articles.abstract: This paper presents BanglaTurn, a corpus for end-of-turn detection in Bangla conversational speech, and a model trained on it. The corpus holds 35,374 samples of 3 to 15 s of podcast speech, labelled for turn state by combining speaker diarization with an LLM pass, with every label then checked by a human annotator. The model pairs a Whisper encoder with task-specific classification heads. On a class-balanced test set drawn from a held-out podcast, it reaches 84.33% accuracy (95% CI 80.3 to 88.1) against 69.28% for the Smart-Turn v3 baseline, and lowers the false negative rate from 51.57% to 7.55% at the cost of a higher false positive rate. We report what encoder layer fine-tuning, multi-scale pooling and INT8 quantization each contribute, and latency stays within 165 to 191 ms end to end on CPU.
articles.titleCn: BanglaTurn：一个用于孟加拉语音末尾检测的基准和基于Whisper的模型
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了BanglaTurn，一个用于孟加拉语对话语音的回合结束检测语料库，以及基于该语料库训练的模型。该语料库包含35,374个3至15秒的播客语音样本，通过结合说话人分离和大型语言模型（LLM）处理进行回合状态标注，每个标签均由人工标注员进行检查。该模型结合了Whisper编码器和特定任务的分类头。在一个从保留播客中抽取的平衡类测试集上，其准确率达到84.33%（95%置信区间为80.3至88.1），而Smart-Turn v3基线的准确率为69.28%，并且将假阴性率从51.57%降低到7.55%，代价是假阳性率有所提高。我们报告了编码器层微调、多尺度池化和INT8量化的各自贡献，端到端在CPU上的延迟保持在165至191毫秒之间。

articles.title: Likelihood Ranking doesn't Scale Like Prompting in LLMs
articles.abstract: LLM evaluation is commonly performed either by prompting models to produce answers or by scoring candidate outputs with likelihood-based metrics. In multiple-choice QA, however, standard likelihood-based scoring is still conditioned on the question and answer set, and can therefore leverage the same task-conditioned answer-selection interface used in prompting. We study a complementary protocol based on likelihood ranking of declarative statements constructed from the same question--answer pairs. Across 95 decoder-only models, ranging from 0.1B to 104B parameters, and 10 MCQA datasets, we find a systematic divergence between declarative-statement likelihood ranking and prompted answering. Statement-likelihood accuracy remains comparatively stable across scale, whereas prompted answering improves sharply with scale and instruction-tuning. These results suggest that likelihood preferences over controlled declarative alternatives and task-conditioned answer selection probe distinct aspects of model behavior, and should not be treated as interchangeable.
articles.titleCn: 似然排序在大型语言模型中不像提示那样可扩展
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的评估通常通过提示模型生成答案或使用基于似然的指标对候选输出进行评分来完成。然而，在多项选择题问答中，标准的基于似然的评分仍然依赖于问题和答案集，因此可以利用与提示相同的任务条件答案选择界面。我们研究了一种基于从相同问答对构建的声明性语句的似然排序的补充协议。在95个从0.1B到104B参数范围的解码器模型和10个MCQA数据集上，我们发现声明性语句的似然排序与提示回答之间存在系统性的差异。语句似然准确率在规模上保持相对稳定，而提示回答随着规模和指令调优的改进则非常显著。这些结果表明，对受控声明性替代的似然偏好和任务条件答案选择探测了模型行为的不同方面，不应被视为可互换的。

articles.title: Baseline Shape Decides the Verdict: A Controlled Re-Examination of Ternary Language Models at 60K Parameters
articles.abstract: Ternary (1.58-bit) weights are attractive for microcontroller-class language models, but the sub-1M-parameter regime rests mainly on isolated, single-seed comparisons. One prominent example reports that a routed ternary block (convolution, diagonal SSM and sparse attention mixed by a per-token router) beats a parameter-matched full-precision transformer by 22% at 60K parameters, attributing this to inductive bias. We re-run it under one fixed recipe, three seeds per cell, 98 byte-level runs on one laptop. (i) Baseline shape dominates: at a 16M-byte budget, param-matched transformers span 22.6% in validation loss purely by depth/width choice - far more than any architecture effect we measure there - and the best-shaped transformer ties the routed model, so the published margin is at least partly a baseline-shape effect; the ordering of shapes reverses with budget, so no single fixed shape can be trusted. (ii) At 130M bytes the routed model does win, by 22.2-24.0% over the three transformer shapes we evaluate there - but a plain gated diagonal-SSM block beats it by a further 9.1%, and the routed model's own router puts most of its weight on its recurrent pathway, so the gain does not require routing. (iii) The ternary penalty differs by architecture at the larger budget (+5.3% best transformer vs. +19.5% routed, +28.1% gated SSM), but we cannot attribute that to architecture alone: our transformers keep learned positional embeddings in full precision, 11-22% of their parameters, so they are less quantized than the models they are compared with. (iv) A 90/10 full-precision-then-ternary schedule beats all-ternary training, but only at a stage-2 learning rate about 10x the pretraining peak; at a conventional fine-tuning rate it looks 15.3% worse, reversing the conclusion. The from-scratch baseline was not itself learning-rate tuned, which bounds (iii) and (iv). Code and run logs released.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Code and run logs: https://github.com/veldanda/ByteLM (tag p1-v1). Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22937824
articles.titleCn: 基线形状决定结果：对60K参数三元语言模型的受控再检验
articles.abstractCn: 三进制（1.58位）权重对微控制器类语言模型很有吸引力，但低于100万参数的范围主要依赖于孤立的单一种子比较。一个突出的例子报告称，一个路由的三进制块（卷积、对角SSM和由每个token路由器混合的稀疏注意力）在6万个参数时比参数匹配的全精度Transformer性能提升22%，归因于归纳偏差。我们在一个固定的配方下重新运行了该实验，每个单元三个种子，在一台笔记本电脑上进行了98次字节级别的运行。（i）基准形状占主导地位：在16MB字节的预算下，参数匹配的Transformer仅通过深度/宽度选择在验证损失上占22.6% - 远超过我们在此测量的任何架构效应 - 并且最佳形状的Transformer与路由模型持平，因此发表的差距至少部分是基准形状效应；随着预算的增加，形状的顺序会反转，因此没有单一的固定形状可以信赖。（ii）在130MB字节时，路由模型确实获胜，比我们评估的三个Transformer形状高22.2-24.0% - 但一个普通的门控对角SSM块比它高9.1%，并且路由模型自己的路由器将其大部分权重放在其递归路径上，因此这种增益并不需要路由。（iii）三进制惩罚在较大预算下因架构而异（最佳Transformer比路由高+5.3%，比门控SSM高+28.1%），但我们不能将其完全归因于架构：我们的Transformer保留全部精度的学习位置嵌入，占其参数的11-22%，因此它们比与之比较的模型量化程度较低。（iv）一个90/10全精度然后三进制的训练计划优于全三进制训练，但仅在阶段2的学习率约为预训练峰值的10倍时有效；在常规微调速率下，它看起来比全三进制训练差15.3%，从而反转了结论。从头开始的基准本身没有进行学习率调整，这限制了（iii）和（iv）。代码和运行日志已公开。

articles.title: Large Language Models for Programming: Actually Fixing or Reimplementing Incorrect Code?
articles.abstract: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models can effectively solve problems and fix bugs in diverse programming environments, including competitive programming. Existing approaches primarily evaluate LLM performance in problem solving or bug fixing independently, but do not explore the relationship between these two capabilities. This work focuses on determining how much the LLM deviates from a buggy solution to fix the bug compared to a human-written patch, and if there is a bias towards generating entirely new solutions. We construct a dataset with all the submissions ($\sim$ 3000) from a couple of users from Codeforces, and we match each buggy submission with its corresponding human fix. By using the similarity between the buggy solution and the human fix as a baseline, we evaluate the quality of LLM-generated bug fixes on 3 OpenAI GPT models (gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5.1). We check if the generated solutions solve the problem by using the Codeforces-R1 dataset, an openly available dataset that has tests generated with the DeepSeek-R1 model. Our findings suggest that LLMs tend to modify more lines than necessary compared to human fixes and, in some cases, generate entirely new solutions. We also observe that LLMs solve more problems correctly when allowed to generate solutions from scratch rather than patch buggy submissions, even when those submissions are close to the human patch. This has important implications for the design of AI-assisted programming tools, particularly in supporting user debugging processes and promoting incremental problem-solving strategies rather than solution replacement.
articles.titleCn: 编程领域的大型语言模型：实际修复还是重新实现错误代码？
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究表明，大型语言模型能有效解决不同编程环境中的问题并修复错误，包括竞赛编程。现有方法主要独立评估语言模型在问题解决或错误修复方面的性能，但未探索这两种能力之间的关系。本研究着重于确定语言模型在修复错误时与人类编写的补丁相比，偏离错误解决方案的程度，以及是否存在生成全新解决方案的倾向。我们构建了一个包含若干Codeforces用户所有提交（约3000条）的数据集，并将每条错误提交与其对应的人类修复匹配。通过将错误解决方案与人类修复之间的相似度作为基准，我们在3个OpenAI GPT模型（gpt-5-nano、gpt-5-mini、gpt-5.1）上评估了语言模型生成的错误修复质量。我们使用Codeforces-R1数据集检查生成的解决方案是否解决问题，该数据集是公开可用的，包含使用DeepSeek-R1模型生成的测试。我们的研究发现，与人类修复相比，语言模型往往会修改更多不必要的代码行，甚至在某些情况下生成全新的解决方案。我们还观察到，当允许语言模型从头开始生成解决方案而非修补错误提交时，即使这些提交接近人类补丁，语言模型能正确解决问题的概率更高。这对AI辅助编程工具的设计具有重要启示，特别是在支持用户调试过程和推广增量问题解决策略而非解决方案替换方面。

articles.title: Controlling Backchannels in Streamable Full-duplex Models
articles.abstract: Backchannels, brief acknowledgements like "uh-huh" produced while the other party may still be talking, are central to natural conversation, but full-duplex spoken dialogue models rarely model them explicitly. We introduce a lightweight backchannel head that predicts, from a full-duplex model's own hidden states, when a backchannel should begin. Once this probability crosses a tunable threshold, a backchannel is force-decoded. Attached to both a 7B (PersonaPlex) and a 1B (F-Actor) model, it generalizes across scale. Probing confirms the hidden states anticipate real human timing, and generation evaluation shows more frequent, better-timed backchannels. Human raters judge the resulting backchannels on par with real ones.
articles.titleCn: 控制可流式全双工模型中的回声通道
articles.abstractCn: 回声反馈，如“嗯嗯”等在对方可能仍在说话时产生的简短确认，是自然对话的核心，但全双工语音对话模型很少明确建模它们。我们引入了一个轻量级的回声反馈头，该头从全双工模型的隐藏状态中预测何时应开始回声反馈。一旦该概率超过可调节的阈值，就会强制解码回声反馈。将其分别附加到7B（PersonaPlex）和1B（F-Actor）模型上，实现了跨规模的泛化。探测实验证实了隐藏状态能预测真实人类的时机，生成评估显示更频繁、时机更好的回声反馈。人类评估者对生成的回声反馈的评价与真实回声反馈相当。

articles.title: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe
articles.abstract: Rufus-Air is an open and reproducible post-training recipe on GLM-4.5-Air-Base (106B-A12B), organized as a serial pipeline of eight stages: SFT, Reasoning RL, Coding RL, Instruction-Following RL, General Agent, Coding Agent, Search Agent, and RLHF. We document the data, reward design, infrastructure, stage order, and stagewise results needed to reproduce the recipe. Stages progress from basic to advanced capabilities and from hard, verifiable rewards to softer judge-based signals. Training builds on open-source components and public data, much of it used as released, without new human annotation or an in-house distillation teacher. Our main findings are that (i) diverse, high-quality SFT establishes a strong capability floor; (ii) difficulty filtering keeps RL prompts within a productive learning range; (iii) reward reliability provides a practical principle for ordering stages; and (iv) infrastructure and engineering choices are part of the recipe, not just an implementation detail. Rufus-Air improves over the official GLM-4.5-Air post-trained release and is competitive with similarly sized open models.
articles.comment: 47 pages, 9 figures, 20 tables. Authors are listed alphabetically by surname; all contributed while at Amazon. The two authors named Zixuan Zhang are different people
articles.titleCn: Rufus-Air：一个开放的大型语言模型训练后微调方案
articles.abstractCn: Rufus-Air是一个基于GLM-4.5-Air-Base（106B-A12B）的开源且可复现的微调训练流程，其组织为一个包含八个阶段的串行流水线：SFT（监督微调）、推理强化学习、编码强化学习、指令遵循强化学习、通用智能体、编码智能体、搜索智能体和RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）。我们记录了所需的数据、奖励设计、基础设施、阶段顺序和各阶段结果，以复现该流程。各阶段从基础能力逐步提升至高级能力，从难以验证的奖励过渡到基于判定的柔和信号。训练基于开源组件和公开数据，其中大部分数据直接使用，无需新的人工标注或内部蒸馏教师。我们的主要发现是：(i) 多样化、高质量的SFT奠定了强大的能力基础；(ii) 难度过滤将强化学习提示保持在有效的学习范围内；(iii) 奖励可靠性为阶段排序提供了实用原则；(iv) 基础设施和工程选择是流程的一部分，而不仅仅是实现细节。Rufus-Air在官方GLM-4.5-Air微调发布版本上有所改进，并与同等规模的开放模型具有竞争力。

articles.title: agentic-ger: terminology recovery in long-form speech using global context
articles.abstract: Recent advances in speech language models have improved automatic speech recognition (ASR) for long-form audio. However, accurately and consistently transcribing domain-specific terminology remains challenging. Motivated by the world knowledge and contextual capability of large language models (LLMs), we propose Agentic-GER, an LLM-based agent for terminology correction in long-form speech. The agent uses global context from the full transcript to identify suspicious terms and resolve ambiguous hypotheses. It selectively re-transcribes the source speech to check candidate corrections, and uses accepted edits to guide subsequent decisions. Experiments with four LLMs and two ASR systems on GigaSpeechBench show consistent terminology improvements in both Chinese and English, with and without thinking. On Chinese speech, Agentic-GER achieves up to a 36.8% relative reduction in biased character error rate (B-CER) over the Whisper baseline.
articles.titleCn: 基于全局上下文的长期语音术语恢复
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，语音语言模型的发展提升了长音频自动语音识别（ASR）的性能。然而，准确且一致地转录特定领域的术语仍然是一个挑战。受大型语言模型（LLMs）的世界知识和上下文能力启发，我们提出了Agentic-GER，一个基于LLMs的用于长音频术语修正的智能体。该智能体利用完整转录稿的全局上下文来识别可疑术语并解决模糊假设。它选择性地重新转录源语音以检查候选修正，并使用接受的编辑来指导后续决策。在GigaSpeechBench上使用四种LLMs和两种ASR系统的实验表明，无论是否进行思考，中英文术语转录均有持续改进。在中文语音上，Agentic-GER相较于Whisper基线实现了高达36.8%的偏向字符错误率（B-CER）相对降低。

articles.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
articles.abstract: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchmarks Jev on ten alignment failures: sycophancy, jailbreaks, deception, prompt injection, hallucination, privacy violation, social bias, reward hacking, concealing uncertainty, and power seeking. It spans 44 benchmarks and five target models, labelled by each benchmark's scorer and, on two, by humans. Many of these failures are relational, defined against a reference, such as the user's belief or an injected instruction, that the response alone does not reveal. Our key idea is therefore to vary what Jev is asked separately from what it sees: the question's wording and answer type on one side, the fields of the input on the other. A single generic question reaches a median AUROC of 0.886 zero-shot and beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks. Question wording matters little, while context matters more, mostly through fields that encode the label. Jev matches the reference scorer's agreement with human labels, surfaces label defects in existing benchmarks, and costs 63x less than LLM-judge scorers. Code and data: https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench.
articles.titleCn: 只需问杰夫：用于校准决策的强化学习作为零样本检测AI对齐失败的检测器
articles.abstractCn: 对齐失败的检测器筛选部署的语言模型并评分对齐基准。大多数是生成式判别器，它们对每个标准都进行一次解码过程，以及像Llama Guard这样的读取标记概率的分类器，每次调用仍然只评分一个固定标签。Jev是一个使用强化学习训练以进行校准决策（RLCD）的模型，它可以在一次调用中对一个输入回答许多类型的问题，并以校准的概率回答。它是否检测到对齐失败尚未被测量。我们提出了RLCDAlignBench，它对Jev在十个对齐失败上进行基准测试：奉承、越狱、欺骗、提示注入、幻觉、隐私侵犯、社会偏见、奖励黑客、隐藏不确定性以及权力寻求。它涵盖44个基准和五个目标模型，由每个基准的评分者标记，并且在两个基准上由人类标记。其中许多失败是关系性的，它们相对于一个参考定义，例如用户的信念或注入的指令，仅凭响应无法揭示。因此，我们的关键思想是分别改变Jev被问及的内容和它所看到的内容：一方面是问题的措辞和答案类型，另一方面是输入的字段。一个通用的单一问题达到了0.886的中位数AUROC零样本，并在大多数基准上击败了监督基线。问题的措辞影响不大，而上下文更重要，主要通过编码标签的字段来实现。Jev与参考评分者对人类标签的同意程度相匹配，揭示了现有基准中的标签缺陷，并且比LLM判别器评分器便宜63倍。代码和数据：https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench。

articles.title: IterSynth: Rethinking Deep Search Agents via Role-Decoupled Iterative Synthesis
articles.abstract: Deep search requires LLM agents to decompose complex queries, search for evidence, and synthesize grounded answers, yet existing ReAct-style agents suffer from two limitations: role coupling, where one policy must handle planning, evidence use, and synthesis; and context accumulation, where growing search histories introduce noise and obscure useful information. To address these issues, we propose IterSynth, a role-decoupled and summary-based paradigm that alternates between a Planner for identifying information needs and a Synthesizer for integrating evidence into an evolving summary state. This design separates planning from synthesis while using the summary as the persistent state of search, reducing both capability coupling and context noise. To train IterSynth effectively, we further introduce Role-Decoupled Policy Optimization (RDPO) for reinforcement learning, which combines terminal outcome rewards with turn-level rubric evaluations and computes role-specific advantages for more precise credit assignment. Experiments on five long-horizon deep-search benchmarks such as BrowseComp and Xbench-DS show that IterSynth-8B achieves an average score of 50.7, surpassing the strongest prior $\leq$8B agent by +4.2\%. Moreover, IterSynth serves as a model-agnostic prompting paradigm, delivering substantial zero-shot gains over ReAct and similar prompting paradigms on frontier proprietary models.
articles.titleCn: IterSynth：通过角色解耦迭代合成重新思考深度搜索代理
articles.abstractCn: 深度搜索需要大型语言模型代理分解复杂查询、搜索证据并整合基于事实的答案，但现有的ReAct风格代理存在两个局限性：角色耦合，即一个策略必须处理规划、证据使用和整合；以及上下文累积，即不断增长搜索历史会引入噪声并掩盖有用信息。为解决这些问题，我们提出了IterSynth，这是一种角色解耦和基于摘要的范式，它交替在用于识别信息需求的规划器和用于将证据整合到不断发展的摘要状态中的整合器之间切换。这种设计将规划与整合分离，同时使用摘要作为搜索的持久状态，从而减少了能力耦合和上下文噪声。为了有效地训练IterSynth，我们进一步引入了用于强化学习的角色解耦策略优化（RDPO），它结合了终端结果奖励和回合级评分评估，并计算特定角色的优势，以实现更精确的归因。在BrowseComp和Xbench-DS等五个长时程深度搜索基准测试上的实验表明，IterSynth-8B实现了平均分50.7，超越了最强的先前$\leq$8B代理+4.2%。此外，IterSynth是一种模型无关的提示范式，在前沿专有模型上，它比ReAct和类似的提示范式实现了显著的零样本增益。

articles.title: Two Emojis of Difference: What Multilingual Affective Generation Benchmarks Actually Measure
articles.abstract: We audit a multilingual affective generation benchmark eight instruction-tuned LLMs producing emoji summaries for 17,100 Bangla, English and Hindi sentences, with 6,960 human judgements and find its headline conclusions to be artefacts of the measurement instrument rather than properties of the systems. Treating annotators as a random rather than a fixed factor, no system differs significantly from any other ($F(7,14)=0.59$, $p=0.76$), although the conventional analysis declares 19 of 28 pairwise differences significant. Annotator identity explains far more rating variance than system identity, and the winning system changes whenever any single annotator is removed. The ordering that does emerge tracks output length: mean emoji count explains 78.7\% of between-system variance, and a within-item length-matched comparison over 2,599 pairs reverses the leaderboard. We further show that cross-provider anisotropy differences vanish under mean-centring, that per-language token costs change sign with the normalising unit, and that multi-view row-wise splits inflate macro-F1 by $3.1$ points and change the top-ranked system. In place of preference scoring we propose **emoji-affect decodability**, a reference-based probe whose rankings are stable to $\pm0.003$ macro-F1 across seeds.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, accpeted in 6TH MULTILINGUAL REPRESENTATION LEARNING (MRL) WORKSHOP 2026 at EMNLP 2026 in Budapest, Hungary
articles.titleCn: 两种不同的表情符号：多语言情感生成基准测试实际上衡量了什么
articles.abstractCn: 我们审计了一个多语言情感生成基准，该基准包含八种指令调优的大型语言模型，为17,100句孟加拉语、英语和印地语句子生成表情符号摘要，并收集了6,960个人类判断。我们发现其头条结论是测量工具的产物，而非系统本身的属性。将标注者视为随机因素而非固定因素时，没有系统与其他系统存在显著差异（$F(7,14)=0.59$，$p=0.76$），尽管传统分析宣称28对差异中有19对具有显著性。标注者身份解释的评分方差远大于系统身份，且只要移除任何一个标注者，获胜系统就会发生变化。确实出现的排序与输出长度相关：平均表情符号数量解释了系统间78.7%的方差，而在2,599对项内长度匹配的比较中，排行榜被逆转。我们进一步表明，跨提供商各向异性差异在均值中心化后会消失，每语言标记成本会随归一化单位改变符号，且多视角行分割会使宏观F1提升3.1分并改变排名第一的系统。我们提议用**表情符号情感解码性**替代偏好评分，这是一种基于参考的探测方法，其排名在种子间稳定在±0.003宏观F1范围内。

articles.title: YODAS v3: Over 1 Million Hours of High-Bandwidth, Stereophonic, Multilingual Speech
articles.abstract: We present YODAS v3, a weakly-labeled speech corpus containing over 1.1 million hours of 48kHz multi-channel audio in 147 languages, released under a CC BY 3.0 license. YODAS v3 is not only the largest open speech dataset to date, but also the first truly large-scale speech corpus with high-fidelity stereo audio. We first provide the collection methodology for the corpus, where we introduce new techniques for gathering language-balanced speech data. The effectiveness of our approach is shown by the language distribution of the crawled data: 22 languages in YODAS v3 have over 10K hours and 73 languages have over 5K hours of data. We then conduct extensive analyses on the composition of the data, such as the distribution of languages, audio quality, and transcription quality. Finally, we train baseline speech recognition and neural codec models to show the effectiveness of the dataset. Download at https://huggingface.co/datasets/espnet/yodas3.
articles.titleCn: YODAS v3：超过一百万小时的高带宽、立体声、多语言语音
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了YODAS v3，一个包含147种语言的弱标签语音语料库，总时长超过110万小时，采样率为48kHz的多通道音频，并在CC BY 3.0许可证下发布。YODAS v3不仅是迄今为止最大的开放语音数据集，也是首个真正的大规模高保真立体语音语料库。我们首先提供了语料库的收集方法，其中介绍了平衡语言语音数据的新技术。我们收集的数据语言分布证明了该方法的有效性：YODAS v3中有22种语言的数据超过10,000小时，73种语言的数据超过5,000小时。随后，我们对数据的构成进行了广泛分析，包括语言分布、音频质量和转录质量。最后，我们训练了基线语音识别和神经编码器模型，以展示该数据集的有效性。下载地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/espnet/yodas3。

articles.title: CodeGraph: Open-Taxonomy Knowledge Graph for Source Code with Wikidata Grounding
articles.abstract: Public software repositories, like GitHub and Software Heritage Archive, store billions of files, yet extracting their implicit engineering knowledge ---i.e., the algorithms they implement, the paradigms they follow, the patterns they instantiate, and the application domains they serve--- remains challenging, as current tools are constrained to syntactic and token-level analysis. We present a pipeline for building an open-taxonomy semantic annotation of source code using a code-specialised Large Language Model. The extracted entities are grounded in Wikidata through a three-stage linking procedure: a deterministic SPARQL stage handles unambiguous entities, a Deep Research Agent resolves the residual long tail, and a hierarchy-rollup stage imports the parent-of closure of each resolved Wikidata identifier. The resulting annotations are materialised as a source-code-specific open-taxonomy knowledge graph. We further introduce a calibrated quality-assurance protocol that quantifies annotation precision by combining a small human gold set with an LLM-as-a-judge filter. We applied our pipeline to the 167 million files of the Stack-Edu corpus, creating the first known large-scale open-taxonomy knowledge graph for source code. Our graph, named CodeGraph, contains approximately 158 million nodes, which include around 145 million files, about 63,000 extracted concept entities (such as algorithms, paradigms, design patterns, and application domains), and roughly 19,800 grounded Wikidata entities. Furthermore, CodeGraph features approximately 1 billion typed edges that connect files to their respective concepts, link these concepts to their grounded Wikidata identifiers, and relate them to their parent categories, covering 14 programming languages.
articles.titleCn: CodeGraph：基于Wikidata锚定的开源分类法知识图谱
articles.abstractCn: 公共软件仓库，如GitHub和软件遗产存档库，存储着数十亿个文件，然而提取其隐含的工程知识——即它们实现的算法、遵循的范式、实例化的模式以及服务的应用领域——仍然具有挑战性，因为当前工具仅限于句法和词元级分析。我们提出了一种使用代码专用大型语言模型构建开放分类法语义标注源代码的流程。提取出的实体通过三阶段链接程序与Wikidata关联：确定性SPARQL阶段处理无歧义实体，深度研究代理解决残余长尾问题，层级汇总阶段导入每个已解析Wikidata标识符的父级闭包。最终生成的标注以特定源代码的开放分类法知识图谱形式呈现。我们进一步引入了一种校准的质量保证协议，通过结合少量人工黄金集和LLM作为裁判的过滤器来量化标注的精确度。我们将该流程应用于Stack-Edu语料库的1.67亿个文件，创建了首个已知的大规模开放分类法源代码知识图谱。我们的图谱名为CodeGraph，包含约1.58亿个节点，其中包括约1.45亿个文件、约6.3万个提取出的概念实体（如算法、范式、设计模式和应用领域），以及约1.98万个体化的Wikidata实体。此外，CodeGraph具有约10亿个带类型的边，这些边连接文件与其各自的概念，将这些概念链接到其已关联的Wikidata标识符，并将它们与其父类别关联，覆盖了14种编程语言。

articles.title: TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026: A Fine-Tuned Surface Tagger for Arabic Machine-Translation Error-Span Detection and Classification
articles.abstract: We present TTLab's submission to the AlexandriaX-2026 Subtask~3 on Arabic MT error span detection and classification. Our system frames the task as token-level classification over surface forms, preserving character offsets to ensure exact alignment with the evaluation metric. To handle severe label imbalance, we employ a focal loss with class weighting and dialect-specific decoding thresholds. Among six Arabic pre-trained encoders, MARBERTv2 achieves the best overall performance of 40.8 and 40.91 on the development and test set, respectively, ranking $\nth{3}$ out of all participating teams. While our system localizes error spans effectively, classification of rare error types remains challenging, highlighting the need for data augmentation for tail categories. The code is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/arabic-dialectal-mt-error-span-detection}{\faGithub~ TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026}$
articles.comment: Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026, shared task AlexandriaX-2026
articles.titleCn: 亚历山大X-2026的TTLab：用于阿拉伯机器翻译错误片段检测与分类的微调表面标签器
articles.abstractCn: 我们提交了TTLab针对AlexandriaX-2026子任务3（阿拉伯语机器翻译错误片段检测与分类）的解决方案。我们的系统将任务定义为基于表面形式的标记级分类，同时保留字符偏移量以确保与评估指标精确对齐。为处理严重的标签不平衡问题，我们采用了带类别权重的焦点损失和方言特定的解码阈值。在六种阿拉伯语预训练编码器中，MARBERTv2在开发集和测试集上分别取得了40.8和40.91的最佳综合性能，在所有参赛队伍中排名第3。尽管我们的系统能有效定位错误片段，但罕见错误类型的分类仍然具有挑战性，这凸显了需要对尾部类别进行数据增强的必要性。代码可在https://github.com/ENTAILab/arabic-dialectal-mt-error-span-detection（TTLab at AlexandriaX-2026）获取。

articles.title: TTLab at StanceEval-2026: A Cloze-Style Prompting Approach for Arabic-Language Stance Detection (CLASP-Ar)
articles.abstract: Arabic-language stance detection remains challenging, and previous shared-task systems have largely relied on multitask learning and ensembles. While these systems achieve state-of-the-art performance, their applicability and transferability are limited by the additional complexity introduced by multitask learning.To reduce this complexity, we introduce $\texttt{CLASP-Ar}$, which reformulates the task as cloze-style masked language modeling. In this approach, the target, predicted sentiment, and text are combined into a single prompt whose $\texttt{[MASK]}$ prediction is restricted to a verbalizer-constrained label vocabulary.

articles.title: C3M: Cross-Session Multimodal Memory Maintenance for Long-Horizon Tasks
articles.abstract: Long-horizon tasks require preserving and later recovering cross-session evidence under a bounded, query-blind memory budget. Existing compression can discard fine-grained visual cues or conflate semantically similar but incompatible observations. We present C3M, a cross-session multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence. Relation-aware updates consolidate safe redundancy while preserving complementary and incompatible records. At query time, budgeted routing selects useful index pages and expands their associated source evidence under a fixed reader budget. Together, these mechanisms establish a compact, provenance-preserving multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks, retaining temporal distinctions and source links required for reliable downstream reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M.
articles.titleCn: C3M：用于长时程任务的跨会话多模态记忆维护
articles.abstractCn: 长时程任务需要在有限的、查询盲的内存预算下保存并恢复跨会话证据。现有的压缩方法可能会丢弃细粒度的视觉线索，或将语义相似但不相容的观察结果混淆。我们提出了C3M，一种跨会话多模态记忆组织方法，它通过在持久的源文本-图像证据上维护一个有界的活跃索引来组织记忆。关系感知更新会整合安全的冗余性，同时保留互补和不相容的记录。在查询时，预算路由会选择有用的索引页面，并在固定的读者预算下扩展其关联的源证据。这些机制共同建立了一种紧凑的多模态记忆组织方法，用于跨会话长时程任务，保留时间差异和源链接，这对于可靠的下游推理至关重要。代码可在 https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M 获取。

articles.title: JEV vs. LLMs as Rubric Judges: Cheaper, Faster, and Wrong in the Same Places
articles.abstract: We ask whether Jev, a typed classifier that returns probabilities over permitted answers without generating text, can replace an LLM rubric judge. We compare it with three flash-tier LLM judges on nine panels drawn from seven benchmarks, giving every judge identical criterion texts. Jev's accuracy differs significantly from an LLM judge's in only 8 of 27 paired comparisons, ahead mostly on binary criteria and behind only on graded ones, and most of the other comparisons are inconclusive. Summed over the nine panels, the LLM judges, called once per criterion, cost 29 to 325 times as much as Jev and took 30 to 220 times as long. On graded criteria all four judges agree more with one another than with the labels and mostly assign lower levels than the raters. One of several observational accounts is that raters followed scale conventions our criterion texts omit. Jev's confidence ranks its own errors on most panels, which should make a cheap classifier the ideal first stage of a cascade that defers its uncertain verdicts to an LLM judge. Correlated errors undo that advantage. The LLM judges repeat nearly all of Jev's most confident errors, so a cascade replayed on the recorded verdicts lowers cost but gains at most 1.5 points over the best single judge with cross-fitted thresholds, and at most 2.0 even with oracle thresholds.
articles.titleCn: JEV与LLMs作为评分标准裁判：更便宜、更快，但在相同的地方出错
articles.abstractCn: 我们探讨了Jev——一个带类型分类器，它在不生成文本的情况下返回允许答案的概率——是否能够取代LLM评分员。我们在从七个基准中抽取的九个面板上，将其与三个快速级LLM评分员进行比较，并给每位评分员提供相同的标准文本。Jev的准确率仅在27次配对比较中的8次与LLM评分员存在显著差异，主要在二元标准上领先，仅在分级标准上落后，而大多数其他比较结果不明确。在九个面板上汇总，LLM评分员（每个标准调用一次）的成本比Jev高29到325倍，耗时也长30到220倍。在分级标准上，所有四位评分员与标签的共识程度高于彼此，并且大多分配了比评分员更低的等级。一种观察性解释是，评分员遵循了我们的标准文本中省略的量表惯例。Jev的置信度排名将其在大多数面板上的错误，这使得一个廉价分类器成为级联的理想第一阶段，该级联将其不确定的裁决推迟给LLM评分员。相关错误会消除这种优势。LLM评分员几乎重复了Jev的所有最自信的错误，因此在一个级联中重新播放记录的裁决可以降低成本，但最多比最佳单个评分员（使用交叉拟合阈值）提高1.5分，即使使用神谕阈值，最多也只能提高2.0分。

articles.title: TimeBraid: Unifying Time Series and Language for Understanding and Forecasting
articles.abstract: We present TimeBraid, a series of unified time-series and language models that align pretrained language models and pretrained time-series foundation models through interleaved global residual attention layers. Each model inherits knowledge, instruction following, and reasoning from one side, continuous-signal perception and zero-shot forecasting from the other, and fuses the two in a shared representation space where both modalities are understood and generated. We study the design choices that make such unified modeling work: where to align the two representation spaces, how to ground language in temporal structure, how to balance understanding with generation, and how to keep joint optimization stable. The resulting recipe combines a unified prompting scheme for diverse time-series and text tasks, stabilized joint training, and supervision from 2.2M curated series--text pairs and 4.9M instruction-tuning samples. Across benchmarks spanning time-series perception, understanding, reasoning, and both context-aided and unimodal forecasting, TimeBraid remains competitive with far larger general-purpose models and task-specific counterparts.
articles.titleCn: 时间编织：统一时间序列与语言，用于理解与预测
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了TimeBraid，一系列统一的时间序列和语言模型，通过交错的全局残差注意力层将预训练语言模型和预训练时间序列基础模型进行对齐。每个模型从一方面继承知识、指令遵循和推理能力，从另一方面继承连续信号感知和零样本预测能力，并在共享表示空间中将两者融合，使两种模态都能被理解和生成。我们研究了使这种统一建模生效的设计选择：如何对齐两个表示空间，如何将语言锚定在时间结构中，如何平衡理解与生成，以及如何保持联合优化的稳定性。最终形成的方案结合了适用于多样化时间序列和文本任务的统一提示方案、稳定的联合训练，以及来自220万组精选的时间序列-文本对和490万条指令微调样本的监督。在涵盖时间序列感知、理解、推理以及上下文辅助和非单模态预测的基准测试中，TimeBraid在远大于通用模型和特定任务对应模型的情况下仍保持竞争力。

articles.title: Benchmarking and Domain Adaptation of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) for Adolescent Health Communication in Ghanaian Languages
articles.abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end study of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for adolescent health communication in three Ghanaian languages (Twi, Dagbani, and Ewe). The work proceeds in three connected stages; First, we benchmark five ASR systems (three language-specific Wav2Vec2 models and two multimodal LLMs, Gemma 3n and Gemma 4) on a general-domain Bible corpus and a Youth Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health (ASRH) Domain ASR dataset, using Character and Word Error Rate (CER, WER). Second, guided by the benchmark, we perform supervised domain adaptation: although Gemma 4 was the strongest zero-shot candidate, fine-tuning it proved computationally infeasible, so we pivoted to the compact Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, fine-tuned on a large Ghana Bible corpus (~90k samples) and evaluated strictly on held-out human-collected in-domain audio. Fine-tuning reduced WER on every language, most dramatically for Ewe (WER from 109.3% to 64.8%, a drop of 44.5 pp; CER from 65.1% to 24.9%). Third, we validate the work through KasaHealth, a live voice-first ASRH application deployed in all three languages, complemented by Senti-Check, a technical evaluation harness. KasaHealth was tested by 50 community respondents and achieved a 100% chat-approval rate, a 72% Good-or-Excellent translation rating, and a 92% would-recommend rate, while surfacing the domain gaps that most constrain real-world use. Across all three stages the evidence converges: for these languages the binding constraint is validated in-domain data, not model capability or computation.
articles.titleCn: 加纳语言青少年健康交流中自动语音识别（ASR）的基准测试与领域自适应
articles.abstractCn: 本文对适用于加纳三种语言（阿肯语、达冈比语和埃维语）的青少年健康交流的自动语音识别（ASR）进行了端到端研究。这项工作分为三个相互关联的阶段；首先，我们在通用领域圣经语料库和青少年青少年性与生殖健康（ASRH）领域ASR数据集上，使用字符错误率（CER）和词错误率（WER）评估了五种ASR系统（三个特定语言的Wav2Vec2模型和两个多模态LLM，Gemma 3n和Gemma 4）的性能。其次，在基准测试的指导下，我们进行了监督领域自适应：尽管Gemma 4是最强的零样本候选模型，但微调它被证明在计算上不可行，因此我们转向了紧凑型Qwen3-ASR-0.6B，在大型加纳圣经语料库（约9万样本）上进行微调，并在严格保留的人收集领域音频上进行评估。微调降低了所有语言的WER，对埃维语的影响最为显著（WER从109.3%降至64.8%，下降了44.5个百分点；CER从65.1%降至24.9%）。第三，我们通过KasaHealth验证了这项工作，这是一款在三种语言中部署的实时语音优先ASRH应用程序，并辅以Senti-Check技术评估工具。KasaHealth由50名社区受访者进行测试，实现了100%的聊天批准率，72%的良好或优秀翻译评分，以及92%的推荐率，同时揭示了最限制实际使用的领域差距。在所有三个阶段，证据都表明：对于这些语言，约束条件是领域内数据，而不是模型能力或计算。

articles.title: Adaptive Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance for Low-Resource Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: Adapting multilingual speech foundation models to low-resource languages remains difficult, especially for languages that are poorly represented during pre-training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting large models, conventional approaches such as LoRA rely on generic low-rank parameterizations and do not explicitly use downstream task information to define the adaptation subspace. To investigate whether task-informed PEFT can better support low-resource ASR, we apply Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance Analysis (FCCA) to Whisper and Qwen3-ASR, and introduce two complementary extensions: Asymmetric-Coupled FCCA (AC-FCCA), which exploits structured cross-layer sharing, and Adaptive-Rank FCCA (AR-FCCA), which reallocates adaptation capacity across projection matrices under a fixed parameter budget. Under controlled multilingual experiments, we evaluate these approaches on languages that are poorly represented or unsupported during pre-training alongside well-represented languages. Standard FCCA is competitive with, and usually outperforms, trainable-parameter-budget-matched LoRA. AR-FCCA provides the most consistent improvement over standard FCCA across both model architectures, with statistically significant gains in several evaluation settings, while retaining the same number of trainable parameters. These results show that task-informed subspace construction can be effective for low-resource speech adaptation, and that adaptive rank allocation provides a robust way to improve parameter efficiency without increasing model capacity.
articles.titleCn: 自适应Fisher白化交叉协方差矩阵在低资源语音识别中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 将多语言语音基础模型适配到低资源语言仍然存在困难，尤其对于那些在预训练阶段代表性不足的语言。虽然参数高效微调（PEFT）降低了适配大型模型的成本，但传统方法如LoRA依赖于通用的低秩参数化，并未明确使用下游任务信息来定义适配子空间。为了探究任务信息化的PEFT是否更能支持低资源语音识别（ASR），我们应用了Fisher白化交叉协方差分析（FCCA）到Whisper和Qwen3-ASR，并引入了两个互补的扩展：非对称耦合FCCA（AC-FCCA），该扩展利用了结构化的跨层共享，以及自适应秩FCCA（AR-FCCA），该扩展在固定的参数预算下重新分配投影矩阵中的适配能力。在受控的多语言实验中，我们在预训练阶段代表性不足或不受支持的语言以及代表性充分的语言上评估了这些方法。标准FCCA与参数预算匹配的LoRA具有竞争力，并且通常表现更优。AR-FCCA在两种模型架构下都提供了最一致的改进，在多个评估场景中实现了统计显著的增益，同时保持了相同数量的可训练参数。这些结果表明，任务信息化的子空间构建对低资源语音适配是有效的，而自适应秩分配提供了一种在不增加模型容量的情况下提高参数效率的稳健方法。

articles.title: Learning to Ideate for Scientific Impact
articles.abstract: Scientific ideation is increasingly mediated by large language models, but current ideation systems are usually trained and evaluated on immediately judgeable proxies such as novelty, clarity, and feasibility. This leaves open whether delayed signals of scientific uptake can be used as feedback for steering models toward research directions with higher expected \emph{impact}. We study this question using citation-normalized impact as a noisy but scalable proxy for scholarly uptake. We construct a large-scale dataset from over 100K computer science papers by extracting goal-conditioned idea descriptions and assigning each paper an ordinal, year-normalized citation label. We then train a goal-conditioned reward model to predict citation-impact labels from research goal and idea pairs, and use this reward to align an idea generator through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. To reduce circularity, we evaluate generated ideas with a held-out, reference-grounded protocol that compares model outputs against historical ideas under the same research goal and weights judgments by the reference idea's citation-impact label. Experiments show that our RL-tuned model consistently produces ideas with higher estimated impact than both the base model and supervised fine-tuning baselines. Our findings position scientific impact as a practical, outcome-grounded feedback signal for aligning LLMs in open-ended scientific discovery.
articles.titleCn: 学习以科学影响力为目标进行构思
articles.abstractCn: 科学构思正越来越多地受到大型语言模型的中介，但当前的构思系统通常在可立即判断的代理指标（如新颖性、清晰度和可行性）上进行训练和评估。这引发了延迟的科学采纳信号是否可用作反馈，以引导模型朝向预期影响更高的研究方向的问题。我们使用引用标准化影响作为衡量学术采纳的噪声但可扩展的代理指标来研究这一问题。我们从超过10万篇计算机科学论文中构建了一个大规模数据集，通过提取目标条件下的构思描述，并为每篇论文分配一个按年份标准化的引用标签。随后，我们训练了一个目标条件下的奖励模型，从研究目标和构思对预测引用影响标签，并使用该奖励通过监督微调随后进行强化学习来对齐构思生成器。为减少循环性，我们采用一个基于参考的保留协议来评估生成的构思，该协议将模型输出与相同研究目标下的历史构思进行比较，并根据参考构思的引用影响标签对判断进行加权。实验表明，我们的强化学习调优模型始终产生比基础模型和监督微调基线具有更高估计影响的构思。我们的研究将科学影响定位为在开放式科学发现中对齐大型语言模型的一种实用、结果导向的反馈信号。

articles.title: CORDIAL: Calibrating Ordinal LLM Outputs from Few Labels
articles.abstract: A large language model (LLM) can turn a text into a distribution over an ordered scale, but that distribution is a noisy measurement: saturated, compressed or exaggerated, and biased in a consistent direction. We propose CORDIAL, which treats the model's output as a noisy reading of the true label and corrects it with a channel of five interpretable parameters. The channel is small enough for its posterior to be averaged from a handful of labels, and we prove that the resulting calibration preserves first-order stochastic order. On Amazon reviews and CMU-MOSEI transcripts with four LLMs, CORDIAL has the lowest log loss among nine calibrators in 76 of 80 settings with 5 to 100 labels; with 20 labels and the main 7B reader, it matches the strongest baseline using 28-54 labels. The same posterior lets us learn priors from other tasks and fuse several LLMs. Unrestricted calibrators such as Dirichlet calibration overtake it only as the calibration set grows into the hundreds or thousands.
articles.titleCn: 心诚：从少量标签中校准序数LLM输出
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够将文本转化为有序标度上的分布，但这种分布是一种带有噪声的测量结果：可能饱和、压缩或夸张，并且存在一致的偏差。我们提出了CORDIAL方法，将模型的输出视为对真实标签的噪声读数，并使用一个包含五个可解释参数的通道对其进行校正。该通道足够小，其后验分布可以从少量标签中平均得到，并且我们证明了由此产生的校准保留了第一阶随机顺序。在亚马逊评论和CMU-MOSEI转录文本上，使用四种LLM进行测试，CORDIAL在80个设置中的76个（标签数量为5到100个）中，在九种校准器中具有最低的对数损失；使用20个标签和主要的7B读取器时，它匹配了使用28到54个标签的最强基线。相同的后验分布使我们能够从其他任务中学习先验分布，并融合多个LLM。只有当校准集增长到数百或数千个标签时，无约束校准器（如Dirichlet校准）才能超越它。

articles.title: ChunkRank: Model-Aware Text Chunking and Abstention-Aware Answer Selection for LLM Pipelines
articles.abstract: We present ChunkRank, an open-source Python library that derives chunk boundaries from a target model's tokenizer and context window, and selects an answer among candidates produced independently per chunk. It ships a validated registry of 90 models across 15 providers and six answer-selection methods, and needs only three core dependencies. For chunking, ChunkRank avoids context-window overflow automatically from the model name, whereas character-based splitters overflow or waste the budget, and a fidelity study across 11 languages shows why token-exact budgets matter beyond English. For answer selection we report a negative result: on NaturalQuestions, TriviaQA and HotpotQA, with extractive and generative readers, no content-based ranker reliably beats taking the first non-empty answer. The reason is reader abstention on chunks that lack the answer, not answer position. A long-context baseline shows that chunking matches single-call reading on single-hop questions, so ChunkRank targets small-window and beyond-window settings. Code, registry and evaluation harness are released.
articles.titleCn: ChunkRank：面向LLM流程的模型感知文本分块与弃权感知答案选择
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了ChunkRank，一个开源的Python库，它可以从目标模型的分词器和上下文窗口中推导出片段边界，并在每个片段独立生成的候选答案中选择一个答案。它提供了一个经过验证的注册表，包含来自15个提供商的90个模型和六种答案选择方法，只需要三个核心依赖。在片段划分方面，ChunkRank通过模型名称自动避免上下文窗口溢出，而基于字符的分割器则会导致溢出或浪费预算，一项跨越11种语言的保真度研究表明，除了英语之外，精确的token预算也很重要。对于答案选择，我们报告了一个负面结果：在NaturalQuestions、TriviaQA和HotpotQA上，使用提取式和生成式阅读器，没有基于内容的排序器能够可靠地胜过选择第一个非空答案。原因是阅读器在缺少答案的片段上选择放弃，而不是答案的位置。一个长上下文基线表明，片段划分与单次调用的单跳问题阅读匹配，因此ChunkRank针对小窗口和超窗口设置。代码、注册表和评估工具已发布。

articles.title: PUBG Ally: A Conversational Embodied Agent as an AI Teammate
articles.abstract: We introduce PUBG Ally, an embodied agent for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS that can reason, act autonomously, and play alongside players as a voice-enabled teammate. Building such a teammate requires combining two difficult capabilities: it must perceive and respond to a constantly changing game world under strict latency constraints while interacting naturally with players, keeping its speech synchronized with its actions. Ally therefore combines agentic tool use with real-time game control. A language-model agent uses a controlled interface to inspect game information, interpret player speech, maintain context, decide what to say, and issue high-level action choices that steer a faster control layer for movement, combat, and recovery. Because the player's and Ally's speech and actions continually shape each other and the course of the match, training requires data from actual gameplay. We therefore collect data across nearly 39k sessions in which real players play alongside Ally, recording gameplay, player speech, agent decisions, tool use, actions, and player feedback, and use these records for iterative training. To evaluate teammate quality, we use player feedback and preference comparisons to identify gaps between offline evaluations and player preferences, and iteratively refine the evaluation criteria. Deploying Ally in live service further requires low-latency on-device execution and safeguards for player-facing communication, which we address through model compression, context compaction, targeted safety training, runtime guardrails, and memory redaction. During the live service, we surveyed players in 141 countries. Among respondents whose play with Ally was confirmed in game records, positive responses exceeded negative responses by 25.1 percentage points when asked whether they would recommend Ally, with players describing Ally not only as a tool but also as a teammate or companion.
articles.titleCn: PUBG 伙伴：一个对话式具身智能体作为AI队友
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了PUBG Ally，一个能够在《PUBG：战斗之地》中推理、自主行动，并与玩家作为带语音功能的队友一起游戏的拟人化智能体。构建这样的队友需要结合两项艰巨的能力：它必须在严格的延迟限制下感知并响应不断变化的游戏世界，同时与玩家自然互动，保持其语音与行动同步。因此，Ally结合了智能体工具使用与实时游戏控制。语言模型智能体通过受控接口检查游戏信息、解释玩家语音、维持上下文、决定说什么，并发布高级行动选择，这些选择引导更快的控制层进行移动、战斗和恢复。由于玩家和Ally的语音和行动不断相互塑造比赛进程，训练需要实际游戏数据。因此，我们收集了近3.9万场真实玩家与Ally一起游戏的会话数据，记录游戏过程、玩家语音、智能体决策、工具使用、行动和玩家反馈，并使用这些记录进行迭代训练。为了评估队友质量，我们使用玩家反馈和偏好比较来识别离线评估与玩家偏好之间的差距，并迭代优化评估标准。在正式服务中部署Ally还需要低延迟的设备端执行和面向玩家的通信安全措施，我们通过模型压缩、上下文精简、针对性安全训练、运行时护栏和内存脱敏来解决这些问题。在正式服务期间，我们对141个国家的玩家进行了调查。在游戏中确认与Ally互动的受访者中，当被问及是否会推荐Ally时，正面反馈比负面反馈高出25.1个百分点，玩家不仅将Ally视为工具，还将其视为队友或伙伴。

articles.title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs
articles.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly non-linear components, in this work we demonstrate that they exhibit fundamental linearity: when inputs from distinct text streams are linearly combined, the model outputs a superposition of the individual next-token distributions. We term this the \textit{Superposition Linearity Hypothesis}. We provide evidence that superposition is an intrinsic property of the Transformer architecture rather than an emergent consequence of training; in fact, we observe that it tends to diminish as pretraining progresses. However, we demonstrate that linearity can be substantially restored through lightweight fine-tuning, significantly reducing the divergence between the predicted next-token distribution and the average of the individual next-token distributions. Finally, we introduce a guided decoding procedure that disentangles superposed outputs, enabling the simultaneous generation of two coherent continuations from a single forward pass.
articles.titleCn: 你的Transformer可以同时持有两个想法：LLMs中线性叠加的证据
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）依赖于高度非线性的组件，但在本研究中我们证明了它们表现出基本的线性特性：当来自不同文本流的输入线性组合时，模型输出的是各个下一个词分布的叠加。我们称之为\textit{叠加线性假设}。我们提供了证据表明，叠加是Transformer架构的内在属性，而非训练产生的涌现结果；事实上，我们观察到随着预训练的进行，叠加特性往往会减弱。然而，我们证明了通过轻量级微调可以显著恢复线性特性，从而显著降低预测的下一个词分布与各个下一个词分布的平均值之间的偏差。最后，我们引入了一种引导解码程序，能够将叠加输出解耦，从而通过单次前向传递同时生成两个连贯的续写。

articles.title: Encoded but Not Decoded: Layer-Localized Evidence for a Three-Level Gap in LLM Syntax
articles.abstract: A language model can fail a syntactic test in two distinct ways: by not encoding the relevant structure, or by encoding it but failing to use it at the output. Behavioral evaluation alone cannot tell these apart. We propose a three-level evaluation framework (behavioral deployment, LM-head readout, and probe recoverability) measured on the same items under the same binary decision. Using a compact trilingual (English, Chinese, German) control-dependency benchmark, we find that probe recoverability exceeds or equals LM-head readout, which in turn exceeds or equals behavioral deployment, across seven models and all three languages in the aggregate. The recoverability surplus is never negative across all 14 (model, task) conditions. The disconnect concentrates in subject-control, where a nearest-noun heuristic gives the wrong answer. The single largest gap (0.653) appears on Qwen3-0.6B Instruct in question answering. The gap persists at Qwen3-14B Instruct. Instruction tuning degrades deployment more than encoding in percentage terms. We rule out option-position bias, late-layer erasure, output-formatting artifacts, and probe-training variance. The pattern is consistent with decoding that favors surface shortcuts, and the behavior-probe gap measures the strength of that preference. Activation patching shows the gap is layer-localized. Under instruction tuning, the LM-head-decoded layer shifts approximately ten layers later than the probe-decoded layer. These findings argue that behavioral evaluation understates what models encode, while probing alone overstates what they deploy.
articles.titleCn: 已编码但未解码：LLM句法中层级差异的层局部证据
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型可以通过两种不同的方式在句法测试中失败：未能编码相关结构，或编码了结构但在输出时未能使用。仅通过行为评估无法区分这两种情况。我们提出一个三级评估框架（行为部署、LM头读取和探测可恢复性），在相同项目和相同二元决策下进行测量。使用一个紧凑的三语（英语、中文、德语）控制依赖基准，我们发现探测可恢复性大于或等于LM头读取，而LM头读取又大于或等于行为部署，跨越七个模型和所有三种语言的总和。在所有14（模型、任务）条件下，可恢复性盈余始终为正。这种脱节主要集中在主语控制上，其中最近名词启发式给出了错误答案。最大的单个差距（0.653）出现在问答任务中的Qwen3-0.6B Instruct。这种差距在Qwen3-14B Instruct中依然存在。指令微调在百分比上比编码对部署的损害更大。我们排除了选项位置偏差、后期层擦除、输出格式伪影和探测训练方差。这种模式与倾向于表面捷径的解码一致，行为-探测差距衡量了这种偏好的强度。激活补丁显示这种差距是层本地的。在指令微调下，LM头解码层比探测解码层大约晚十个层。这些发现表明行为评估低估了模型编码的内容，而单独探测则高估了模型部署的内容。

articles.title: Multi-Task Learning by using Contextualized Word Representations for Syntactic Parsing of a Morphologically Rich Language
articles.abstract: We address the challenge of syntactic parsing for Urdu, a morphologically rich language, and present state-of-the-art results for both constituency and dependency parsing. This paper offers four major contributions: 1) the conversion of the CLE-UTB phrase structure treebank into a dependency treebank by developing language-specific head-word and phrase-to-dependency label mapping rules; 2) a novel sequence labeling scheme that transforms the parsing task into a unified representation; 3) the training of contextualized word representations on a large 220 million tokens Urdu corpus collected from the web; and 4) development of parsing framework using two learning paradigms, single-task and multi-task learning. Several post-processing rules are applied to improve the quality of the automatically converted dependency structure treebank. The proposed sequence labeling scheme enables the use of a shared architecture that learns the syntactic structures from both grammatical structures simultaneously and hence improves generalization. Experiments show that the multi-task learning setup significantly enhances parsing performance, achieving an F1 score of 91.39 for constituency parsing (an improvement of 3.29 points) and a labeled attachment score of 85.69 for dependency parsing (an improvement of 1.49 points). These results demonstrate that learning cross-task representations provides measurable benefits and advances the state of syntactic parsing for Urdu.
articles.titleCn: 基于上下文词表示的多任务学习，用于形态丰富语言句法分析
articles.abstractCn: 我们针对乌尔都语这一形态丰富的语言，解决了句法分析挑战，并展示了成分句法和依存句法的最新成果。本文提出了四项主要贡献：1）通过开发特定语言的词头和短语到依存标签映射规则，将CLE-UTB短语结构树库转换为依存树库；2）提出了一种新的序列标注方案，将句法分析任务转换为统一表示；3）在从网络上收集的2.2亿个词元的乌尔都语语料库上训练上下文词表示；4）使用单任务和多任务学习两种学习范式开发句法分析框架。应用了若干后处理规则以提高自动转换的依存结构树库的质量。所提出的序列标注方案能够使用共享架构，同时学习句法结构和语法结构，从而提高泛化能力。实验表明，多任务学习设置显著提高了句法分析性能，成分句法达到了91.39的F1分数（提高了3.29分），依存句法达到了85.69的标注附着分数（提高了1.49分）。这些结果表明，跨任务学习提供了可衡量的收益，并推动了乌尔都语句法分析的发展。

articles.title: MILO: Efficient Many-shot In-Context Learning with Block-wise Low-rank Compression
articles.abstract: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to complex tasks by conditioning on thousands of demonstration examples, but this paradigm shifts the inference efficiency bottleneck to the key-value (KV) cache memory. Due to the linear scaling behavior of the KV cache, storing these intermediate tensors has become a paramount challenge for both online serving and on-device deployment. To address this issue, we propose a novel compression framework, termed MILO, that exploits the low-rank redundancy inherent in many-shot contexts. Specifically, MILO features a block-wise low-rank compression strategy that compresses the KV cache at the block granularity, where each block contains multiple many-shot examples. Furthermore, to handle the heterogeneous context density across different blocks, MILO dynamically allocates rank budgets based on the information entropy, preserving the fidelity of critical blocks while aggressively compressing redundant ones. Experimental results on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that our method achieves up to 50% reduction in KV cache memory and 1.8x throughput improvement, with negligible performance degradation on classification and reasoning benchmarks, significantly outperforming prior baselines.
articles.titleCn: 米洛：基于分块低秩压缩的高效小样本情境内学习
articles.abstractCn: 多示例情境学习（ICL）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够通过基于数千个演示示例进行条件适应，从而适应复杂任务，但这种范式将推理效率瓶颈转移到了键值（KV）缓存内存。由于KV缓存的线性扩展行为，存储这些中间张量已成为在线服务和设备部署的严峻挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的压缩框架，称为MILO，该框架利用多示例情境中固有的低秩冗余。具体而言，MILO采用了一种基于块的低秩压缩策略，在块粒度上压缩KV缓存，每个块包含多个多示例。此外，为处理不同块之间异构的情境密度，MILO根据信息熵动态分配秩预算，在保留关键块保真度的同时，对冗余块进行激进压缩。在Qwen2.5模型上的实验结果表明，我们的方法将KV缓存内存减少高达50%，吞吐量提升1.8倍，在分类和推理基准测试上的性能下降可忽略不计，显著优于现有基线方法。

articles.title: Cultural Divergence Preservation: Diagnosing Flattening and Caricature in LLM-Simulated Survey Populations
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents to estimate population response distributions. In cross-cultural survey simulation, evaluations should assess not only distributional fidelity within countries but also whether differences across countries are preserved. However, existing distance-based metrics such as Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) do not directly capture such cross-country differences. To address this limitation, we introduce Cultural Divergence Preservation (CDP), a reference-light diagnostic based on a one-time human calibration. CDP identifies reduced cross-country divergence as cultural flattening and increased divergence as cultural caricature. To evaluate CDP, we conduct experiments across four LLM backbones, three persona-based prompting methods, and two survey domains, the World Values Survey (WVS) and the Big Five Personality Test. The results reveal a systematic discrepancy between conventional fidelity metrics and CDP. Controlled experiments show that CDP changes monotonically as cross-country divergence is attenuated or amplified, while the corresponding changes in JSD remain relatively small. In our audit of real LLM generations, DeepPersona-Inspired prompting is frequently favored by conventional fidelity metrics but exhibits the strongest flattening in every model--domain block. CDP thus complements fidelity metrics by directly quantifying the attenuation or amplification of cross-country divergence.
articles.comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Pluralistic AI & NLP (PANDORA)
articles.titleCn: 文化差异保护：诊断LLM模拟调查人口中的扁平化和漫画化
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用作合成调查受访者，以估计人群响应分布。在跨文化调查模拟中，评估不仅应评估国家内部的分布保真度，还应评估国家之间的差异是否得到保留。然而，现有的基于距离的指标，如杰森-香农散度（JSD），并不能直接捕捉这种跨国差异。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了文化差异保留（CDP），这是一种基于一次性人工校准的参考轻量级诊断方法。CDP将跨国差异的减少识别为文化扁平化，将差异的增加识别为文化漫画化。为了评估CDP，我们在四个LLM主干、三种基于角色的提示方法和两个调查领域——世界价值观调查（WVS）和五大人格测试——进行了实验。结果表明，传统保真度指标与CDP之间存在系统差异。受控实验表明，随着跨国差异的减弱或增强，CDP单调变化，而相应的JSD变化相对较小。在我们的真实LLM生成审计中，受DeepPersona启发的提示方法经常被传统保真度指标青睐，但在每个模型-领域块中表现出最强的扁平化。因此，CDP通过直接量化跨国差异的减弱或增强，补充了保真度指标。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of VLM Pipelines for Long-Document QA
articles.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for long-document processing, where the inputs combine text with charts, tables, figures, and complex layouts. Deploying them means choosing how to feed the document to the model, which retriever to use when only a subset of pages is sent, and whether to run the model agentically or as a static pipeline. We study these choices on two long-document QA benchmarks with both frontier API and open-weight VLMs. First, on MMLongBench-Doc our six-tool agent with page, table, figure, and search calls pays off only once the answering VLM is large enough: with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B it trails static page input, with Qwen3.5-27B it draws level, and with Sonnet 4.5 it leads. On LongDocURL it is level with or ahead of static input at every reader. Its lead over the strongest static pipeline is clearest with the frontier reader on MMLongBench-Doc and narrows to within noise on LongDocURL. Second, retrieval modality matters more than the specific retriever: the strongest image retriever leads the strongest text pipeline, and on the text side a single off-the-shelf cross-encoder rerank essentially matches a much heavier multi-stage LLM pipeline. Top-k image retrieval is also the most token-efficient input at every reader we paired it with, at roughly a seventh to a quarter of the tokens of sending every page. Third, cutting across all three choices, three of our strongest pipelines succeed on different questions, and an oracle that picks the best pipeline per question gains roughly thirteen points over the best single pipeline, though evidence-type routing recovers almost none of it.
articles.titleCn: 长文档问答中VLM流水线的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在长文档处理中的应用日益增多，其输入结合了文本、图表、表格、图像和复杂布局。部署这些模型意味着需要选择如何将文档输入模型，在仅发送部分页面时使用哪个检索器，以及是运行模型代理式还是静态管道。我们在两个长文档问答基准上研究了这些选择，包括前沿API和开放权重VLMs。首先，在MMLongBench-Doc上，我们的六工具代理在回答VLM足够大时才有效：使用Qwen3.5-4B和9B时，其表现落后于静态页面输入；使用Qwen3.5-27B时，其表现与静态输入持平；而使用Sonnet 4.5时，其表现领先。在LongDocURL上，它在每个阅读器中都与静态输入持平或领先。其相较于最强静态管道的领先优势在MMLongBench-Doc的前沿阅读器上最为明显，而在LongDocURL上则缩小到噪声范围内。其次，检索模态比具体检索器更重要：最强的图像检索器领先最强的文本管道，而在文本方面，单个现成的跨编码器重新排序几乎与更复杂的分阶段LLM管道相当。在所有我们配对的阅读器中，Top-k图像检索也是最具token效率的输入方式，大约是发送每一页token数量的七分之一到四分之一。第三，跨越所有三个选择，我们最强的三个管道在不同的问题上取得成功，而一个按问题选择最佳管道的预言机比单个最佳管道高出约十三分，尽管证据类型路由几乎未能恢复其中的任何优势。

articles.title: Augur: A Synthetic Decision Lab for Rehearsing Reactions to Product and Policy Changes
articles.abstract: Before a product or policy change ships, the question that matters is how people will react to it. Augur rehearses that reaction offline: it builds a typed knowledge graph from the change documents, populates a grounded persona market, simulates the interaction, and returns an auditable decision memo recommending one of five actions. We assemble Gold-50, fifty real product and policy episodes whose real-world outcome is known, adjudicated against the public record, and score the five-way release verdict against it. Our central finding is methodological and negative: most of the measured gap between frontier cloud models and open-weight models we fine-tune and serve offline is attributable to an under-specified evaluation, not a difference in capability. We show this three ways. First, the prompt envelope alone can dominate the score: holding weights, cases and scorer fixed, one system -- a LoRA-SFT adapter on Qwen3-32B -- swings from 0% to 73%. Second, in a matched 2x2 ablation, defining the decision taxonomy in the prompt -- with no model change -- lifts every frontier model by +24 to +34pp; under the under-specified prompt, Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT served offline beats all three frontier models (paired McNemar, Holm-corrected), and once the prompt is fair no significant difference from any of them is detected. Third, agreement with the distillation teacher rises without accuracy following, and the full pipeline amplifies a systematic "over-doom" bias rather than improving the verdict. Separately, we validate the reaction layer on its own terms: blind judges across four model families find the synthetic reaction recovers 67-90% of the concerns the public actually raised, and a pre-registered ablation locates its value -- largest where the decision is hardest, redundant near ceiling. The pipeline that regenerates every number and figure here is available from the authors.
articles.titleCn: 占卜：一个用于演练对产品和政策变化的反应的合成决策实验室
articles.abstractCn: 在产品或政策变更正式发布前，关键问题在于人们将如何反应。Augur 在线下模拟这种反应：它从变更文档中构建一个类型化的知识图谱，填充一个基于现实人物的虚拟市场，模拟互动过程，并返回一份可审计的决策备忘录，推荐五种行动方案中的一种。我们收集了50个真实的产品和政策案例（Gold-50），这些案例的现实结果已知，并与公共记录进行核对，对五种发布方案进行评分。我们的核心发现是方法论上的负面结论：我们微调并在离线状态下服务的最前沿云模型与开放权重模型之间的测量差距，主要归因于评估方法不明确，而非能力差异。我们通过三种方式证明这一点。首先，仅提示框架本身就能主导评分：在固定权重、案例和评分者的情况下，一个系统——基于Qwen3-32B的LoRA-SFT适配器——的评分从0%波动到73%。其次，在匹配的2x2消融实验中，通过在提示中定义决策分类（无需模型变更），所有前沿模型的评分提升了+24至+34个百分点；在定义不明确的提示下，离线服务的Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT击败了所有三个前沿模型（配对McNemar检验，Holm校正），一旦提示变得公平，就检测不到与任何模型的显著差异。第三，与蒸馏导师的协议提升而准确率未变，整个流程放大了系统性的“过度悲观”偏见，而非改进决策。此外，我们单独验证了反应层本身的价值：跨越四个模型系列的盲评法官发现，合成的反应回复了公众实际提出的67-90%的关切，一项预先注册的消融实验定位了其价值——在决策最困难时价值最大，在接近上限时冗余。本流程中重新生成的所有数据和图表均可从作者处获取。

articles.title: VietPrism: A large-scale Vietnamese speech and deepfake corpus with diverse dialects and code-switching
articles.abstract: Vietnamese speech research is constrained by resources that isolate automatic speech recognition from speaker, dialect, code-switching, and deepfake analysis. We introduce VietPrism, an open, multi-domain corpus that brings these dimensions together at scale: 993.4 hours and 403,941 bona fide utterances from 1,262 verified speakers across 8,388 real-world videos. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale Vietnamese corpus to jointly provide transcripts, consistent speaker identities, five dialect groups, and naturally occurring Vietnamese--English code-switching, which constitutes nearly half of the corpus by duration. We further create over 3.1K hours of spoof speech with four open-source and commercial synthesis systems. Every spoof is conditioned on a verified speaker reference and paired with a transcript- and speaker-matched bona fide utterance, enabling unique controlled evaluation with reduced lexical and identity confounds. Zero-shot evaluation of five pretrained multilingual detectors reveals striking brittleness: EER greatly varies across detector--generator pairings, while recent multilingual detector DFA-1B degrades from 16.3% to 33.6% as speaker similarity increases. Dialect-stratified results expose further model-dependent disparities. By unifying natural linguistic diversity with controlled spoof generation, VietPrism provides a challenging foundation for Vietnamese speech modeling and trustworthy audio-deepfake detection.
articles.titleCn: 越南棱镜：一个包含多种方言和代码转换的大规模越南语音和深度伪造语料库
articles.abstractCn: 越南语音研究受限于资源，导致自动语音识别与说话人、方言、语码转换和深度伪造分析相分离。我们介绍了VietPrism，一个开放的多领域语料库，将这几个维度大规模整合起来：包含993.4小时和403,941个真实语音片段，来自1,262名经过验证的说话人，分布在8,388个真实世界视频中。据我们所知，这是首个联合提供文本转录、一致说话人身份、五个方言组以及自然发生的越南-英语语码转换的大规模越南语语料库，后者在语料库时长中占比近一半。我们进一步使用四种开源和商业合成系统创建了超过3.1K小时的伪造语音。每个伪造语音都基于经过验证的说话人参考，并与文本和说话人匹配的真实语音片段配对，从而实现独特的受控评估，并减少词汇和身份混淆。对五种预训练的多语言检测器的零样本评估揭示了惊人的脆弱性：不同检测器-生成器组合的等错误率差异很大，而最新的多语言检测器DFA-1B随着说话人相似度的增加，从16.3%下降到33.6%。方言分层结果进一步暴露了模型相关的差异。通过统一自然语言多样性并控制伪造生成，VietPrism为越南语音建模和可信音频深度伪造检测提供了具有挑战性的基础。

articles.title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Question Answering in Financial Services with Domain-Adapted Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Financial institutions operate under dense, frequently amended rulebooks, and answering a compliance question correctly requires not only fluency but verifiable grounding in the authoritative text. Large language models are attractive for this task, yet the models that firms can realistically deploy on-premise are compact ones, and compact models hallucinate obligations. We study whether a carefully domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline closes that gap. Our retriever is built in three stages on top of LegalBERT: entailment tuning that recasts question--passage matching as premise--hypothesis reconstruction, contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives, and score-level fusion with BM25. Our generator is a compact model (2B--12B parameters) served under 4-bit quantization, either prompted or adapted with retrieval-aware fine-tuning (RAFT) through LoRA. On ObliQA, a question-answering benchmark built from the Abu Dhabi Global Market rulebooks, the staged retriever raises Recall@10 from 0.256 to 0.774 and outperforms BM25 (0.678) and E5-large-v2 (0.758), the strongest general-purpose dense encoder we tested. RAFT-LoRA then improves the composite RePASs answer-quality score for every model we could adapt, with the largest gain on the weakest one. However, the adapted models do not transfer to Australian case-law questions, and a closed-book model that receives no passages at all scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline while producing answers that cite nothing and misstate obligations. The retrieval gain is therefore measured directly, the generation gain is a gain in RePASs rather than demonstrated grounding, and grounding itself requires an evaluation protocol that RePASs does not provide.
articles.titleCn: 金融服务中基于领域自适应检索增强生成的自动化合规问答
articles.abstractCn: 金融机构在繁复且频繁修订的规则体系下运营，正确回答合规性问题不仅需要语言流畅性，还需要在权威文本中具备可验证的依据。大型语言模型虽然适用于此任务，但企业实际部署的本地模型通常是紧凑型模型，而紧凑型模型会产生幻觉性的义务。我们研究了精心进行领域适配的检索增强生成流程是否能弥补这一差距。我们的检索器基于LegalBERT构建，分三个阶段进行：蕴含调优将问题-段落匹配重构为前提-假设重构，批内负样本对比调优，以及BM25的分数级融合。我们的生成器是紧凑型模型（2B-12B参数），采用4位量化服务，或通过LoRA进行检索感知微调（RAFT）进行提示或适配。在ObliQA（基于阿布扎比全球市场规则书构建的问题回答基准），分阶段检索器将Recall@10从0.256提升至0.774，优于我们测试的最强通用密集编码器BM25（0.678）和E5-large-v2（0.758）。RAFT-LoRA随后提升了我们所有可适配模型的复合RePASs回答质量分数，在最弱模型上提升效果最显著。然而，适配后的模型无法迁移至澳大利亚判例法问题，而完全不受段落输入的闭卷模型回答引用空白且义务陈述错误，其分数与完整流程仅相差0.011 RePASs。因此，检索增益直接衡量，生成增益以RePASs分数提升而非证明性依据，而证明性依据本身需要RePASs未提供的评估协议。

articles.title: Low-Cost Assays for Measuring Model Behavior Across Vendors and Releases
articles.abstract: Language models advise people, keep them company, and write software while they sleep. Measuring what they do is hard: behavior has to be sampled repeatedly across models, prompts and releases, most of it lives in unstructured text that has to be coded before it can be counted, and the result has to be legible and rigorous enough to meaningfully compare models and vendors. To address these constraints, we present a simple, cheap, scalable, and replicable model for studying model behavior. Each study is a frozen, public stimulus run identically on a cross-vendor panel, at a few dollars per model or less. Each reads its transcripts one of three ways, chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs: exact match on a clamped reply, a codebook applied by LLM judges whose agreement with a human coder is reported per code, and an instrumented environment that records what an agent did independently of what it said. Run across four years of model releases from both frontier and open-source labs, these instruments find four things. Convergence: asked to pick a word, 27 of 44 models answer serendipity at least once in four tries. Resistance: a trailing "right?" moves endorsement by up to 32 points, and the sign flips from sycophantic to resistant as generations advance, keyed to the tag's surface form. House: whether a model holds a position under pressure tracks its generation, and how it holds tracks the lab that built it. Account: told to do something the documentation in their repository contradicts, some coding agents never went along silently and others always did, and the same model can change with the harness it runs in. Re-run on every release, batteries like these track how behavior is changing across vendors and over time.
articles.titleCn: 跨供应商和版本测量模型行为的低成本检测方法
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型为人类提供建议、陪伴人类，并在人类睡觉时编写软件。衡量它们的行为很困难：行为需要在不同的模型、提示和版本中反复采样，其中大部分存在于非结构化文本中，必须先进行编码才能进行计数，而结果必须足够清晰和严谨，才能有意义地比较模型和供应商。为了应对这些限制，我们提出了一种简单、廉价、可扩展且可复制的模型行为研究方法。每个研究都是在一个跨供应商面板上相同地运行的冻结的公共刺激运行，每个模型成本低于几美元。每个模型以三种方式之一读取其文本记录，选择方式取决于行为所需的解释程度：对固定回复进行精确匹配、由大型语言模型裁判应用的代码簿（裁判与人类编码器的协议按代码报告）以及记录代理行为而不依赖于其言论的仪器化环境。跨越四年来自前沿和开源实验室的模型发布，这些仪器发现了四件事。收敛性：被要求选一个词，44个模型中有27个在四次尝试中至少一次回答了“机缘巧合”。阻力：一个附加的“对吗？”能使认同度提高高达32个点，并且随着世代的进步，其符号从奉承变为抵制，这与标签的表面形式相关。房屋：在压力下模型是否坚持立场反映了其世代，而其坚持方式则反映了构建它的实验室。账户：当被要求做某事而其存储库中的文档与之矛盾时，一些编码代理从不默默服从，而另一些则始终服从，并且相同的模型可能会随着其运行的框架而改变。在每个发布上重新运行，这类电池可以追踪行为在不同供应商和随时间的变化。

articles.title: Artificial Societies Benchmark: A Validation Framework for Synthetic Research
articles.abstract: A synthetic survey can reproduce the average answer while misrepresenting how people differ, how their answers relate to one another, or how they respond to changes in conditions. We introduce the Artificial Societies Benchmark to help researchers assess whether synthetic populations support their intended analyses. The framework combines eleven tests across internal, construct, and external validity, drawing on twenty human sources and comparing nine language models. It connects each research use to the evidence it requires and tests how results change with the information we supply about respondents. Importantly, strong performance in one domain does not establish fidelity in the others. Models often answer too consistently, compress response scales, and alter relationships between traits whilst richer profiles improve prediction for some models and worsen it for others. The resulting scorecard helps researchers identify which aspects of a synthetic population can support their analysis and where researchers need further human evidence.
articles.titleCn: 人工社会基准：合成研究的验证框架
articles.abstractCn: 综合调查可以复制平均答案，但会歪曲人们对事物的不同看法、答案之间的相互关系，或他们对条件变化的反应。我们引入了人工社会基准来帮助研究人员评估合成人群是否支持其预期的分析。该框架结合了内部、结构性和外部效度的十一项测试，基于二十个人类来源，并比较了九种语言模型。它将每种研究用途与其所需证据联系起来，并测试结果如何随着我们对受访者提供的信息的变化而变化。重要的是，在一个领域的出色表现并不能证明其他领域的保真度。模型往往回答过于一致，压缩了回答量表，并改变了特质之间的关系，而更丰富的个人资料对某些模型改善了预测，但对另一些模型则恶化了预测。由此产生的评分卡帮助研究人员确定合成人群的哪些方面可以支持他们的分析，以及研究人员需要在哪些地方提供进一步的人类证据。

articles.title: Style, Not Self: Surface Cues Explain Zero-Shot Code Attribution by Large Language Models
articles.abstract: If a language model can recognize code it wrote, it may favor that code as a judge, and instances of one model monitoring each other could collude. We test this zero-shot on current commercial models. Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind. In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49-58% for all 15 model-benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38-67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise task, accuracy across 14 evaluator-opponent combinations correlates at r=0.93 with how often the evaluator's solution is longer. Attribution to a named model succeeds on some pairs and is consistently inverted on others. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names preserves Pass@1 and leaves ten of twelve re-tested results at chance; the other two follow a length difference it leaves, although a trained classifier still separates most normalized pairs. Claude Haiku's self-preference also disappears. We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.
articles.titleCn: 风格而非自我：表面线索解释了大语言模型在零样本代码归属中的表现
articles.abstractCn: 如果一个语言模型能够识别它自己编写的代码，它可能会将这段代码作为评判依据，而不同模型相互监控的情况可能导致共谋。我们在当前的商业模型上进行了零样本测试。五个大型语言模型生成了解决MBPP、HumanEval和DS-1000的方案，另外七个模型生成了解决MBPP的方案，这些模型在四个任务中充当评估者：从一对方案中挑选自己的方案、判断单个方案是否为自产、识别两个方案中哪个是由指定模型编写的，以及盲法评判质量。在单方案任务中，所有15个模型基准组合的平衡准确率在49-58%之间，而原始准确率（38-67%）主要反映了模型主张作者身份的倾向。在成对任务中，14个评估者-对手组合的准确率与评估者方案长度出现的频率相关，相关系数为r=0.93。将指定模型的归属成功识别在某些组合中，而在其他组合中则始终被反转。基于规则的归一化方法，去除文档字符串、注释、类型提示和局部名称，可以保留Pass@1，并使12个重新测试结果中的10个达到随机水平；其余两个结果遵循该方法留下的长度差异，尽管训练好的分类器仍能区分大多数归一化后的组合。Claude Haiku的自我偏好也消失了。我们建议报告平衡准确率、启发式基线和标签一致性。

articles.title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
articles.abstract: Advances in language modeling have been driven by scaling pretraining on ever more data. Yet, the training data is still largely curated on the model's behalf. A more general approach to pretraining would let the model learn to generate the data most useful for its own improvement. This would provide an effectively unbounded source of training data, limited by compute rather than human knowledge. We introduce Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data, an initial proof-of-concept towards realizing this vision. Our procedure casts synthetic data generation as a search over the space of all computable structure, taking inspiration from Solomonoff induction. Starting from random initialization, two models learn in tandem: a generator proposes programs interpreted by a universal Turing machine, generating byte sequences, while a learner autoregressively predicts these byte sequences. The learner is trained with standard cross-entropy, while the generator is trained with reinforcement learning to produce sequences at the frontier of the learner's capabilities, yielding an adaptive curriculum. A universal Turing machine gives us a search space over all computable data-generating processes, imposing little domain-specific structure, and self-play searches over this space for useful training data. We test whether zero-shot performance on natural data improves predictably with self-play compute; this is a clean test of transfer since neither generator nor learner is trained on natural data. Across several natural datasets, zero-shot loss exhibits predictable scaling in compute. The models also exhibit in-context learning, and discover recognizable mathematical sequences during training.

articles.titleCn: 零数据自博弈预训练
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的发展主要得益于在不断增加的数据上进行预训练。然而，训练数据仍然主要由模型来筛选。一种更通用的预训练方法可以让模型学会生成对其自身改进最有用的数据。这将提供一个实际上无界的训练数据来源，其限制在于计算能力而非人类知识。我们介绍了“零数据自博弈预训练”，这是一个实现这一愿景的初步概念验证。我们的方法将合成数据生成视为对所有可计算结构空间的搜索，并从中获得灵感。从随机初始化开始，两个模型协同学习：一个生成器提出由通用图灵机解释的程序，生成字节序列，而一个学习器自回归地预测这些字节序列。学习器使用标准的交叉熵进行训练，而生成器使用强化学习来生成学习器能力前沿的序列，从而产生自适应的课程。通用图灵机为我们提供了一个涵盖所有可计算数据生成过程的搜索空间，施加较少的特定领域结构，而自博弈在这个空间中搜索有用的训练数据。我们测试了在自然数据上的零样本性能是否随着自博弈计算量的增加而可预测地提高；这是一个清晰的迁移测试，因为生成器和学习器都没有在自然数据上进行训练。在多个自然数据集上，零样本损失表现出可预测的计算量缩放。这些模型还表现出上下文学习能力，并在训练过程中发现了可识别的数学序列。

articles.title: Scoring Both Directions: LLMs realize the MRS they cannot reliably parse
articles.abstract: The English Resource Grammar (ERG) is a hand-written computational grammar of English. Given a sentence, its processor, ACE, produces a formal meaning representation called Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS): a graph of the sentence's predicates and their arguments. The grammar is bidirectional and can also turn an MRS back into an English sentence. \citet{hajdik2019} used the ERG's treebank to build a benchmark for that generation task, MRS to text, and trained sequence-to-sequence models to solve it. The parsing task, text to MRS, can be tested on the same sentences. We reconstruct their 10K-sentence test split, and score two large language models, Claude Sonnet~4.5 and Claude Opus~5, in both directions against their trained systems and against ACE, with no task-specific training. Given an MRS and three examples, Opus writes the sentence at 76.3 BLEU, ten points above their system trained on 72k pairs (66.1 BLEU), and comparable to their system trained on a million extra pairs (77.2 BLEU). Sonnet scores 65.7 BLEU, and letting it choose among ACE's own candidate sentences lifts it to 69.6, while a pooled judge that keeps Opus's own sentence among the candidates adds 0.6 points (77.0 BLEU). In the parsing direction, however, the models fall far behind ACE: asked for the MRS of the same sentences, they reach 57.2 (Sonnet) and 65.5 (Opus) F$_1$ on the graph's predicates and arguments against 91.0 for ACE, and exact-match the gold on about 1\% of sentences. We characterize the failure modes for the parsing tasks, and conclude that a generation score alone does not show that models understand formal semantic representations.
articles.titleCn: 双向评分：LLM认识到它们无法可靠地解析MRS
articles.abstractCn: 英语资源语法（ERG）是一种手写的英语计算语法。给定一个句子，其处理器ACE会生成一个称为最小递归语义（MRS）的正式意义表示：即句子谓词及其论元的图。该语法是双向的，也可以将MRS转换回英语句子。~\citet{hajdik2019} 使用ERG的树库为该生成任务（MRS到文本）构建了一个基准，并训练了序列到序列模型来解决它。解析任务（文本到MRS）可以在相同的句子上进行测试。我们重建了他们的10K句子的测试集，并在两个方向上对两个大型语言模型Claude Sonnet~4.5和Claude Opus~5进行评分，分别与他们的训练系统和ACE进行对比，且没有进行特定任务的训练。给定一个MRS和三个示例，Opus写出句子的BLEU得分为76.3，比他们训练72k对的系统（66.1 BLEU）高10个百分点，与训练百万对额外数据的系统（77.2 BLEU）相当。Sonnet得分为65.7 BLEU，而让它从ACE自己的候选句子中选择，得分提升至69.6，而一个保持Opus自己的句子在候选中的池化裁判再增加0.6分（77.0 BLEU）。然而，在解析方向上，模型的性能远落后于ACE：对于相同的句子，它们在图的谓词和论元上达到57.2（Sonnet）和65.5（Opus）的F$_1$得分，而ACE为91.0，且仅在约1%的句子中与黄金标准完全匹配。我们对解析任务的失效模式进行了分析，并得出结论：仅凭生成得分并不能证明模型理解了正式语义表示。

articles.title: How Reproducible Are Evaluation Conclusions? A Self-Audit of LLM-Inferred Prompt Structure
articles.abstract: Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.
